Name: Golden Goat
Description:
Golden Goat is a sativa-dominant hybrid marijuana strain comprising 65% sativa and 35% indica with a moderate THC content ranging from 16% to 23%, a low CBD level, and CBG content testing at around 1%. As this strain is predominantly sativa, its effects are described as energetic and uplifting.

This strain was created by a happy accident in Topeka, Kansas, when a female Island Sweet Skunk strain was unintentionally fertilized by a nearby Hawaiian/Romulan hybrid. The result was a potent strain with sweet tropical fruit and citrus flavors and an earthy and spicy aroma. This combination makes for an interesting flavor profile often described as sweet and sour. It’s also known for being pungent and not for the faint of heart.

It’s coined Golden Goat for two reasons. First, for its “golden glow” when the buds are ready for harvest. Second, it was named after the “golden goat recycling machines” smell — a sweet but rancid smell from soda syrups baking in the hot Kansas sun.

Golden Goat marijuana is reported to have both energetic and relaxing effects, mainly because this strain is a blend of both sativa and indica.

Because the Golden Goat strain is sativa dominant, it has prominent energizing effects. But with an indica content of 35%, it also has relaxing and calming effects. Because of this, Golden Goat has been praised for its “balanced” high.
Growing:
Golden Goat can be grown indoors and outdoors, but it can sometimes be tricky to grow, so this strain may not suit a beginner. This is a clone-only strain, meaning that you won’t have Golden Goat seeds to help you grow a new plant. Instead, you’ll need a cutting from a mature female plant.

As it’s sativa-dominant, it grows quite tall, towering over 6 feet (1.6 meters), and needs space for its leaves to stretch out, so it often suits an outdoor environment. It first blossomed in Topeka, Kansas, so if you want to grow it outdoors, it must be in a warm, dry climate with plenty of hot sunlight. As this plant is tall and leafy, it must be pruned regularly to train it and promote growth.
This strain can be grown indoors but may yield smaller than those grown outdoors. Plants grown indoors may yield 1.5 ounces per plant, whereas those grown outdoors can yield up to 14 ounces per plant.

Height

Golden Goat plants can grow greater than 78 inches tall or well over 6 feet. This is why they suit an outdoor environment or an ample indoor grow space.

Humidity and Temperature

Unlike most varieties of cannabis, Golden Goat grows best in a dry climate, not a humid one. The ideal temperature range is 72 to 80 degrees Fahrenheit, which is why growing outdoors in a warm and dry climate is favored. If you choose to grow it indoors, your indoor grow space needs to recreate this environment.

Flowering

Like many sativa strains, growing time can be long. If grown indoors, Golden Goat will be ready to harvest in nine to 11 weeks or in late October if grown outdoors.

Name: God’s Gift
Description:
God’s Gift is a popular indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain (cultivar), with 90% Cannabis indica and 10% Cannabis sativa genetics. It is made by crossing parent strains Granddaddy Purple and OG Kush, two highly potent and popular strains. Its relaxing and sedative effects suggest God’s Gift helps manage anxiety, insomnia, and chronic pain.

God’s Gift has dreamy and blissful effects. It has earthy, berry, citrus, chestnut, hash flavors, pine, grape, and spicy scents. These aromas and flavors make God’s Gift attractive and pleasing for users.

The God’s Gift strain is believed to have been created in 1995, but it began gaining popularity in California dispensaries in 2005. BC Bud Depot and Scorpion Crew are the breeders who are commonly associated with God’s Gift.

Today, God’s Gift is a popular strain in Canada and on the West Coast of the United States, especially in Nevada, California, and northwestern states such as Washington and Oregon. It won Best Indica at the 2015 Bio Cannabis Cup in Spain.

God’s Gift marijuana has dense buds with lots of white trichomes due to the high THC content. The flowers are deep purple, the pistils are bright orange, and the sugar leaves that grow around the flowers are violet, green, and/or gray.
Growing:
God’s Gift is described as being a relatively easy strain for beginners to grow. It’s resistant to many diseases and pests and is also a strong plant, making it less likely to succumb to breakages.
However, providing God’s Gift with sufficient nutrients is crucial, potentially more than some other strains is crucial. Nitrogen, potassium, and phosphorus are vital nutrients to consider.
God’s Gift plants can be grown indoors and outdoors, but a hydroponics setup is highly recommended. A hydroponics setup involves using a water-based solution instead of soil.
If this isn’t possible, you can still use soil; in these cases, the “sea of green” growing method is beneficial. This is where you grow many small plants in a confined area rather than a few larger plants.
You can expect a yield of approximately 10 ounces (283 grams) of bud per square meter when you grow God’s Gift indoors or outdoors.

Height

Like other indica-dominant cannabis strains, God’s Gift is a relatively short plant. You can expect it to reach heights of between 30 to 60 inches (76 to 152 centimeters).

Humidity and Temperature

A dry and warm environment is optimal for growing God’s Gift plants.
The humidity should be kept between 30% and 40%. This is important because God’s Gift can be susceptible to bud rot if there is excessive moisture in the air.
God’s Gift grows best at temperatures between 68 and 80 degrees Fahrenheit (approximately 20 to 27 degrees Celsius).

Flowering

God’s Gift generally takes between seven and nine weeks to flower.
If you choose to grow God’s Gift outside, it should be ready to harvest sometime between late September and mid-October.

Description:
Gorilla Glue #4, often shortened to GG4, is a sativa-dominant cannabis hybrid created by GG strains. A potent hybrid cultivar, GG4 is 63% sativa and 37% indica.

Gorilla Glue #4 has a distinctive look. Densely packed and glazed with crystalline particles and trichomes, the plant also tends to feature leaves and hairs that stick out, giving buds the appearance of having a light dusting of snow.

Winning multiple awards, it remains famous for its THC content, which is among the highest in the world at 25%. As a result, this strain is only recommended for more experienced users.

Because of extensive backcrossing, the Gorilla Glue strain has many parents, including Sour Diesel, Sour Dubb, Chem’s Sister, and Chocolate Diesel. This strain is far from a caffeine boost for coffee and chocolate tasting, producing a “couch-lock” effect.
Growing:
Height

As a sativa, GG4 will likely grow tall. Many GG4 plants have reached extremely tall heights of 80 inches (203 cm). On average, these plants grow to heights of 130-170 cm, so that they will need a spacious growing environment.

Grow in conditions of relative humidity (RH) level of approximately 60%.





Flowering

The average flowering time for GG4 is roughly 56 days to 63 days or eight to nine weeks.

Description:
Gelato, also known as Larry Bird and Gelato #42, is a roughly equal indica-sativa hybrid (56% indica, 44% sativa) with a balanced euphoric-uplifting-relaxing effect.

Gelato is a cross of Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint GSC and measures between 15% and 20% THC content. It has been described as having a sweet aroma; a fruity, nutty, vanilla, and mint flavor, and relaxing, euphoric, and even arousing effects. Gelato could help alleviate stress and anxiety and help with chronic pain, fatigue, and insomnia. Variations of Gelato #42 include Gelato #3, Gelato #33, Gelato #41 and Gelato #45.
Growing:
The Gelato marijuana strain is not the most challenging cultivar of cannabis to grow and has a good level of pest resistance. However, it is sensitive to humidity and temperature changes, so it may be better for those with a few grows under their belt than those who are brand new to growing cannabis. Gelato is better suited for indoor growing. Expect yields of around 17 ounces per square meter.

Height

Expect Gelato to grow between 3 and 5 feet or 36 to 60 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

The ideal temperature for Gelato is between 70 and 80 degrees Fahrenheit (21 to 26 degrees Celsius) during the day, reducing the temperatures by 10-15 degrees to 55-65 degrees Fahrenheit (13 to 18 degrees Celsius) at night to stimulate purple coloration. As with most varieties of cannabis, Gelato does best at a humidity level of around 50% during the vegetative stage, gradually reducing to 40%, 35% and finally to 30% during the final two weeks of the flowering stage.

Flowering

It takes approximately eight to nine weeks for Gelato to finish flowering.

Name: Fruity Pebbles
Description:
Fruity Pebbles, also referred to as Fruity Pebbles OG and Fruity OG, is an indica-dominant hybrid strain created by Alien Genetics in 2006. The hybrid takes genetics from Green Ribbon, Granddaddy Purple, and Tahoe Alien to create a berry flavor.

The strain’s buds are lime green, and the rest of the plant manifests various greens, reddish-browns, and light shades of purple, giving it a mottled “cereal-like” appearance. The plant is known for containing many resinous crystals and a bushy appearance with orange hairs.

Its complex chemical composition delivers an extremely fruity smell reminiscent of the popular cereal “Frooty Pebbles.” It provides a strong euphoric effect to elicit an uplifted mood when stressed and induces sleep in those with insomnia.

Fruity Pebbles is reported to be one the most enjoyable and popular strains on the market, but it’s one of the more difficult strains to get hold of due to its genetics. The potency of tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) and cannabidiol (CBD) can vary significantly between individual plants.
Growing:
The Fruity Pebbles marijuana strain is suitable for intermediate growers because it does require a few environmental conditions. Common to sativa strains, it grows tall and lanky, requiring plenty of vertical space and light to thrive.

Mold is common in areas with high humidity and low water evaporation. Fruity Pebbles contains resinous trichomes on its buds, which make it resistant to mold by the Botrytis fungus.
The “screen of green” growing method is recommended to maximize the yield of Fruity Pebbles. The method involves securing a screen above the canopy of the plants and then tying the plant to the screen as it grows. Due to its massive height, growers should trim fan leaves to allow light to penetrate lower branches. Finally, because of the pungent aroma of the strain, it’s recommended to use tools like carbon filters and exhaust fans to maximize airflow.

As the plant moves through the vegetative stage, the plant foliage becomes denser. When flowering starts, anthocyanins are produced, creating the purple/red hues of the leaves. During the final weeks of flowering, the plant length increases by at least 50%, reaching five to six feet.

Height

Fruity Pebbles requires space to grow to tall sativa-like heights; the strain can reach a height of 30 to 70 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

Fruity Pebbles prefers a temperate climate throughout its growing stage and indirect sunlight.

Flowering

Fruity Pebbles has a flowering period of between eight and nine weeks and produces average yields. When grown indoors, you can expect 16 ounces per square meter. Outdoors, this increases to 18 ounces per plant.

Name: Fruity Juice
Description:
Known for its sweet, fruity taste, the Fruity Juice strain (popularly known by a trademarked candy name) is a 55% Cannabis sativa and 45% Cannabis indica hybrid. Its THC level ranges from 18% to 20%, and its CBG and CBD levels test around 1%. This makes for a well-balanced strain (cultivar) with energetic, time-warping effects. Fruity Juice can help manage stress and inflammation, anxiety, and depression.

A cross between a pure Afghani indica and a pure Thai sativa — both iconic landrace strains — Fruity Juice comes from strong roots.

Because they are not the product of crossbreeding, landrace strains are either 100% sativa or 100% indica. These landrace strains are named after the original geographical home of the cannabis plant, which for sativa strains is equatorial countries, and for indica strains is Central Asia.

Fruity Juice was developed by the seed company Sensi Seeds and named after its delicious flavor profile. With strong tropical and sugary sweet flavors — and a hint of something sour — this strain is very popular among cannabis users and is great for beginners.

The effects of sativa and indica interact to create a high that starts with mood-boosting, cerebral effects that mellow into a state of relaxation over a few hours. Because it’s so well balanced, this strain will suit any time of day. It is important to note that some people experience a “time-warping” effect when using Fruity Juice, where three hours may feel like five minutes or vice versa.
Growing:
The Fruity Juice plant characteristics are a blend of sativa and indica traits. It stretches tall and thin towards the sky like a typical sativa but flowers in just 50 to 60 days like an indica. Also, expect your Fruity Juice to turn into a large-leafed, thick-stemmed plant.

This strain can be grown indoors, outdoors, and in a greenhouse. Like many cannabis varieties, Fruity Juice will thrive in a Mediterranean-like environment when growing outdoors. Topping will help promote lateral growth and allow more plant access to direct sunlight. Expect yields of up to 21 ounces per plant in an outside environment and 17 ounces per square meter for indoor plants.

If you choose to grow your Fruity Juice indoors, you may want to try the “sea of green” growing method to increase the yield. This method involves shortening the plant’s growth phase to grow a larger number of smaller plants for a shorter time to increase overall yield. This method was coined “sea of green” because of the large grow rooms packed full of green cannabis plants.

Height

If grown in the right conditions, you can expect your Fruity Juice plant to grow up to 9 feet or 3 meters tall.

Flowering

If you are growing your Fruity Juice plants indoors, they will flower between 50 and 60 days. Outdoor plants will be ready to harvest from late September to early October.

Name: Fruit Loops
Description:
Fruit Loops is a flavorful indica hybrid descended from some legendary strains. Said to be a four-way cross between Blueberry, White Widow, Grapefruit, and Blue Dream, Fruit Loops has a prestigious lineage.

White Widow is one of the most recognizable strains worldwide, and Blueberry took the High Times Cannabis Cup for best indica in 2000.  As no significant breeder has claimed responsibility for creating Fruit Loops, seeds are not commercially available, meaning prospective growers must source cuttings from mature plants to grow genetically identical clones.

This well-balanced strain has genetics that leans slightly in favor of indica (55% indica and 45% sativa), meaning its uplifting and stimulating powers go hand in hand with a deep and resonant relaxation.

Some strains are considered one-hit wonders, whereas Fruit Loops is slightly more subtle, with users reporting a comfortable and gradual onset of effects. A profound sense of physical relaxation and ease is countered by a surge in mental activity and creativity for the user.

Fruit Loops boasts moderate tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) levels, averaging 18%-22%. It is considered a mellow, well-rounded, and multipurpose strain, suitable for socializing and relaxing, enhancing creativity, and helping with pain management. Not surprisingly, Fruit Loops’ sweet berry aroma and sugary cereal taste have been compared to treats like blueberries, candy, birthday cake, and tropical fruits. Its effects make Fruit Loops potentially helpful in managing anxiety and depression.
Growing:
Like many indica-leaning varieties, Fruit Loops is short and bushy, with buds that exhibit a similar compact density. The buds are dull olive green, resinous, and woven with bright orange pistils.

Considered a robust variety suitable for beginners, Fruit Loops can do well indoors in a small tent or a more elaborate grow room. Unlike many varieties, Fruit Loops can cope with colder weather and thrive outdoors until harvest. This strain will produce around 12 ounces of buds per plant.

Potential growers should know that this strain must be grown from cuttings rather than seeds.

Height

Fruit Loops is a short bushy strain, growing less than 30 inches tall.

Humidity and Temperature

This strain prefers moderate levels of humidity. Humidity levels should be maintained at 40%-50%, or the plant should be grown in a semi-humid climate if cultivated outdoors.

Flowering

Fruit Loops has an average flowering time of eight to nine weeks.

Name: Forbidden Fruit
Description:
Forbidden Fruit is an indica-dominant strain that came about through the crossbreeding of Cherry Pie and Tangie strains. The indica-to-sativa ratio is around 70:30, respectively.

Forbidden Fruit offers substantial tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) levels, often around 25%, significantly higher than many other strains (cultivars). These levels send the body of its users into deep relaxation. Those who have tried Forbidden Fruit have described it as having a distinct taste of sweet berries, mangoes, grapefruit, and a sweet, tropical fruit aroma.

The effects of Forbidden Fruit come on strongly and lead to a potent and intoxicating high that slowly decreases and induces sleepiness; therefore, it’s best to be used later in the day or evening. This cultivar could be very useful for managing chronic pain, anxiety, and insomnia.
Growing:
Although Forbidden Fruit may be hard to come by when wanting to purchase, it is relatively easy to grow for even the most novice growers. It is a low-maintenance plant and moderately resistant to diseases, mold, and mildew.

Forbidden Fruit can be grown indoors and outdoors if certain conditions are met. These plants will thrive in a moderate climate with lots of sunlight and reasonably dry air, and planted in rich, organic soil will ensure they can flourish to their potential.

Height

Forbidden Fruit will grow to an average height of 4 feet but can grow up to 6 feet in optimal growing conditions.

Humidity and Temperature

Forbidden Fruit thrives in a warm Mediterranean climate, with long summers and a lot of light and dry air.

Flowering

Forbidden Fruit will flower in approximately 10 weeks.
The harvest time for an outdoor plant is in mid-October.

Name: Elmer’s Glue
Description:
Elmer’s Glue is an indica-dominant hybrid created by Relentless Genetics in the Southern United States. Elmer’s glue was created by crossing the famously potent Gorilla Glue #4 with The White, producing a hybrid with a complex flavor profile and high THC content (greater than 26%).

The parents of Elmer’s Glue are classic strains known for their potency. Gorilla Glue #4 is one of the most potent strains at 30% THC with little CBD content. The White is known for its dense trichome coverage, producing frosted white buds and sugar leaves.

Elmer’s Glue is a sedative strain with pain-relieving and reflective effects, perfect for nighttime use. This strain may help alleviate chronic pain, insomnia, stress, and depression.

This strain is aromatic with notes of diesel and sweet pine cones. The taste is mild but sweet and earthy.
Growing:
Like its parent strain, The White, Elmer’s Glue produces compact buds packed with frosted trichomes. This variety is short and compact, but growers can expect moderate yields of up to 400 grams per square meter indoors.

There are multiple phenotypes of Elmer’s Glue, but there is little known distinction between them online. In general, this is a compact indica variety suited to indoor growing. Due to its compact nature, it is crucial to stay on top of trimming to allow for good air circulation and light penetration into the center of the plant.

While this plant is relatively squat, the colas will stretch considerably in the early flowering stage. If there is limited space, it would be advisable to train these plants to prevent them from being burned by lighting and increase yields.

Elmer’s Glue responds well to “screen of green” (SCROG) training. The SCROG method is topping the plants in the early vegetative stage (removing the apical or center stem). This encourages the plant to produce more side shoots, eventually becoming colas (flowers). Once topped, the branches of the plants are gently weaved through support (usually a horizontal trellis) to maximize the amount of light reaching each potential bud site.

Elmer’s Glue may also benefit from low-stress training (LST) and high-stress training (HST). These techniques are slightly more advanced but don’t require trellising. They both involve bending plant stems, much more so with high-stress training, and should only be attempted by experienced growers.

Elmer’s Glue requires a semi-humid and warm climate to grow outdoors.

Height

Elmers Glue typically grows between 30 and 60 inches indoors and 60 to 80 inches outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

Elmer’s Glue prefers a slightly more humid environment; however, it’s important not to encourage fungal growth on these plants. When growing indoors, keep the relative humidity between 40%-60% in the vegetative phase and drop it to 40%-50% during flowering to prevent molds such as bud rot from taking hold.
Temperatures should stay between 70-80 F (21-26 C). The humidity may fluctuate with changes in temperature as the water cools and condenses from the air, so continual humidity monitoring is essential.

Flowering

Elmer’s Glue takes nine to 10 weeks to finish flowering.

Name: Dutch Treat
Description:
Dutch Treat, also known as Dutch Crunch or Dutch Treat Haze, is a hybrid strain created by crossing Northern Lights, a classic indica, with Haze, one of the world’s most popular strains.

Leaning heavily in favor of indica, Dutch Treat is 80% Cannabis indica and 20% Cannabis sativa, with high THC content of between 18% and 25%. This well-balanced strain produces mildly-stimulating euphoric effects, making it a popular strain for gentle socializing and relaxation. Due to its effects, Dutch Treat is often labeled a “sativa,” but this is not the case.

Though its name suggests European origins, the original Dutch Treat is said to have been developed by Jordan of the Islands, a breeder from Vancouver Island in British Columbia who is famous for creating the legendary God Bud strain.

Dutch Treat’s notable energizing, sociable effects have made it a popular choice in Amsterdam coffee houses. It is a sought-after strain in Europe, Canada, and the United States, with its popularity often attributed to it being a particularly well-balanced indica-dominant strain.

Though high levels of indica can be associated with sedation, this variety won’t have you sinking into the couch. Instead, users have reported that this strain actually feels more like an even balance between indica and sativa, making it perfect for fighting fatigue and instilling a euphoric mood. Dutch Treat is generally considered versatile — a good option for nighttime socializing, introspection, and relaxation.

An award-winning hybrid, Dutch Treat dominated the indica category at the 2012 Southern California Cannabis Cup and is frequently used in cross-breeding to develop new strains.

Dense, sticky buds are characteristic of this strain, as are bright orange hairs and a thick fuzz of trichomes. Flavor-wise, it is predominantly sweet and fruity but with additional herbal notes of pine and eucalyptus.
Growing:
Although it is an indica-dominant cultivar, the appearance and structure of a Dutch Treat plant are said to better resemble a typical sativa, with wispy leaves that are fairly sparse in arrangement. Dutch Treat thrives best in an indoor hydroponic system, though it is an adaptable strain that can be grown outdoors. If grown outdoors, growers should anticipate lower yields and avoid significant temperature fluctuations. Warmth is crucial to a successful harvest of Dutch Treat, so living in a stable, warm, dry climate is essential in attempting to grow this strain outdoors. Dutch Treat is highly resistant to disease and is a good choice for beginner gardeners.

Growers should ensure the lower half of their Dutch Treat plants are well-trimmed. Dutch Treat plants tend to be quite bushy, and careful pruning will increase growth at the colas (bud sites).

Height

Dutch Treat plants are short and stout, with an average height of 30 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

For best results when growing Dutch Treat, temperatures should be between 68-80 degrees Fahrenheit (20-26 degrees Celsius)., High airflow and low humidity should be maintained to ensure quality buds.

Flowering

The average flowering time for Dutch Treat is six to eight weeks.

Name: Dragon’s Breath
Description:
Dragon Breath is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross strain made by crossing the Northern Lights indica strain with the Jack Herer sativa strain. It’s also believed that an unknown skunk strain is added into the mix. This is likely responsible for the intense, skunky scents. Its flavor profile is earthy, sweet, citrusy, and slightly spicy.

Dragon Breath was created by Ocean Grown Seeds and has become increasingly popular. However, the actual genetic makeup of Dragon Breath isn’t known. Most breeders think it’s sativa-leaning, while some consider it a balanced hybrid with 50% Cannabis sativa and 50% Cannabis indica genetics.

In 2018, High Times named Dragon Breath their “10 Best Weed Strains To Ring In The New Year.” The strain is primarily known in the cannabis community for its clear-headed effects.

The appearance of Dragon Breath is attractive, with large and lumpy buds. They take on a color ranging from forest green to purple and blue. The buds also have a frosty coating of sticky trichomes.
Growing:
Dragon Breath plants are relatively easy to grow, even for first-time cannabis planters. They require less maintenance than other strains because the plants are resistant to molds, pests, and mildew.

The yield is roughly similar to the average yield for cannabis strains. When grown indoors, you’ll obtain approximately 16 ounces (453 grams) of Dragon Breath bud per square meter of the plant. If you grow Dragon Breath outdoors, you can expect a slightly higher yield of around 18 ounces (510 grams) of bud per square meter of the plant.

Cultivators suggest that growing methods suitable for the Dragon Breath strain include:

Height

Dragon Breath plants usually reach heights between 30 and 60 inches (0.7 and 1.5 meters).

Humidity and Temperature

Like many cannabis strains, Dragon Breath grows best in a warm, dry, and sunny environment– often described as a “Mediterranean” climate.
The temperature of the environment has a significant impact on the color of the flowers. Dragon Breath flowers are dark blue and purple in cooler temperatures, and in warmer temperatures, they’re light green.

Flowering

The average flowering time for Dragon Breath plants is eight to nine weeks. If you’re growing Dragon Breath outdoors in the Northern Hemisphere, the plants will likely be ready to harvest during mid-October.

Name: Dragon Fruit
Description:
The Dragon Fruit Strain crosses two popular strains: Snow Lotus and Super Silver Haze. It has characteristics of both strains being 50% indica and 50% sativa, and contains relatively high levels of THC with almost no detectable CBD.

It gets its name from its fruity flavor, which resembles its namesake — a real dragon fruit. Users have claimed that this strain helps reduce stress and anxiety while elevating mood, making it a highly sought-after strain.
Growing:
Dragon Fruit marijuana can be grown indoors and outdoors but is often best grown indoors where the conditions can be controlled.

Height

The Dragon Fruit strain produces a classic indica-like plant: short and bushy. It reaches 60-80 centimeters, making it an ideal cannabis variety for those with limited space.

Humidity and Temperature

Dragon Fruit grows best in climates that mimic Mediterranean conditions, including moderate humidity and high light levels. It can be grown hydroponically and in soil, depending on available resources. This makes it an attractive plant to try and grow, with the addition of it being relatively mold and pest-resistant.
The plant benefits from being trimmed at the bottom, ensuring good airflow. It is also said to benefit from high-pressure sodium lights, accelerating maturation, and flowering for impatient growers.

Flowering

It flowers between 56-70 days if grown indoors, and the harvest period is between October and September, depending on the growing conditions. Its yield can be upwards of 300 grams if grown in the right conditions.

Name: Double Dream
Description:
Double Dream is a sativa-dominant hybrid created by crossing Dream Star with the famed Blue Dream, hence the name Double Dream. Double Dream is a 90% sativa and 10% indica hybrid with a THC content of 20%.

Double Dream is considered a daytime strain (cultivar) despite the dreamy name, and it causes a euphoric buzz and is unlikely to cause “couch lock.” Double Dream is informally considered a “party” strain, helping users become more sociable. For this reason, Double Dream may be particularly helpful for managing anxiety, and it may also help alleviate depression, stress, and chronic pain symptoms.

Double Dream has a beautiful blend of sweet floral notes and spice, with some users reporting the taste of blueberry, which comes from the lineage of its parent Blue Dream.
Growing:
Double Dream produces thick, frosted buds that are light green and covered in bright orange hairs (pistils). The leaves are wispy.

The strain is relatively easy to grow, but finding Double Dream seeds may be challenging as this strain is elusive. Most growers will grow this from cuttings, and it is a vigorous grower that will need a bit of attention, especially when it comes to trimming.

This variety benefits from heavy trimming to open up the center of the plant for good air circulation. Trimming will also help improve light intensity across bud sites. Double Dream buds can also get quite large and heavy, which is a plus for yields, but it does mean that a trellis should support them.

Double Dream responds well to the “screen of green” (SCROG) training method. The SCROG method involves topping the plants in the early vegetative stage (removing the apical or center stem). This encourages the plant to produce more side shoots, eventually becoming colas (flowers).

Once topped, the branches of the plants are gently weaved through support (usually a horizontal trellis) to maximize the amount of light reaching each potential bud site. Weaving the branches along the trellis will help support the weight of the buds and prevent snapping.

Double Dream is a high yielder producing up to 750 grams per square meter indoors and 800 grams per square meter outdoors. If growing outdoors, this variety prefers a warm “Mediterranean” climate.

Height

Double Dream can grow quite tall, reaching between 60-80 inches indoors and out.

Humidity and Temperature

While this variety may be resistant to mildew, keeping the relative humidity between 40%-60% in the vegetative phase and dropping it to 30%-40% during flowering to prevent mold. Temperatures should stay in the 70-80 F (21-26 C) range; however, Double Dream can tolerate warmer temperatures.

Flowering

Double Dream has a relatively short flowering period of 56-63 days (seven to eight weeks).

Name: Dosido
Description:
Dosido — also referred to as Dosi Doe, Dosi, or Do-Si-Dos strain — is an indica-dominant hybrid strain (70% indica/30% sativa) developed in 2016 by breeder Archive Seed Bank. It was created by parents Face-Off OG and GSC (GSC). Face-Off OG is a potent Californian indica cultivar rich in CBG and praised for its reported medicinal benefits. GSC is a potent, award-winning strain with a dessert-like aroma.

Dosido is visually appealing, featuring bright orange pistils, a mixture of green and lavender leaves, and a thick coat of white resinous trichomes. When grown, it produces a pine and lime fragrance that transforms into a pungent skunky smell when smoked.

The buds of Dosido are particularly potent, delivering a tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) level of up to 30% and a cannabidiol (CBD) level of 1%. It’s known for delivering a very potent but smooth high that can lift your mood and provide a psychoactive experience. Dosido has been reported as having sleepy, relaxing effects that could make this weed strain ideal for managing stress, anxiety, insomnia, and chronic pain.
Growing:
Dosido isn’t a strain for beginner growers due to its requirement for intermediate humidity and warmer climates. Growers wanting to select leaves with colorful purple hues should expose the crops to a short period of cold during the night before the plant’s flowering season.

As Dosido is a pungent strain, it requires good ventilation from carbon air filters or exhaust fans.

Dosido produces a medium yield but can improve with training techniques such as “sea of green.” The method involves securing a screen above the canopy of plants and tying the plant to the screen as it grows. It allows branches/leaves to be exposed to sunlight while using space in the growing chamber.

Height

Dosido plants can grow up to 39 inches when grown indoors. This can increase to 8 feet if grown outside.

Humidity and Temperature

Dosido can be grown indoors and outdoors, but growers tend to keep them indoors to control temperature and humidity.
Dosido thrives at temperatures between 75 and 82 degrees Fahrenheit.

Flowering

The flowering time for Dosido is around seven to nine weeks. It produces an average yield, providing 17-31 ounces.

Name: Dog Walker
Description:
The Dog Walker strain is an indica-dominant cross between the Albert Walker OG and Chemdawg 91 strains. Sometimes called Dog Walker OG, its name comes from the pungent scent that it gives off when burnt, which is something like the skunky smell of a wet dog with an earthy undertone.

While that might not seem very appealing, regular users say that it becomes an acquired taste and that its effects are quite balanced. It is a notably potent strain of cannabis, which means that people often experience more of an effect than expected, and it may not be suitable for first-time users.

Dog Walker has been described as having cerebral and calming effects that help improve focus. This suggests that Dog Walker OG may be useful for managing anxiety, attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and chronic fatigue syndrome.

This OG strain can be grown both inside and outside, but it may be tricky to grow for beginners. Its yield indoors can be lower than outdoors, but there are several tips and tricks you could use to increase yield. The original plant’s seeds are unavailable commercially, meaning clone-only versions are available, and some companies have made their version of the plant commercially available.

This plant can grow to be between 60 and 90 inches tall indoors and may reach up to 6 feet tall outdoors.

Early on, the plant may benefit from up to 65% humidity. Reduce humidity when the plant begins to flower to prevent the buds from rotting.

Flowering

It takes nine to 10 weeks for this plant to flower when grown indoors, but it can be harvested from mid to late October when grown outdoors. There are many different ways to tell if your plant has been flowering for long enough to be harvested.

Description:
Diablo Wind, also known as Diablo OG, is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain that is a cross between African and Grapefruit.115 Some enthusiasts argue that it is a cross between OG Kush and a South African sativa. Diablo Wind is known for its potent THC content, averaging around 20%, but can reach up to 28% in some cases. Diablo Wind is 60% sativa and 40% indica.

Diablo Wind is celebrated for its uplifting and energizing effects, making it a popular choice for daytime use. However, beginners should proceed with caution due to its strong psychoactive properties. The high THC content in Diablo Wind may make it beneficial for those dealing with stress, depression, and fatigue. Diablo Wind is reported to have a complex flavor profile, with notes of spicy, citrus, sweet, earthy, and pine.

Diablo Wind plants are moderately challenging to cultivate, growing to a large size with a high yield. Suitable for indoor or outdoor growth, this strain is an ideal choice for experienced growers seeking a rewarding harvest.

Diablo Wind plants grow to a moderate size, with sturdy stems that can withstand various conditions. Given proper care and attention, cultivators can expect a bountiful yield.

Humidity and Temperature

The Diablo Wind strain flourishes most effectively in a moderately hot climate. Cultivating indoors allows growers to regulate the ideal temperature and humidity levels.

Flowering

The flowering time for Diablo Wind is moderate, typically between eight to nine weeks.

Name: Critical Mass
Description:
Critical Mass is an indica-dominant strain (cultivar) renowned for its large dense buds, hence, the name. The big buds get so huge that some have been known to snap branches. Critical Mass also has relatively high tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) content, which is impressive for a plant with such huge buds. Critical Mass has been described as having relaxing, sleepy effects, making it ideal for chronic pain, stress, and insomnia.

Furthermore, if you’re looking for a strain that prefers indoors over outdoors, then Critical Mass is ideal; when this strain is grown outdoors, the buds are more susceptible to mold.

This strain was created by Mr. Nice, a cultivator who has won several awards in the High Times Cannabis Cup by crossing Afghani indica and Skunk #1 strains. Critical Mass is 80% Cannabis indica and 20% Cannabis sativa.

The THC content tests around 20%, and the CBD is usually quite low, with some phenotypes measuring up to 5%. Critical Mass’ heavy bud production and high-CBD phenotypes have made it a cornerstone of many breeding projects. A CBD-rich version of Critical Mass is available, called “CBD Critical Mass.” This cultivar generally has a 1:1 THC:CBD ratio, regularly measuring between 5% and 10% THC and CBD.
Growing:
Critical Mass is an indica-dominant plant and will not grow very tall. Indica plants are typically short and bushy, whereas sativa plants are tall. Because of this, Critical Mass is a great indoor plant, and keeping it indoors is best since the massive buds are prone to mold after rainfall. In other words, it grows to its best potential when kept indoors away from the rain.

Critical Mass is pest-resistant, but it’s prone to diseases like mold. Pruning the plant facilitates airflow, which prevents moisture from collecting on the buds, thus protecting it from some diseases that are attracted to moisture.

When grown outdoors, growers can expect 21 ounces (595 grams) per square meter. However, the yield could increase to 27 ounces per square meter when grown indoors. This high yield is remarkable for an indica strain, and it will certainly exceed your expectations for an indica if you grow it yourself.

If you grow Critical Mass indoors, remember to provide the plant with regular feeding, water, and sun. Also — this can’t be stressed enough — stay on top of the humidity and temperature to prevent mold from growing on the buds.

Height

Critical Mass grows between 32-80 inches (1.1-2 meters).

Humidity and Temperature

Unlike most cannabis varieties, Critical Mass doesn’t like high humidity. Therefore, keep the humidity levels at around 50% during the vegetative stage and reduce it to 35% or even as low as 30% when the buds form.

Ideal temperatures are between 68 and 80 degrees Fahrenheit (20 to 26.7 degrees Celsius) and no lower than 60 to 70 degrees Fahrenheit (15.5 to 21 degrees Celsius) at night. If grown inside, a heat lamp is helpful in maintaining the correct temperatures at all times.

Flowering

The time for Critical Mass to flower is eight weeks or longer. Most indicas typically finish flowering in about six to nine weeks.

This strain is very pungent, so if you’re growing it inside, you’ll need to ensure you have sound ventilation systems, especially if you’re trying to be discreet. Cornbread requires constant maintenance to trim away branches and leaves that prevent light from being able to shine onto the flowering nodes.

When well-maintained, you should expect flowering to begin within nine to 10 weeks. You can expect an outdoor yield of between 10 and 15 ounces per plant and an indoor yield of between 0.5 and 1 ounce per square foot.

Name: Blueberry OG
Description:
A cross between OG Kush and DJ Short Blueberry, Blueberry OG — or Blueberry OG Kush — is an indica-dominant marijuana hybrid. It is 70% Cannabis indica and 30% Cannabis sativa.

Barney’s Farm on the West Coast created Blueberry OG with some well-loved parents. A cross between the infamous indica-dominant OG Kush and the much-loved indica-dominant DJ Short Blueberry, Blueberry OG, was set up for success. Taking after its parents with a strong indica effect, this strain produces a powerful body high that calms and relaxes the body.

Blueberry OG’s flavor profile contains the best characteristics of both of its parents. With sweet, sour, and citrus flavors from OG Kush and the strong fruity blueberry flavor from DJ Short Blueberry — and earthy aroma from both — Blueberry OG is delicious.

The full-body high that Blueberry OG is known for is a result of it being 70% indica. This strain has relaxing, numbing effects, which make it ideal for nighttime use and to help with sleep. With a THC content ranging from 16% to 24%, this strain can pack a punch, so users should be careful with dosing if they want to avoid “couch lock.”

The CBD content of Blueberry OG is debated but largely considered to be low. Those who claim it has CBD levels over 10% boast of its pain-relieving abilities. While it is common to use the numbing effects of indica-dominant strains to help with pain, it may not be effective for everyone.
Growing:
Blueberry OG can be grown from seeds and cuttings (also known as clones). The creator of Blueberry OG, Barneys Farm, tightly controls the sale of these seeds, making them very hard to come by. Because of this, the easiest way to grow Blueberry OG is to find someone with a mature female plant and get a cutting from there.
This plant can be grown indoors and outdoors but is not suitable for novice gardeners because it requires a high level of maintenance. Indica-dominant Blueberry OG will grow short and bushy with densely packed buds and branches. Plants need pruning so branches on the top do not overshadow them. Sunlight is essential for maturing plants; you want the largest surface area possible to receive direct sunlight.
You can also use “temperature shocking” to bring out more vibrant colors on the buds. This requires exposing your plants to a lower temperature before the start of the flowering stage. This is easy if you grow Blueberry OG indoors, as you can easily adjust the temperature, but it’s more challenging to control in an outdoor setting.
You can expect a successful indoor plant to yield around 21 ounces for every 10 square feet, and outdoor plants will have a higher yield of approximately 35 ounces per plant.

Height

You can expect your Blueberry OG plants to grow to a medium height of between 3 and 4 feet. Plants grown indoors will be shorter, reaching just over 3 feet, whereas those grown outdoors can reach a maximum of 4 feet.

Humidity and Temperature

Blueberry OG is a versatile plant that will be able to grow in temperate and hot environments. Climates that get colder may even be advantageous for “temperature-shocking” outdoor crops.

Flowering

Blueberry OG will flower in 55 to 65 days if grown outdoors and will be ready to harvest by the second to the third week of October.

Name: Blueberry Muffin
Description:
Blueberry Muffin, aka Blueberry Muffins, is an indica-dominant strain produced by Humboldt Seed Company. It is an 80% indica, 20% sativa cross of Razzleberry and Purple Panty Dropper and is often described as having relaxing, arousing, and energizing effects.

This cultivar is also noted for its sweet, vanilla, blueberry, creamy, muffin-like smell and flavor. Its effects suggest that Blueberry Muffin may be useful for managing insomnia, chronic pain, anxiety, and depression. THC content is generally 18% to 21%, with CBD at 0.05%. Blueberry Muffin won 6th place at the 2017 Emerald Cup.
Growing:
Blueberry Muffin is one of Humboldt Seed Company’s most popular strains, thanks to its smell, taste, and effects. Moreover, Blueberry Muffin has good resistance to mold and a relatively short flowering time thanks to its indica background. It is suitable for indoor and outdoor growth and has deep green and purple hues.

Some have noted sativa-dominant phenotypes, which may be better suited to outdoor grows in Mediterranean climates and may help explain why some people experience uplifting and stimulating effects. Taller phenotypes may respond well to “screen of green” (ScrOG) growing, so you can train the plant.

Height

Blueberry Muffin can grow from 4 to 7 feet and may grow slightly taller than many indicas.

Humidity and Temperature

As with most varieties of cannabis, Blueberry Muffin does best at a humidity level of around 50% during the vegetative stage, gradually reducing to 45%, 40%, and finally 30% during the final stages of flowering. Blueberry Muffin may tolerate higher humidities than many other cannabis varietals.

Ideal temperatures are between 70 and 85 degrees Fahrenheit (21 to 29 degrees Celsius) during the day and between 60 and 70 degrees Fahrenheit (15.5 to 21 degrees Celsius) at night, with slightly lower temperatures helping to bring out more blue and purple hues.

Flowering

It takes between eight and nine weeks for Blueberry Muffin to finish flowering.

Name: Blueberry Kush
Description:
Blueberry Kush is a 100% pure Cannabis indica strain (cultivar), and it is a hybrid made by crossing Blueberry and OG Kush strains together. With its considerably high THC content, Blueberry Kush gives its users a relaxing and sedative high.

Initially bred in Oregon, USA, Blueberry Kush has become increasingly popular throughout the United States. This is likely due to the award-winning success and popularity of the parent strains. For example, Blueberry won the 2000 High Times Cannabis Cup for Best Indica. OG Kush is a common and versatile strain found in many hybrids.

Blueberry Kush has sweet, fruity, earthy, and herb flavors due to the three primary terpenes present in the plant. It also has a pleasant aroma of fresh blueberries that reportedly doesn’t cause coughing.

The sticky resin produced by the trichomes causes the white color on the leaves of the Blueberry Kush strain. The buds of the plant can be purple, red, or blue.
Growing:
Blueberry Kush is a high-maintenance plant, so it may be more challenging to grow than other cannabis strains. This is because of its particular feeding schedule and the sensitivity of the plant to its environment. It is recommended for experienced cultivators who have the time to closely monitor the plant and provide it with nitrogen and CalMag fertilizers.

Blueberry Kush can be grown indoors or outdoors, ensuring it gets lots of sunshine and light. If you grow Blueberry Kush indoors, it’s recommended to use a hydroponics setup. This method involves suspending the plant’s roots in a solution of water and nutrients instead of the traditional way of using soil. For picky plants, it allows you to monitor the nutrients you feed them.

In terms of yield, when Blueberry Kush is grown indoors, it produces around 7 ounces (198 grams) of bud per square meter. If you grow it outdoors, you can expect a significantly larger yield of up to 23 ounces (652 grams) of bud per square meter.

Height

Indica-dominant strains are usually short in height. This includes Blueberry Kush, which typically grows to around 40 inches (1.1 meters).
Blueberry Kush grows wide and rather tall. The downside of this is that some parts of the plant might not be able to get air. This can cause mold to grow. To prevent this, trim the plants time to expose more bushy parts of the plant to air.

Humidity and Temperature

Blueberry Kush grows best in a dry, mild climate.
It’s essential to keep the humidity to low levels. If the environment is too moist, the buds can grow mold on them.
The optimal humidity for growing Blueberry Kush depends on the stage of growth that it is in.
Seedling stage: Less than 70% humidity
Vegetative stage: Between 55% and 60% humidity
Flowering stage: Approximately 40% humidity
The optimal temperature for growing Blueberry Kush is between 68 and 80 degrees Fahrenheit (15 and 27 degrees Celsius).

Flowering

Blueberry Kush plants generally take between eight and 10 weeks to flower.
If grown outside, you can expect your Blueberry Kush plant to be ready to harvest between the end of September and November in the Northern hemisphere.

Description:

Blueberry Headband came to be strategically crossbreeding Blueberry, Emerald OG Kush, Cali Sour D, and Pre-98 Bubba Kush. The indica-sativa ratio of this cannabis strain is 50:50, providing well-balanced effects. Its tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) levels are moderate, with levels testing at around 18% on average, while cannabidiol (CBD) levels are practically non-existent at below 0.04%.

Blueberry Headband has a delightful and pungent aroma. Aside from the obvious sweet berry undertones, it also offers hints of pine and citrus. Most will find the fragrance of Blueberry Headband appetizing.

Blueberry Headband’s effects come on quickly and provide an uptick of mental energy and altered perceptions, such as visual distortion and time dilation. The high from the balanced strain is long-lasting, and the relaxation turns into sedation as it wears on. Blueberry Headband may help manage nausea, headaches, and chronic pain.

Blueberry Headband is an easy-to-grow plant resistant to mold, mildew, and common disease. Although it is relatively resilient, it is better suited to those with experience in growing due to its constant pruning requirements. The plants of Blueberry Headband grow to be tall with large buds, bright green leaves, milky trichomes, and bright orange pistils.

It can be grown indoors and outdoors and is considered a super high yielder. Expect indoor yields of 11-15 ounces per square meter and outdoor yields of 35-41 ounces per plant.

The plants will grow tall and have a pungent odor, so it’s unsuitable for those wishing to keep growth discreet.

Height

Blueberry Headband boasts extravagant height and will often grow to 9 feet tall.

Humidity and Temperature

Blueberry Headband thrives in a Mediterranean and humid climate.

Flowering

Blueberry Headband will flower within eight weeks, and outdoor plants should be harvested around the end of September to early October.

Name: Blueberry
Description:
Blueberry, also known as “Berry Blue,” is an indica-dominant strain comprised of 80% indica and 20% sativa created by breeder DJ Short in the 1970s. He began crossbreeding landrace strains that developed in the wild without human interference.  He crossed an Afghani indica with a Highland Thai sativa and Purple Thai sativa, yielding the hybrid strain aptly named for its fresh blueberry fragrance and taste and bright blue hues in its leaves and buds.

It’s also a very potent strain with a THC content of between 16% and 23.5% and a CBD level of around 0.26%. Blueberry is noted for its ability to combat anxiety and stress, facilitate calmness and ease restlessness. Blueberry is an ideal strain for managing chronic pain and insomnia, and some have claimed that Blueberry is arousing as well.

It is one of the most popular strains on the market, and in 2000 Blueberry won the High Times Cannabis Cup in the Best Indica and Best Overall strain categories. It received third place in the Overall category in 2001.
Growing:
Blueberry plants are suitable for beginner growers as they are straightforward to grow and require a shorter flowering time than other strains. Blueberry flourishes outdoors but requires regular pruning to prevent powdery mildew from dominating it.

During the early seedling stage (two to three weeks), Blueberry requires high nitrogen levels. Soil should be prepared with high-grade fertilizer in the greenhouse before the plant is shifted outdoors.

There are a few pruning techniques used to increase yield. “Topping” (cutting the plant’s main stalk) sculpts it into a bush shape. If it grows into this structure, it will put more resources into developing buds and take up less space. Pruning also increases airflow to prevent powdery mildew infection.

Blueberry cannabis has a reputation for producing high yields compared to other strains, attributed to its aforementioned bushy shape. Indoors it can provide 18 ounces of bud per square meter. However, outdoors, you can expect a yield of up to 25 ounces per plant. In addition to nitrogen, silica and iron are minor nutrients that could also help boost the health of your Blueberry plant.

Height

Blueberry needs space to flourish when grown indoors – this fruity strain can reach a height between 20-30 inches. Outdoors it is expected to grow to over 3 feet.

Humidity and Temperature

Blueberry requires a milder climate than other cannabis strains. It thrives at temperatures between 65 and 80 degrees Fahrenheit (18.3 to 26.7 degrees Celsius), though it can handle colder nighttime temperatures without a significant effect on yield.

Flowering

Blueberry begins to flower in about seven to nine weeks. When grown under ideal conditions, buds can be expected in less than two months.

Height

Flowering

Blue Kiss flowers in 8-9 weeks.

Name: Blue Iguana
Description:
Blue Iguana is a strain (cultivar) developed by Mosca Seeds and is the result of a cross between Double Dutch and Old Time Moonshine (OTM). Blue Iguana is an indica-sativa hybrid strain, with some claiming it is a sativa-dominant cultivar. However, the Mosca Seeds website states that Blue Iguana is indica-dominant. Both Double Dutch and OTM are indica-leaning with plenty of sativa influence, so it is not uncommon to see Blue Iguana labeled “sativa.” There is also another version called “Ark Blue Iguana,” which is a different variety of cannabis and is thought to be sativa-dominant. There is little specific information on the sativa and indica percentages of Blue Iguana. Still, it seems to be a relatively balanced hybrid of indica and sativa with a slight tendency towards indica.

Blue Iguana is a THC-dominant variety of cannabis. However, the THC content is considered relatively moderate. CBD, CBC, CBN, CBG, and THCV are present in Blue Iguana in small concentrations. This unique mixture of cannabinoids paired with its moderate THC content could be why Blue Iguana is often reported as having both relaxing and uplifting effects.

Blue Iguana has been described as having relaxing, sleepy, and giggly, talkative effects. Blue Iguana may help manage stress, anxiety, and depression. Blue Iguana has flavors of blueberry, butter, spice, ammonia, musky, skunky, and earthy aromas.
Growing:
Blue Iguana is a hybrid cannabis variety that is considered relatively easy to grow, with its manageable height, quick flowering times, and hybrid vigor. Blue Iguana grows quite well in both indoor and outdoor settings and is quite forgiving of simple mistakes.

Height

Blue Iguana grows at a moderate height of around 5-7 feet indoors and outdoors.

Blue Iguana is like most other cannabis varieties in that it flourishes in warm, Mediterranean climates at approximately 65 degrees Fahrenheit at night and 68-82 degrees Fahrenheit during the day. Relative humidity between 40%-60% during the vegetative period and 40%-50% during the flowering period is ideal.

Its flowering time averages between eight and 10 weeks, and it’s known to grow up to six feet tall. Novice cultivators be warned: The Blue Haze marijuana strain requires a lot of care and attention and may not be beginner-friendly.

Those who use Blue Haze medicinally report that it helps relieve migraines, headaches, stress, anxiety, and chronic pain. Like other indica-dominant hybrids, Blue Haze is often categorized as an evening strain due to its propensity to leave users sleepy and relaxed after consumption.

If grown outdoors, Blue Haze matures and is ready for harvest in early- to mid-October.

The Blue Haze strain reportedly grows between five to six feet.

Flowering

Blue Haze’s flowering time is typically between eight and 10 weeks.

Blue Dream is one of the most popular varieties of cannabis. It is a favorite among novice and veteran cannabis consumers due to its pleasant, sweet berries, sometimes peppery flavor, and manageable effects. This varietal of cannabis could help manage chronic pain, anxiety, and depression.

Due to the popularity of the Blue Dream cannabis strain, there are various versions of it, many built from different varieties of Haze, Blueberry, or some combination of the two. Growing:
Compared to many other tall sativas, Blue Dream is comparatively fast and easy to grow, perhaps partly due to the influence of its indica-leaning Blueberry genetics. Blue Dream is also sensitive to small changes in climate and is thought to be best grown indoors. However, as a sativa-leaning variety of cannabis, it can grow quite tall, so some people in subtropical or Mediterranean climates may prefer to plant it outdoors.

Blue Dream also seems to like nutrients, especially nitrogen. The ideal pH for soil is between 6.0 and 7.0 or 5.5 and 6.5 for hydroponic growth. Blue Dream thrives in a “sea of green” (SoG) setup, so it is wise to find a good mother, take cuttings, and plant clones. Expect yields of 15 and 22 ounces per square meter if grown correctly.

Height

Blue Dream can grow to between 4 and 6 feet tall.

Humidity and Temperature

The following refers to indoor grow rooms, where temperature and humidity can be controlled.

Seedling stage: 72-78 degrees Fahrenheit (22-25.5 degrees Celsius); humidity range = 30%-50%
Vegetative stage: similar temperature to above, but increase humidity to about 55%
Flowering stage: ideal temperature is 80-85 degrees Fahrenheit (26.6-29.4 degrees Celsius); humidity should be between 30-40%. Using a dehumidifier can decrease humidity levels gradually between the vegetative and flowering stages.

Flowering

Blue Dream takes 8-9 weeks to finish flowering. If growing outdoors in the Northern hemisphere, expect Blue Dream to be ready to harvest by mid-September to mid-October. In the Southern hemisphere, expect to harvest around February or March.

Name: Blue Dragon Desert Frost
Description:
Blue Dragon Desert Frost (BDDF) from Yerba Buena is a balanced hybrid marijuana strain that crosses the Desert Frost and Blue Dragon strains. A two-time winner at the Cultivation Classic, Blue Dragon Desert Frost is an incredible flower built for therapeutic purposes. It has exceptionally low to moderate THC levels from 1% to 18%, with a high CBD content of 9% to 20%.

The Blue Dragon Desert Frost strain has an earthy, fruity scent with strong blueberry notes and flavors. The leafy plant has heavy, spade-shaped forest green buds with thin orange hairs, finished with a coating of blue-tinted crystal trichomes.

Most people use the Blue Dragon Desert Frost cannabis strain for medicinal purposes due to its largely non-intoxicating effects and high CBD content. Patients report the strain relieves chronic pain, anxiety, and depression and works well any day. On some occasions, Blue Dragon Desert Frost strains can also contain higher THC levels. In these cases, users report cerebral effects that enhance focus and creativity.
Growing:
Resources indicate Blue Dragon Desert Frost strain is suitable for indoor and outdoor growth. It has a relatively short flowering time of around eight to nine weeks and produces high yields. It is a resilient strain resistant to pests and mold, making it a good choice for beginner growers.

Height

The Blue Dragon Desert Frost strain reportedly grows between 30-60 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

The Blue Dragon Desert Frost strain thrives in warm and temperate climates. For indoor grows, cultivators have reported that seedlings and clones prefer temperatures of 70-80 degrees Fahrenheit with the lights on and high humidity levels of 65-70% during the vegetative stage, lowering to around 40% during the flowering stage.

Flowering

Flowering time for this high CBD cannabis plant is typically 53 to 61 days.

Growers report the Blue Dragon Desert Frost strain produces an average indoor yield of one to two ounces per square foot indoors, while outdoor plants can grow 10-15 ounces per plant.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for depressionOne survey found that 70% of cannabis users who consumed CBD felt depression relief. Research validates this claim, suggesting that CBD may activate serotonin receptors to deliver mood-boosing and anti-anxiety benefits. The Blue Dragon Desert Frost strain, with its high CBD content, fits this therapeutic profile.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for chronic painBDDF’s high CBD content and minimal-to-moderate THC levels make this strain a top choice for patients needing relief. Research shows CBD reduces pain by acting in various receptors throughout the body. For example, one study shows CBD binds TRPV1 receptors to mitigate pain perception and reduce inflammation. Other research suggests CBD interacts with spinal cord receptors to quell chronic inflammatory pain.

Name: Blue Diesel
Description:
Blue Diesel, also known as Blue City Diesel, is a hybrid of the cannabis strains Blueberry Diesel and NYC Diesel.

A slightly indica-dominant strain with 60:40 hybridization, Blue Diesel combines feelings of relaxation and euphoria while providing a refreshing experience and an intense aroma. It also contains a high THC level making up 16%-23% of the cannabinoids present and has very little CBD. Blue Diesel treats nausea, anxiety, chronic pain, and insomnia.
Growing:
Blue Diesel is an excellent choice for a beginner, as it is a forgiving strain and isn’t heavily impacted by minor temperature, humidity, and water differences. However, it will respond poorly to sudden negative conditions. Even when optimal growing conditions aren’t met, the strain can produce a good crop with high yields.

Blue Diesel grows well inside and outside, though it usually provides a better yield in outside conditions. Although the plant prefers dry, sunny climates such as those found in California or the Mediterranean, it also has some resistance to mold and mildew. It can be grown in slightly more humid conditions if careful.

Height

Blue Diesel is a medium to tall plant and may benefit from topping (removal of the upper portion of the plant) at five to seven weeks, especially when grown indoors. Plants usually grow to between 4 and 6 feet in height, depending on growing conditions and whether or not the plant is topped, and plants tend to grow taller in outside conditions.

Humidity and Temperature

Although Blue Diesel is somewhat resistant to the damp, low humidity helps prevent the growth of mold and mildew. The strain prefers dry, hot climates such as those found on the middle to lower West Coast of the U.S.

Flowering

Flowering occurs at around 55-60 days, or in late September to early October, in the northern hemisphere. Blue Diesel is an exceptionally high producing strain when grown in good conditions, producing up to 1.8 ounces per square foot and 21 ounces per plant outdoors.

Name: Blue Cookies
Description:
Blue Cookies is an indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain that contains 90% Cannabis indica and 10% Cannabis sativa genetics. It’s made by crossing the Blueberry and GSC strains. The Blue Cookies strain has sweet, berry, earthy, cherry, and candy flavors and aromas. However, when you break or burn the flowers, it develops a leathery smell. This cultivar’s relaxing, euphoric effects may make it helpful in managing chronic pain and insomnia.

Blue Cookies is a colorful strain with blue, purple, and green hues. The buds are large and chunky, and the leaves appear clumped in long conical shapes. These flowers are surrounded by bright red and orange pistils. Blue Cookies also have a thick layer of frosty trichomes due to the high resin content.

The history of Blue Cookies isn’t clear. It’s believed to have been created in Washington, but the original breeders haven’t been identified.

As an aside, a second Blue Cookies strain exists, just a different version of the GSC strain. The information provided in this article relates to the GSC x Blueberry hybrid strain.
Growing:
Blue Cookies seeds can be hard to find. To make clones, growers should use cuttings from mature parts of the strain.

Blue Cookies can be grown indoors and outdoors. Growing cannabis indoors or in a greenhouse allows the grower to control the environment and provide plants with optimal growing conditions.

Growing Blue Cookies is not recommended for beginner cultivators, and these plants require attention and regular maintenance. For example, you should regularly prune and trim the leaves so light and air can reach the lower parts of the plant.

The Blue Cookies flowers are heavy and dense, which can weigh down and potentially damage the plant, so you may need to ensure that the plant is physically supported.

The average yield of Blue Cookies is similar to other cannabis strains. Blue Cookies usually yield 12 to 16 ounces of bud per square meter when grown indoors, and you can expect to get at least 16 ounces of bud per square meter when grown outdoors.

Height

Like other indica varieties, the Blue Cookies strain is short to medium in height. You can expect it to grow between 3 and 5 feet (0.9 and 1.5 meters).

Humidity and Temperature

Like most other cannabis strains, some humidity is helpful when growing Blue Cookies.

The Blue Cookies strain grows well in moderate to warm climates. Optimal temperatures are between 70 and 74 degrees Fahrenheit (21 to 23 degrees Celsius). To enable the flowers’ bright purple and blue hues to develop, you should “shock” Blue Cookies with cooler temperatures at night when the plant is close to flowering.

Flowering

Blue Cookies plants generally flower in nine to 10 weeks, which is relatively fast. If you grow Blue Cookies outdoors, you can expect to harvest in late September in the Northern Hemisphere.

Name: Blue Cheese
Description:
This indica-heavy hybrid is known for its rich, earthy aroma. While named after a famously pungent cheese, most users report tasting blueberries or strawberries mixed with earth and herbs.

With 80% indica, a CBG content of up to 2%, and a mid-range 18%-20% THC, this strain (cultivar) is great for stress relief, helping anxiety and depression while aiding symptoms of conditions like ADHD and manic depressive disorder (bipolar). CBD

The high can take some time to kick in but has strong effects. A THC level of 18%-20% means the slow-to-come high will last for hours.
Growing:
Blue Cheese is an easy strain to grow, and many beginner growers have success with their Blue Cheese harvest. This hardy plant will survive small growing mishaps and enjoys a mild climate.

Blue Cheese will grow indoors and out and is resistant to mold. Just note: Blue Cheese prefers a slightly cooler growing environment, unlike some of the other strains from this family. Blue Cheese enjoys nitrogen and minor nutrients like calcium, magnesium, and silica but keeps nutrient levels slightly lower during the vegetative stage.

Height

Indoor plants grow to around 5 feet and yield up to 550 grams per square meter. Outdoor plants will grow up to 7 feet and produce slightly less, between 500-550 grams per plant.

Humidity and Temperature

Indica-dominant hybrids prefer drier climates, and blue Cheese enjoys a lower-humidity environment. The ideal humidity range is around 65% for Blue Cheese plants during the vegetative stage.

The levels can be adjusted throughout the growing stages. At the vegetative stage, keep humidity to 60%, and aim to decrease this level incrementally each week before flowering. At the start of flowering, aim for the humidity level to be below 50%, dropping to 30%-40% as flowering enters its second or third week. This plant can handle low humidity.

Flowering

Flowering occurs around seven to eight weeks, and it is usually ready to harvest at the end of September for growers in the northern hemisphere.
Also, note that Blue Cheese may stretch when flowering, potentially tripling in height. Note that an outdoor plant can reach 10 feet in height during the flowering stage.

Name: Bloodwalker
Description:
Bloodwalker is an indica-dominant strain (cultivar) that crosses Mazar with Blueberry (formerly Skywalker) and Cherry Pie. Los Angeles Kush developed this uplifting yet relaxing strain with a sweet cherry taste.

The strain is also known for its deliciously spicy and sweet diesel aroma. Cannabis smokers can expect a light, spicy, earthy exhale.

High THC concentrations make Bloodwalker a good choice for relieving chronic pain, including muscle spasms. People also praise Bloodwalker for its euphoric effects and help in managing depression.
Growing:
The Bloodwalker cannabis plant produces bright orange-purple buds that resemble dried blood. Little information exists about cultivating Bloodwalker, but the strain is available in Bloodwalker cartridges 510 threads, a concentrated version of Bloodwalker available in vape form.

Height

Up to 90 inches outdoors; up to 80 inches indoors

Humidity and Temperature

Semi-humid; warm

Flowering

56 to 63 days

Name: Bloodhound
Description:
Created by RedEyed Genetics, Bloodhound crosses Huckleberry Hound and Guard Dawg. This genetic coupling has created an obscure cross with potent THC levels.

Bloodhound has a complex aroma and flavor profile. Expect an earthy aroma with surprising notes of sage mixed with tart fruit and even a touch of chocolate fondue.

This well-balanced indica-dominant hybrid strain (cultivar) clocks in at 60% indica and 40% sativa. Cannabinoid levels are not as balanced, with up to 25% THC and almost non-existent CBD. People use Bloodhound to treat various conditions, including appetite loss, stress, and social anxiety.
Growing:
Bloodhound has popcorn-shaped dark olive green nugs with thin, light amber hairs. The Bloodhound plant fares best outdoors and can withstand harsh elements, including colder temperatures. But, Bloodhound also does well in indoor setups. Growers will need a pair of pruning shears, as this cultivar tends to grow full and bushy.

Height

30 to 60 inches

Humidity and Temperature

Semi-dry; cool climate with daytime temperatures averaging 65 degrees Fahrenheit

Name: Blood Orange Kush
Description:
Blood Orange Kush is a rare and mysterious indica-dominant cannabis strain (cultivar) with a parentage that is not fully known. Made by crossing Aota with Pinecracker and an unknown OG strain, Blood Orange Kush features moderate THC levels, low CBD, and a bright citrus-forward flavor profile.

Blood Orange Kush has been described as a citrus orchard, as some users praise the strain’s fresh orange, and sometimes tart citrus, flavor profile. Citrus aromas are also potent in Blood Orange Kush, which has earthy and diesel undertones.

Some cannabis users turn to Blood Orange Kush for help with chronic pain and depression. THC levels topping out at 15% may be helpful as a supplemental pain management treatment.
Growing:
Blood Orange Kush plants are quick flowering plants with dense trichome-covered nugs. The strain may be cultivated indoors or outdoors but is unavailable in the form of feminized seeds, as the developer, Exclusive Seeds, has kept them under wraps.

Height

Three to four feet.

Humidity and Temperature

Semi-humid; 70 degrees Fahrenheit.

Flowering

Eight to 10 weeks.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersWith users lauding its near-instant effects, Blood Orange Kush may help individuals looking for rapid relief from anxiety. The strain’s purported giggly and euphoric properties may provide mental uplift, while its relaxing qualities can help to ease the physical effects of mental tension.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for chronic painBlood Orange Kush may help some people combat chronic pain. THC levels of up to 15% help reduce muscle soreness, joint stiffness from arthritis, and other types of chronic pain.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular

Cannabis for depressionDepression symptoms may be relieved temporarily when using Blood Orange Kush weed. The strain’s euphoric and giddy effects help some feel uplifted and energized.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System

Name: Blood Orange
Description:
Blood Orange is a sativa-dominant hybrid weed strain (cultivar) that crosses Cali Orange with Appalachia. Known for its vivid flavor of zesty citrus fruits paired with its citrus-forward and spicy aromas, Blood Orange is an energizing strain at 70% sativa and 30% indica lineage.

A strong body buzz and appetite stimulation are two of the most common effects of Blood Orange weed. Blood Orange can credit its appetite-boosting and psychoactive effects to a high THC content (up to 25%) and comparatively low levels of CBD (less than 1%).
Growing:
Blood Orange is easy to grow for both indoor and outdoor cultivators. Originally bred by Bodhi Seeds, Blood Orange seeds are challenging to find. But if you can grow this strain at home, you’ll note the plant’s deep orange-haired nugs and large, creamy, white trichomes.

30 to 60 inches

Humid; warm, and sunny (70 degrees Fahrenheit)

Name: Bloo’s Kloos
Description:
Bloo’s Kloos is a rare pure indica cannabis strain (cultivar) first bred by Mr. Mack of Las Vegas. This playful Indica is a three-way Larry OG, Blueberry, and Northern Lights cross. However, there is some controversy about this strain’s indica lineage, as some people claim the strain is indica-dominant but not 100% indica. The rarity of Bloo’s Kloos makes it difficult to confirm or refute these claims.

Citrus and berry flavors characterize Bloo’s Kloos, with some users saying the strain tastes like a fruit pie. Other users note undertones of spice and earth in Bloo’s Kloos aroma and taste profile.

THC levels are moderate at around 15%, while CBD levels are low. People with chronic pain and depression may find relief from using Bloo’s Kloos. Insomnia is one other condition that this powerful indica strain may help treat.
Growing:
The Bloo’s Kloos plant features deep olive green buds with orange hairs and amber trichomes. The strain is known for achieving a greater maximum yield outdoors but may also be cultivated indoors.

Height

30 to 60 inches

Humidity and Temperature

Low humidity and cool temperatures of 65 to 75 degrees Fahrenheit.

Flowering

49 to 63 days
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for chronic painBloo’s Kloos boasts anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties thanks to its pain-relieving combination of THC and CBD. User reviews claim that the strain is particularly effective in easing cramps, nerve, and muscular pain.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for depressionMany users report laughter as a positive side effect of Bloo’s Kloos. This strain’s cheerful feelings may help some people temporarily relieve their depression symptoms. The CBD content of Bloo’s Kloos may also help lower anxiety levels that often correspond to depression.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for insomniaIndica strains are known for helping people with insomnia, and Bloo’s Kloos may be especially effective with its medium THC content accompanied by just enough CBD to prevent the energizing and almost psychedelic effects associated with some high-THC varieties of cannabis.

Name: Blob OG
Description:
Blob OG is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain (cultivar) with a 70% sativa and 30% indica profile. Grown by crossing Sour Diesel and Pre-99 Chemdawg genetics, this hybrid from Western Washington registers high THC levels ranging from 24 to 30%.

Blob OG’s top terpenes, limonene, myrcene, and beta-caryophyllene produce a citric sweetness and a piny, nutty aroma. Its cannabinoids synergize with these aromatic compounds to deliver a light body high combined with an intense, energizing cerebral experience.

Blob OG fans describe feeling euphoric and highly chatty after smoking this heavy-hitting hybrid. Others describe its potent effects as useful for medical conditions such as depression, stress, and headaches.
Growing:
Blob OG is a tropical strain that loves to be outdoors and under the sun all day. Outdoor growers in the northern hemisphere may need help to maintain the same light this strain likes to receive, creating a later flowering time. As a result, growers might prefer cultivating this plant indoors, where they can mimic a Mediterranean climate, breeze, and air temperature. Experienced OG farmers say this strain rises tall and is moderately difficult to grow.

Height

Sativa-dominant hybrid strains typically mimic sativa properties, making them taller and thinner. At full height, sativas like Blob OG can grow five to eighteen feet or more.

Humidity and Temperature

Ideal Blob OG growing conditions depend on whether the setup is indoors or outdoors. In either case, growers should maintain temperatures and humidity similar to the warm, Mediterranean climate. Providing even light distribution and blowing a fan over the top of the plant are essential strategies for success.

Flowering

Flowering time for Blob OG depends on its growing conditions. Typically growers can successfully extract buds from Blob OG plants within ten to twelve weeks in an indoor setting. For outdoor operations, a cycle from seed to harvest lasts around six months.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for loss of appetiteResearch indicates that THC can promote the release of the hunger-stimulating hormone called ghrelin. Since Blob OG has a high percentage of THC, this could help people experiencing nausea and loss of appetite.
Organ SystemsOther,Endocrine
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for inflammationTHC can reduce and inhibit inflammation by reducing immune signaling proteins, allowing for inflammatory responses to slow down around the cells. This action may be why Blob OG users have reported decreased pain associated with inflammatory headaches and stress.
