medical_application_3:
Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersBlob OG’s sativa dominance and uplifting terpene profile reportedly create a pleasant buzz that washes away daily stresses. According to users, its dopamine-boosting euphoria temporarily improves mood and diminishes angst.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System

Name: Blizzard Bush
Description:
Blizzard Bush is a resinous hybrid cross of Pura Vida and Stardawg genetics created by Greenpoint Seeds. It is a rare, evenly balanced hybrid strain (cultivar) with a 50% indica and 50% sativa profile, offering consumers the best of both worlds. THC levels average a moderate 15%, while CBD content rarely tops 1%. This evenly balanced hybrid also contains minor cannabinoids CBC, CBG, CBN, and THCV, known for enhancing pleasure and motivation.

Not to be confused with Activision Blizzard, the gaming company, the aptly named Blizzard Bush strain has fluffy buds covered in thick resin trichomes with a shimmering effect of a snowstorm. Fans of this blizzardy cultivar can expect top notes of creamy marshmallow aromas mixed with octane fuel, pepper, and cured meats. The final exhale has a sweet candy flavor, like roasted marshmallows on the tongue.

Users enjoy Blizzard Bush’s mood elevation and blissful relaxation that doesn’t weigh them down. Thanks to its long-lasting effects and moderate THC levels, Blizzard Bush is a great strain to treat medical conditions such as mood swings, anxiety, depression, chronic stress, and chronic fatigue.
Growing:
Greenpoint Seeds discontinued selling Blizzard Bush cannabis seeds. However, seedlings or clones could be available online. Cultivators who can source this snowy variety will find it moderately challenging to grow.

Blizzard Bush can thrive indoors or outdoors, but outdoor yields tend to be higher. An average coating of buds should appear within 8-10 weeks, with large resin glands that glisten in the light. Blizzard Bush plants can grow rather tall, so indoor operators should allow plenty of space.

Height

Blizzard Bush is a balanced combination of Pura Vida and Stardawg that usually reaches a medium-tall height of 60-80 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

The Blizzard Bush strain appreciates sunshine and a semi-humid climate. Most cannabis requires about 40% air humidity during the flowering stage in mild, temperate conditions of no more than 75 degrees. Lower temperature and humidity levels are best for one to two weeks before harvest.

Flowering

The Blizzard Bush strain reaches full maturity in nine to 10 weeks. Mature plants have thickly coated buds that practically glow.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for depressionThe Blizzard Bush strain elevates mood, provides energy, and increases hunger. As a result, this strain may be used to treat symptoms of depression, such as sadness, fatigue, mood swings, and lack of appetite. THC notably acts as a temporary antidepressant for some people by stimulating the brain’s reward system to produce more dopamine, the body’s natural feel-good drug.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersBlizzard Bush marijuana induces a talkative, uplifting, and creative feeling, which can relieve stress and anxiety throughout the day. Linalool is a primary terpene in the strain’s profile, which, studies show, has stress-reducing effects.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS)/myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME)Marijuana is well known for its sedative properties. Still, recent studies confirm that smoking cannabis flower can also combat excessive fatigue in patients with cancer, Parkinson’s Disease, and multiple sclerosis. Blizzard Bush’s moderate THC content and initial burst of energy may be why some report its anti-fatigue effects.
Organ SystemsOther,Skeletal,Muscular
medical_application_4:
Cannabis for insomniaAs Blizzard Bush’s energizing effects wear off, its calming terpenes, linalool, and myrcene help send viscerally calming vibrations through the body. Blizzard Bush’s gentle sedation and anxiety-relieving properties can promote deeper, more restful sleep for some people with insomnia.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional,Brain & Nervous System

Name: Blissful Wizard
Description:
Blissful Wizard by The Captain’s Connection is a 50% indica, 50% sativa hybrid strain (cultivar) that crosses Captain’s Cookies with GSC. With high THC levels of up to 34%, it is one of the most potent hybrids on the market. Its powerful effects crowned the Blissful Wizard strain the best non-solvent hash at the 2015 SoCal Cannabis Cup. CBD content is often below 1%, and minor cannabinoids present include CBC, CBG, CBN, and THCV.

The Blissful Wizard strain has green buds coated in fiery orange hairs and off-white trichomes. It smells like key-lime pie, granny smith apples, and dirt with flavors of citrus cream, sweet apples, and earthy flowers.

This potent hybrid strain has a blissful euphoric onset that leaves cannabis enthusiasts feeling happy and energized. Its high THC content also treats pain, muscle spasms, nausea, and appetite loss.
Growing:
Blissful Wizard can grow well indoors or outdoors with moderate yields. However, experts say it’s tricky to master. This strain is photoperiodic, meaning it only flowers when exposed to specific wavelengths of light. When it does flower, Blissful Wizard buds are medium-sized, pear-shaped, and green with bright orange hairs and glistening trichomes.

Height

Blissful Wizard commonly reaches heights of 30-60 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

The Blissful Wizard strain prefers a warm climate. Most flowering cannabis plants like 40% humidity during the flowering stage and temperate conditions of no more than 75 degrees. One to two weeks before harvest, cannabis prefers slightly lower temperature and humidity levels.

Flowering

Blissful Wizard flowers 8-10 weeks after germination. Growers can begin harvest at about 64 days.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for acute pain or post-surgery painMedical cannabis patients will love Blissful Wizard for its potent pain-relieving abilities. The full spectrum of cannabinoids in the Blissful Wizard strain, including THC, CBD, and CBG, all act on receptors in the body to fight inflammation and relieve related issues, such as chronic pain and muscle spasms.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersBlissful Wizard is a great strain to feel uplifted and relieve stress. The intense body high can melt preoccupations and concerns, making it helpful for stress-related conditions like anxiety and PTSD. However, due to the high THC, dose Blissful Wizard slowly and carefully to prevent an adverse reaction.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for loss of appetiteBlissful Wizard strain’s extraordinarily high THC content will increase appetite and help reduce nausea. This effect can benefit those struggling with appetite loss due to gastrointestinal issues or medical treatments like chemotherapy.
Organ SystemsOther,Endocrine
medical_application_4:
Cannabis for depressionTwo of Blissful Wizard’s most notable effects — happiness and motivation — make it an excellent choice for those struggling with depression. Its high THC levels stimulate the brain’s reward system to produce more dopamine, while its indica-to-sativa ratio makes users feel more talkative and social.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_5:
Cannabis for arthritisStudies show its higher beta-caryophyllene and myrcene content also helps with joint pain and arthritis.
Organ SystemsMuscular

Name: Bleugenius
Description:
Bleugenius is a well-balanced, high CBD strain believed to be a member of the Blueberry family. Cultivated as hemp flower or marijuana, Bleugenius (by Eugenius) contains up to 19% THC and CBD levels ranging from 8% to 15%.

This bud combines mild citrus with a floral berry aroma that transforms into freshly ripened blueberries with a grassy taste upon smoking. Bleugenius flowers reportedly have spade-shaped green nugs with thin orange hairs and crystal resin trichomes. Some reports say Bleugenius flowers also contain dark purple hues.

The high from Bleugenius marijuana is equally bright, with upbeat and joyful effects designed to give feelings of unadulterated joy and pleasure. This high CBD strain is commonly used for medicinal purposes to treat headaches, chronic pain, and even migraines.
Growing:
Bleugenius can be grown indoors, although growers report that this strain prefers the outdoors. Experienced cultivators say this strain is moderately challenging to harvest. Bleugenius leaves should be unfurled and fully stretched out when ready for harvest.

Height

Bleugenius will grow to an average height of around 30-60 inches indoors. Outdoor varieties should sprout up from 60 inches to 80 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

Some growers report this strain prefers a more warm and dry climate, although the exact humidity and temperature requirements are unknown.

Flowering

This strain should flower between days 42-56 and be ready for harvest around day 60.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for inflammationTHC and CBD are both powerful anti-inflammatory agents. THC can block inflammation by lowering immunological signaling proteins, while CBD reduces pro-inflammatory cytokines (proteins) levels. Together, CBD and THC can target the inflammatory causes of disease, reduce symptoms, and ease pain.
Organ SystemsImmune System,Other
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for headache and migraineResearch shows THC may relieve pain by binding with receptors on peripheral nerves to block pain sensations. Other theories indicate that THC can alleviate pain by boosting dopamine levels and reducing pain perception. CBD research also suggests this compound alone may help to treat migraines, making a strain like Bleugenius an optimal choice.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersA recent study found that strains with lower THC levels and higher CBD content are the most effective at treating anxiety. As a CBD-dominant flower, Bleugenius is famous for relieving the constant worry and mind-wandering that many anxious people experience.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System

Name: Blaze
Description:
Blaze is a 100% sativa strain (cultivar) created from a cross of Haze and Blueberry genetics. Developed by BC Seed company, Blaze is one of the most potent sativas with an average THC level of 20% and a CBD level of less than 1%.

This energy-inducing strain hits hard and fast with a pungent diesel-grape scent combined with herbal and spicy aromas. Blaze’s flavors are no different, with users reporting strong fruity overtones and finishing notes of spice, herbs, and grape.

Blaze fans call it a popular choice for a cerebral high, mental clarity, and increased focus. This uplifting strain is also reportedly effective for stress, aches, pain, and depression.
Growing:
The blaze strain is excellent for less experienced growers who want to take on a doable cultivation challenge. Blaze can be grown indoors and outdoors with comparable yields. As a low-maintenance strain, Blaze only requires basic topping and pruning to produce this dense and aromatic variety.

Height

Blaze grows to between 30” and 60” tall indoors and out.

Humidity and Temperature

Specific humidity and temperature information are not readily available for the Blaze strain. However, some resources indicate that Blaze enjoys a humid, Mediterranean-like climate.

Flowering

British Columbia Seed Company crafted the Blaze strain to reduce the flowering time compared to its parental genetics. Succeeding in this pursuit, Blaze flowers within 52-61 days and is ready for harvest around day 68.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for headache and migraineTHC’s analgesic properties make all potent strains effective painkillers. THC’s dopamine-boosting action also helps take people’s minds off discomfort, changing their relationship to pain. As a result, Blaze’s high THC levels and anti-inflammatory properties reportedly soothe headaches and migraines, among other sources of pain.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersUsers report that Blaze’s euphoric head buzz quickly pushes away negative thoughts and boosts overall mood, allowing worries to melt. Because of this, Blaze can relieve mental health struggles for anxiety, depression, and people with PTSD.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for insomniaBlaze users typically experience a wave of relaxation after the powerful mind-high wears off. These sedative effects cause a lingering body high that reportedly leads to better sleep quality and quantity.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional,Brain & Nervous System
medical_application_4:
Cannabis for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)PTSD is one reason why many patients seek medical cannabis due to its ability to relieve stress and insomnia.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional

Name: Blanco Berry Kush
Description:
Blanco Berry Kush combines two in-house strains (cultivars) produced by Gage Green Group: White Kush and Blackberry Pie. This genetic crossover creates an evenly balanced hybrid strain (cultivar), with THC levels around 19% and CBD around 1%.

Blanco Berry Kush demands to be seen, with a dense coating of crystal white frost around its stark white trichomes, deep olive-green leaves, and thin orange hairs spread across its appendages. Its aroma and flavors mimic spiced coffee, earthiness, and herbs combined with blackberry notes.

Therapeutically, Blanco Berry Kush can reportedly help treat anxiety symptoms, boost appetite, relieve pain, and support more restful sleep.
Growing:
Blanco Berry Kush growing information is limited.

Some cultivators claim this hybrid grows well outdoors or indoors. However, the plant seems to have a higher yield outside. Amateurs may want to avoid Blanco Berry Kush until they gain cultivation experience. Precise pruning is critical as it grows denser toward the top.

Height

Blanco Berry Kush can reportedly grow over 90” outdoors. Indoors, the plant may reach heights between 60-80” depending on growth conditions.

Humidity and Temperature

Gage Green Group has yet to publish specific humidity and temperature guidelines for Blanco Berry Kush. However, if its parent strains, White Kush and Blackberry Pie, are any indication, this hybrid may enjoy a warmer and more humid growth period.

Flowering

Growers report a range of flowering times for Blanco Berry Kush. However, most people say this hybrid flowers within 60-75 days and is ready for harvest around the 80-day mark.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for chronic painBlanco Berry Kush, like all cannabis strains, exhibits anti-inflammatory properties that target the cause of pain from inflammatory injuries and diseases. THC is a known analgesic (pain-killer) that can block pain sensations while boosting dopamine levels to make pain feel less severe.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for insomniaAfter the head buzz has worn off, Blanco Berry Kush lingers with a strong sedative body high, allowing one to slip away into a deep sleep. High THC levels support this hybrid strain’s relaxing properties, increasing total sleep time and preventing people from periodically waking up throughout the night.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional,Brain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersBlanco Berry Kush actively reduces stress and anxiety by offering a balanced buzz that clears the mind and enhances euphoria. Rarely, however, this hybrid cultivar can also aggravate anxiety when used in high doses, so it’s important to partake in low-to-moderate doses.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_4:
Cannabis for loss of appetiteTHC has long been known to stimulate the appetite, causing the phenomenon aptly called “the munchies.” Research indicates this may be because THC interacts with receptors in the hypothalamus to boost the hunger-stimulating hormone ghrelin. THC’s dopamine-boosting properties can also make food simply more enjoyable to eat.
Organ SystemsOther,Endocrine

Name: Blackwater
Description:
Blackwater, aka Blackwater OG, is an indica-dominant hybrid marijuana strain (cultivar) from Cali Connection made by crossing Mendo Purps (also called Mendocino Purp and Mendocino Purple) with San Fernando Valley OG Kush (also SFV OG Kush or OG Kush). Blackwater’s THC content is a potent 20%, while CBD levels rarely exceed 1%.

Blackwater has chunky buds and densely packed leaves when properly cured. Its high resin production creates these large solid nugs, contributing to the strain’s top-shelf “bag appeal.” The flowers appear dark green with purple accents, emitting a sweet grape aroma to complement the hue inherited from Mendocino Purple. Blackwater users enjoy a sweet yet woody flavor with undertones of pine and lemon.

This strain’s heavy indica high is award-winning, receiving Third Best Indica in the 2014 Cannabis Cup in Los Angeles. Fans say Blackwater OG starts mellow but eventually melts down through the body for a euphoric high and sense of calm from head to toe. Its intense sedative effects make the Blackwater strain effective in numerous medical applications, such as stress, anxiety, pain, appetite loss, and multiple sclerosis.
Growing:
The Blackwater strain performs well in indoor, outdoor, or greenhouse growing scenarios. However, this strain requires specific needs to flourish, making it moderately difficult to grow. Outdoor cultivation requires a warm and semi-humid climate, with daytime temperatures around 75 degrees Fahrenheit.

This strain produces generous yields, especially in a sheltered yet well-lit outdoor environment. Growers should expect Blackwater’s chunky buds and bushy leaves.

Height

Blackwater OG commonly reaches heights of 30-60 inches depending on its genetics and sativa-indica ratio.

Humidity and Temperature

The Blackwater strain prefers daytime temperatures of up to 75 degrees and direct sunlight throughout the day.

Growers who live in cold climates should cultivate this strain indoors.

Flowering

Blackwater takes about 8-10 weeks to flower. Outdoors, this strain is ready to harvest around late September to early October when grown in a warm, dry space.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for chronic painBlackwater’s physical numbing makes it an effective painkiller for those dealing with aches, whether from exercise, injury, or chronic conditions like fibromyalgia. The Blackwater strain’s complete cannabinoid profile, including THC, CBD, and CBG, all act on receptors in the body to fight inflammation, contributing to its pain-relieving properties.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for insomniaBlackwater OG is one of the few “night-time-only” strains due to its narcotic, sleep-inducing effects, with a couch-lock quality. This intense sedation can assist those struggling with insomnia and other sleep issues.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional,Brain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for multiple sclerosis (MS)Blackwater fans say the strain significantly eases muscle spasms, muscle tension, and spasticity. The research aligns with these reports, showing that THC and marijuana generally relieve spasms in people with MS by targeting the inflammatory cause of the condition.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_4:
Cannabis for loss of appetiteBlackwater increases appetite, similar to all THC-dominant cultivars. Research indicates THC’s appetite-boosting qualities may come from its ability to stimulate the hunger hormone, “ghrelin,” in the body. This effect can benefit those struggling with nausea and appetite loss, like people undergoing chemotherapy.
Organ SystemsOther,Endocrine
medical_application_5:
Cannabis for depressionBlackwater OG’s full spectrum of compounds, notably THC, acts as a temporary antidepressant by stimulating the brain’s reward system to produce more dopamine. Users report feeling happy and euphoric, helping them cope with mental and psychological conditions, including depression, stress disorders, and anxiety.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System

Name: Blackberry Trainwreck
Description:
Blackberry Trainwreck, sometimes styled Blackberry Wreck, is a cultivar of unconfirmed origins, thought to be a combination of Blackberry Kush and Trainwreck. The strain (cultivar) features 50/50 indica to sativa characteristics, with moderate THC levels testing around 20% with hardly any CBD.

The hybrid strain produces densely packed, popcorn-like buds that exude an aroma of fresh berries, musk, and wet soil. Users report the strain features similarly earthy, sweet flavors, with a blend of berry sweetness present on each exhale.

Blackberry Trainwreck yields a balanced, relaxed high that elevates moods into positivity, encourages creativity, and places users in zen tranquility. As the effects continue, a more physical stone weighs the limbs into a state of relaxation, perfect for use before bedtime.
Growing:
Due to the mysterious origins of the strain, there needs to be more information available about Blackberry Trainwreck’s growing needs. It will likely do well in indoor and outdoor settings as a hybrid cultivar, though this depends on the grower’s skill and adequate protection from molds, mildews, and pests.

Blackberry Trainwreck produces a rainbow of fall-colored leaves as it grows, with everything from dark maroon to lime green. Indoor growers with limited space can use Sea of Green, topping, or other methods to manage the plant’s heights while encouraging higher yields.

Height

While exact heights are unknown, Blackberry Trainwreck produces thick-stalked, medium-sized plants with moderate branching.

Humidity and Temperature

Blackberry Trainwreck’s parent strains are resilient to higher moisture levels and cold, so growers can assume a similar ability to thrive in different weather conditions.

Flowering

Blackberry Trainwreck flowers in 8-10 weeks indoors and reaches maturity in late October outdoors.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for insomniaBlackberry Trainwreck can help users drift off into an easy and lasting slumber thanks to its gentle blanket of relaxation.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional,Brain & Nervous System
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for depressionUsers select Blackberry Trainwreck to temporarily manage symptoms of depression or anxiety and negative thought loops associated with PTSD.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for headache and migraineBlackberry Trainwreck is a helpful strain with some analgesic properties, able to soothe headaches and the tension of various muscles in the temples and throughout the body.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System

Name: Blackberry Rhino
Description:
Blackberry Rhino, also known as Blackberry White, is a combination of Blackberry and White Rhino, first created by mysterious breeders. Tests show this strain features a blend of 50/50 indica to sativa characteristics and averages around 15% THC with little CBD content.

Those who’ve encountered Blackberry Rhino in dispensaries describe the flowers as sporting forest green coloring, purple highlights, and a blanket of resinous trichomes. The buds exude a floral aroma with mild hints of skunk and earth. Blackberry Rhino’s smoke reportedly tastes berry-like, featuring floral notes on each exhale.

Individuals report that Blackberry Rhino produces relatively mild effects, offering relief from symptoms of pain, stress, and other ailments with a gentle body buzz and peaceful, euphoric mental state.
Growing:
Blackberry Rhino is a user-friendly cultivar that thrives even when raised by novice cultivators. The plant produces forest-green buds with purple highlights and a blanket of sticky trichomes. The strain is resilient to most diseases and mildews, and while it prefers warm, dry climates, it can withstand harsher weather conditions if they occur.

Height

Blackberry Rhino grows between 30-60 inches regardless of its environment.

Humidity and Temperature

These plants prefer warm, dry climates with plenty of sunshine, though their exact temperature ideals are unknown.

Flowering

The cultivar reaches maturity in 8-9 weeks indoors and by mid-October outside.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersThe cultivar is most often used to soothe anxiety in the mornings or after winding down after a long day.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for arthritisThose with inflammatory aches and pains, such as arthritis, may benefit from Blackberry Rhino’s analgesic effects.
Organ SystemsMuscular
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for insomniaWhen used before bed, Blackberry Rhino’s relaxing abilities help quiet racing thoughts that would otherwise delay a good night’s sleep.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional,Brain & Nervous System
medical_application_4:
Cannabis for headache and migraineCannabis’ ability to modulate serotonin transmission can help relieve the intensity and frequency of headaches in some cases.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_5:
Cannabis for muscle spasms and spasticityA combination of THC and CBD can help reduce the frequency and intensity of muscle spasms and any related neuropathic pain.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System,Muscular

Name: Blackberry Pie
Description:
The team at Gage Green Group created Blackberry Pie by crossing Jojorizo’s Blackberry Widow with Crystal Locomotive, a combination of White Widow and Trainwreck. This hybrid strain (cultivar) inherited moderate levels of THC, testing up to 19%, with little CBD content, balancing both indica and sativa characteristics.

Blackberry Pie produces bold, richly colored buds with purple coloring and gleaming white trichomes. Its flowers yield a fruity, sweet aroma with hints of damp moss and blueberries. According to users, its flavors carry traces of pine, nuts, and sweet berry pie.

The cultivar’s high begins with a more heady, psychedelic relaxation that ripples a sense of peace and joy from the center to the body. Following the course, Blackberry Pie eventually nestles users in the sense of physical relaxation that’s perfect for winding down at the end of a long day. Blackberry Pie could be beneficial for managing chronic pain, anxiety, and depression.
Growing:
Blackberry Pie plants exhibit hybrid traits, growing into relatively tall plants with thick stalks and wide, lateral branching. The plants can withstand most environmental factors, such as heavy winds or cold, but outdoor gardens will still require protection from heavy rains that could attract mold or mildew. Growers may opt for the more-easily controlled environment of indoor gardens. They can boost yields by cutting the vegetative period shorter or using Sea of Green (SOG) training methods.

Height

60-80 inches

Humidity and Temperature

Blackberry Pie prefers low humidity and temperate weather with plenty of sunshine. Those seeking to encourage the violet colors in the bud should expose the plants to cold temperatures toward the end of their flowering cycle.

Flowering

The strain is ready for harvest in 7-9 weeks indoors and by the end of September or early October outdoors.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for chronic painIndividuals suffering from chronic pain, acute pain due to injury, or general aches or tension caused by inflammation will likely find relief with Blackberry Pie due to the strain’s high myrcene and terpinolene content.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for depressionThe uplifting, happiness-inducing elements of Blackberry Pie’s high help soothe the negativity of depression while simultaneously calming the speedy, racing thoughts associated with PTSD or anxiety.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for inflammationThe anti-inflammatory abilities of Blackberry Pie may calm symptoms of conditions related to hyperactive inflammation or immune response.
Organ SystemsImmune System,Other

Name: Blackberry Moonrocks
Description:
Blackberry Moonrocks is an Anesia Seeds creation, bred as a combination of a female Blue Moonrock plant and a male Blackberry Kush. The cultivar features 80% indica characteristics, with an impressive 30%+ THC and negligible amounts of CBD and other cannabinoids.

The dense, sticky buds produced by Blackberry Moonrocks feature a coat of resinous trichomes and a bruised purple coloring. The flowers exude a lavender and blueberry-like aroma, with a matching palate of flavors, including hints of diesel and a light citrus note.

Medical marijuana patients select the Blackberry Moonrocks hybrid for its overall relaxation, gentle kick, and mood-enhancing sativa effects. Its fluffy soft high puts people in a blissful mood while muting physical discomfort, making the cultivar helpful for those tackling various mental and physiological conditions.
Growing:
Blackberry Moonrocks is a compact strain that thrives in indoor growing operations. The strain makes it easy for beginners, thanks to its mold and fungal resistance and its ability to succeed with gentle yield-increasing techniques like Sea of Green (SOG). Outdoors, Blackberry Moonrocks prefers dryer climates with enough light to branch into the plant’s full potential. The buds turn a deep purple when exposed to cold (but not freezing) temperatures right before flowering begins.

Height

Blackberry Moonrocks reaches heights between 30-60 inches indoors and stretches as high as 80 inches outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

While Blackberry Moonrocks is highly resistant to fungi and molds, it prefers a warm climate with plenty of sunlight and minimal humidity.

Flowering

Indoor plants reach flowering in eight to nine weeks and are ready for harvest by week ten—outdoor gardens flower in early to mid-October.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for arthritisBlackberry Moonrocks feature high linalool, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene content; these terpenes have shown anti-inflammatory properties in studies and could help treat arthritis.
Organ SystemsMuscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for headache and migraineSimilarly, the pain-relieving and anti-inflammatory aspects of Blackberry Moonrocks make it a handy strain for muting the pain of headaches or migraines.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for insomniaIn higher doses and when used before bed, consumers may have an easier time achieving sleep with Blackberry Moonrocks’ myrcene content and higher THC levels.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional,Brain & Nervous System
medical_application_4:
Cannabis for depressionBlackberry Moonrocks’ mood-lifting properties, thanks to its limonene content, make it a helpful tool for individuals struggling with dark or depressive thoughts and low moods.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System

Name: Blackberry Lime Haze
Description:
Blackberry Lime Haze was created by breeders Nebu Hybridz as a combination of Blackberry and Lime Haze. Not to be confused with its Blackberry Haze sister strain, this 90% sativa-leaning hybrid features a milder 16-19% THC content and only 1% CBD.

The Blackberry Lime Haze plant produces beautifully violet buds with orange tendrils and a blanket of white trichomes. Users report a berry-forward aroma blended with spices and a sweet, spicy cocoa afternote. Blackberry Lime Haze features lime flavors mixed with herbs, berries, and a floral finish.

According to anecdotal reports, this cultivar features high-energy clear-headed effects that uplift low moods and make concentrating more accessible. It makes for a handy daytime strain (cultivar), producing functional creativity and many other beneficial effects.
Growing:
Blackberry Lime Haze stretches into long, lean plants that thrive regardless of the growing environment. The cultivar resists most invading molds or diseases quickly, preferring dry and sunny outdoor climates where it can stretch its branches. Exposure to cold — but not freezing — temperatures right before harvest will tease out vivid purple and blue coloring from the buds. Indoor growers who have experience with growing techniques such as Screen of Green (SCROG) can produce improved yields.

Height

Blackberry Lime Hazes stretches between 60-80 inches indoors. Outdoor plants can reach as tall as 90 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

The plants prefer sunny climates with little exposure to humidity, though exact temperatures are unknown.

Flowering

This cultivar typically takes eight to nine weeks to reach maturity indoors or around mid-October when raised outside.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for depressionIndividuals facing depression use Blackberry Lime Haze as a daytime tool to manage low moods and help them feel more engaged with their lives.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS)/myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME)Users describe Blackberry Lime Haze as a “wake and bake” strain, thanks to its ability to combat tiredness and fatigue.
Organ SystemsOther,Skeletal,Muscular
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for inflammationThe beta-caryophyllene and limonene present in Blackberry Lime Haze provide anti-inflammatory benefits, which make the strain helpful in managing symptoms of a host of conditions, including Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, different kinds of arthritis, and multiple sclerosis (MS).
Organ SystemsImmune System,Other

Name: Blackberry Kush
Description:
Blackberry Kush is a cultivar of unconfirmed origins and features approximately 80% indica characteristics, THC content testing as high as 20%, and negligible amounts of CBD.

Many breeders believe Blackberry Kush to be a combination of an Afghani landrace with either Blackberry or DJ Short Blueberry. However, some also believe Bubba Kush or OG Kush genetics play a role in the strain. The buds feature an aromatic blend of fresh berries and damp soil, with flavors that lean closer to an earthy, almost diesel-like palate with a sweet berry flavor.

Medical marijuana patients opt for Blackberry Kush for its powerfully sedating high, producing euphoric happiness and uplifting moods. Others claim the cultivar (often referred to as “strain”) helps stimulate appetite and serves as a valuable companion for combatting stubborn insomnia.
Growing:
Blackberry Kush prefers indoor growing environments where even beginner-level growers can easily attend to its needs and produce high yields. The cultivar produces laterally branching bushes that, with regular trimming and allowing for standard air and light flow, create an aromatic crop of dense, compact green-and-purple buds. More advanced cultivators will also find success raising Blackberry Kush outdoors, though they must protect the plants from some fungi or spider mites.

Height

Blackberry Kush plants stay short and squat, with lots of lateral branching. The exact average height of these plants is still being determined.

Humidity and Temperature

Blackberry Kush prefers warm temperatures and plenty of light, though outdoor gardens can be susceptible to too much humidity.

Flowering

Blackberry Kush reaches maturity between 65 to 75 days inside and by mid-October outdoors.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersThe indica cultivar offers an effective tool for managing anxiety or feelings of stress resulting from various lifestyle factors.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for chronic painThose experiencing chronic or acute pain, such as joint issues, muscle spasms, or migraines, may find long-lasting relief with moderate doses of Blackberry Kush.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for insomniaBlackberry Kush’s sedative myrcene content helps those struggling with restless or elusive sleep to overcome insomnia and access deeper sleep.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional,Brain & Nervous System
medical_application_4:
Cannabis for loss of appetiteIndividuals experiencing a lack of appetite, such as chemotherapy patients or those with cachexia or wasting syndrome, may benefit from the hunger-inducing properties that Blackberry Kush features.
Organ SystemsOther,Endocrine

Name: Blackberry Haze
Description:
Blackberry Haze, sometimes styled Blackberry Lime Haze, was created by breeders Nebu Hybridz as a combination of Blackberry and Lime Haze. This 80% sativa-leaning hybrid features 16-20% THC content and minimal CBD.

The Blackberry Haze cultivar produces a mix of energizing, uplifting effects that allow users to mitigate pain or lack of focus and more easily concentrate on the task at hand. With moderate THC levels, Blackberry Haze makes for a handy daytime strain with many beneficial effects. Blackberry Haze could be very useful for managing anxiety and depression when used in low-to-moderate doses.

Flowers produced by Blackberry Haze feature a lovely purple coloring, sticky with a resinous load of trichomes. The buds exude a berry-forward aroma, with blends of spices and slight chocolate on each exhale.
Growing:
Blackberry Haze develops into tall, stretching plants that thrive indoors and outdoors. The strain is resilient against many common molds and diseases and, when exposed to cooler temperatures right before harvest, produces an attractive yield of purple, green, and orange flowers. The cultivar favors dry, sunny outdoor climates where it can stretch its limbs, but indoor growers with experience in ScROG and other tall-plant growing techniques can also cultivate success.

Height

Blackberry Haze reaches 60-80 inches indoors and stretches over 90 inches outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

Blackberry Haze prefers dry, sunny climates with little exposure to humidity.

Flowering

On average, plants take eight to nine weeks to reach maturity indoors. Blackberry Haze plants outdoors are ready for harvest in mid-October.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS)/myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME)Blackberry Haze has been described as an ideal strain to “wake and bake,” thanks to its ability to combat fatigue and motivate users to face the day ahead.
Organ SystemsOther,Skeletal,Muscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersSimilarly to their impact on fatigue, the eucalyptol and beta-caryophyllene in Blackberry Haze help cancel out unwanted stressful thoughts and anxiety, better equipping people with the tools they need to face the demands of a busy life.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for depressionThose experiencing depression turn to Blackberry Haze as a daytime relief, making them feel motivated and more engaged with their lives without a euphoric or psychoactive experience.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_4:
Cannabis for acute pain or post-surgery painUsers also celebrate Blackberry Haze’s ability to combat chronic or acute pain resulting from illnesses like multiple sclerosis or injury, particularly during the day, thanks to its lack of more soothing properties found in other pain-relieving cultivars.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular

Name: Blackberry Fire
Description:
Blackberry Fire is a diesel-flavored combination of Blackberry Kush and Fire Lady created by the breeders at Purple Caper Seeds. This cultivar contains 70% indica and 30% sativa characteristics, with THC testing at approximately 23% and little-to-no CBD present.

The Blackberry Fire strain features a sweet, berry-esque aroma with hints of a diesel stink. A deeper whiff of these dense, spherical flowers yields hashy notes attributed to the strain’s Kush genetics, whereas their smoke produces a sweeter, more tart berry flavor.

Blackberry Fire took home second place at the 2016 HempCon Cup Awards, where it was lauded for its mix of psychedelic cerebral effects and heavy physical relaxation. Its potent, balanced mixture makes Blackberry Fire helpful for various medical uses, including depression, insomnia, and chronic pain.
Growing:
Purple Caper Seeds has made Blackberry Fire seeds available for private growers, making cultivation information readily available. The cultivar shines in indoor and outdoor gardens, forming squat and bushy plants with thick and lateral branches. At maturity, Blackberry Fire blooms into shades of purple, green, orange, and white with sparkling trichomes.

Height

Blackberry Fire plants develop squat and bushy, reaching no higher than 80 centimeters.

Humidity and Temperature

Blackberry Fire prefers semi-humid climates with temperatures settled in the mid-70s Fahrenheit. Growers looking to tease more purple coloring from their plants should expose crops to cold temperatures right before flowering is due to begin.

Flowering

8-9 weeks

Name: Blackberry Dream
Description:
Blackberry Dream, also known as Blue Dream, is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain that is a cross between Kimbo Kush and Super Silver Haze. Some enthusiasts argue that it is a cross between Blueberry and Haze. Blackberry Dream boasts a high THC content, averaging around 22%, but can sometimes reach up to 24%. The strain is composed of 60% sativa and 40% indica.

Blackberry Dream is known for its uplifting and euphoric effects, making it a popular choice for those seeking a mood boost. However, beginners should proceed with caution due to its potent psychoactive properties. The high THC content in Blackberry Dream may make it beneficial for managing conditions such as chronic pain, depression, and fatigue. The strain is often described as having a sweet, berry, earthy, and slightly spicy flavor profile.
Growing:
The Blackberry Dream marijuana seeds are perfect for both indoor and outdoor cultivation. This strain has an average flowering time of about nine weeks and can yield massive harvests under optimal conditions.

Height

The strain typically grows to a medium height and has the potential to create massive yields, making it a favorable choice for growers looking for a high return.

Humidity and Temperature

The strain thrives in climates with temperatures ranging from mildly cool to warm. Maintain relative humidity levels at 40-50% during vegetative growth and reduce to around 30-40% during the flowering stage.

Flowering

Blackberry Dream strain blooms after around nine weeks. This gives growers plenty of time to plan for a successful harvest.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for chronic painCannabis contains compounds known as cannabinoids, with the most well-known being delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) and cannabidiol (CBD). These compounds interact with the body’s endocannabinoid system, which plays a role in regulating pain. THC has analgesic properties that can help reduce pain, while CBD can help reduce inflammation, a common cause of many types of pain. Additionally, cannabis can help improve sleep, which can in turn help manage chronic pain conditions. Some studies have shown that medical cannabis can help replace or reduce the use of opioids for pain management.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersCannabis, specifically CBD (cannabidiol), has been shown to help with anxiety and panic disorders by interacting with the body’s endocannabinoid system. This system is involved in regulating a variety of functions including sleep, appetite, pain and immune system response. CBD may help to reduce stress and anxiety by enhancing the endocannabinoid signaling, which can help to regulate mood and fear. It can also interact with serotonin receptors in the brain, which play a key role in anxiety disorders. Some studies have shown that CBD can reduce symptoms in people with various anxiety disorders, including generalized anxiety disorder, social anxiety disorder, and panic disorder. However, more research is needed to fully understand the potential benefits and risks.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System

Name: Blackberry Diesel
Description:
Blackberry Diesel is a cross of Plushberry and East Coast Sour Diesel that contains 80% sativa and 20% indica content. First bred by the team at New420Guy Seeds, the strain (cultivar) tests at an average of 21% THC content and features little-to-no CBD.

The Blackberry Diesel hybrid strain inherits many flavors and aromas from its Diesel genetics. When its purple and neon green buds are smoked, Blackberry Diesel produces a flavor palate of honeyed wet soil and rich blackberries. The cultivar exudes a musky blend of earthy sweetness and a tart fuel-like aroma on the first whiff.

Anecdotal reports claim that Blackberry Diesel invigorates the mind with mental stimulation and cerebral rush within a few minutes of consumption. The body tingles with energy that relaxes wanton physical discomfort, while the mind sharpens into a more focused state that benefits from added motivation. Those seeking to address fatigue, pain, or depression often use this cultivar.
Growing:
Blackberry Diesel grows into sativa-characteristic plants with tall heights, branching stalks, and long, thin fan leaves. The cultivar prefers warmer, Mediterranean-like climates, though plants will do just as well in indoor settings. As long as temperatures are steady, Blackberry Diesel produces large, fluffy flowers that reach maturity when trichomes become visible. This strain has an intense nose, so you may prefer planting Blackberry Diesel indoors with smell-proof protection if discretion is needed.

Height

These plants grow tall and lanky, though Blackberry Diesel’s exact height is unknown.

Humidity and Temperature

As a mostly sativa plant, Blackberry Diesel prefers moderate humidity and plenty of warm sunshine.

Flowering

Blackberry Diesel reaches maturity indoors in 10-12 weeks, while outdoor gardens flower in early November.

Name: Blackberry Cream
Description:
Blackberry Cream, sometimes styled Blackberry Creme, is a 70% indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain created by the team at Exotic Genetix by crossing Cookies and Cream with Blackberry Kush. The strain (cultivar) features THC content testing at up to 25%, with little-to-no CBD or other cannabinoids.

The Blackberry Cream plant yields densely packed, popcorn-shaped buds coated with olive green and purple hues and a thick layer of trichomes. The flowers exude a pungently sweet, earth-laden aroma with notes of berries and spice emitted when crushed. Blackberry Cream tastes similar, with an earthy smoke featuring hints of sweet cream and smooth vanilla.

Anecdotal reports claim the Blackberry Cream strain produces a swift euphoric high, with uplifting elements, inviting positive thinking and slowing racing thoughts. As the experience continues, the euphoria sinks into the body with a blanket of tension-relieving relaxation. These effects make individuals choose Blackberry Cream to address stress, depression, insomnia, and physical pain.
Growing:
Despite its indica-leaning genetics, Blackberry Cream grows more like a true hybrid. It displays long, thin fan leaves and taller heights that indicate a sativa lineage but produces the purple hues, thicker stalks, and dense buds commonly associated with indica plants. The strain is a good option for beginner cultivators, as it can thrive indoors and outdoors when left to its own devices. However, you may prefer an indoor garden if you’re worried about smell or plants getting too tall.

Height

Blackberry Cream plants grow tall with sturdy, thick stalks and long fan leaves. The strain’s exact average height is unknown.

Humidity and Temperature

Information on Blackberry Cream’s humidity and temperature preferences is unavailable, but it likely favors moderate to cooler temperatures, as hinted by its purple coloring.

Flowering

The strain flowers indoors in 7-9 weeks and reaches full maturity in the northern hemisphere between the end of September and mid-October.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for insomniaBoth the high levels of THC and the presence of myrcene in Blackberry Cream can help fight off unwanted insomnia.

Name: Blackberry Cobbler
Description:
Blackberry Cobbler is an indica-dominant hybrid of Blackberry Kush and Trainwreck comprised of 70% indica and 30% sativa effects. Phantom Farms developed this high-THC strain (cultivar) that packs a wallop with its heady effects. Fruity aromas fill the air when someone is smoking Blackberry Cobbler, which has been compared to a freshly baked pie.

Blackberry Cobbler has a high 29% average THC level, which makes the strain effective for chronic pain and depression. Nausea and appetite loss are two of the most common conditions people use Blackberry Cobbler to treat. Studies have shown that high-THC strains like Blackberry Cobbler may help people with cancer increase their caloric intake when undergoing chemotherapy.
Growing:
Blackberry Cobbler has a 55-day average flowering time and produces an average to slightly above average yield. The Blackberry Cobbler plant blooms in lustrous flowers with orange and red stigmas.

Height

30 to 60 inches

Humidity and Temperature

Blackberry Cobbler does best in a warm, temperate climate between 65 and 75 degrees Fahrenheit.

Flowering

55 days Indoors: 1 ounce per square foot
Outdoors: 15 ounces per plant

Name: Blackberry Chem OG
Description:
Blackberry Chem OG is an indica-dominant hybrid strain (cultivar) that crosses Blackberry with Chemdawg. Some users describe Blackberry Chem OG as having a somewhat harsh, earthy, ammonia scent with contrasting hints of sweet berries. This unique combination surprises the palates of people trying the strain for the first time.

The effects of Blackberry Chem OG are diverse, with some describing the sensation of being in a warm haze and others deriving short-term relief from muscle spasms. Whether it’s addressing minor physical discomfort or severe pain, the high THC levels in Blackberry Chem OG are potentially helpful.
Growing:
The original breeder of Blackberry Chem OG remains a mystery, but we do know that the plants display olive green buds with plentiful orange hairs. Trichomes are a striking amber hue and appear after an average harvest time of close to eight weeks.

Height

30 to 60 inches

Name: Blackberry Bubble
Description:
Blackberry Bubble is an 80% indica-dominant hybrid strain (cultivar) with strong sedative effects and pain-killing properties. Produced exclusively by Arizona Natural Selections, the strain blends Sour Bubble and Blackberry Kush. Blackberry Bubble has a reputation as a delicious strain with flavors of sweet berries and bubble gum.

Cannabis cultivators may have difficulty finding growing information on Blackberry Bubble, as Arizona Natural Selections keeps their strategies top secret. Taking clippings from mature plants may be the only way to grow Blackberry Bubble at home.

But we do know that the Blackberry Bubble cannabis plant has resin-crusted buds and an unusual phenotype with lavender trichomes and buds with rich, purple undertones.

Name: Blackberry
Description:
Blackberry by Seattle-based Nirvana Seeds was created in 2009 as a combination of a clone of Black Domina with the Raspberry Cough strain (cultivar). This 50:50 indica-to-sativa hybrid features moderate levels of THC, testing up to 21%, with around 3% CBD content.

The hybrid plant produces compact, densely-packed flowers with tight leaves and a coat of resinous trichomes. Blackberry exudes a scent more diesel-like than berry, though it contains hints of its namesake fruit. Its smoke produces a more blackberry-forward flavor with notes of diesel and loamy soil.

Users report Blackberry is best known for its potent, euphoric effects that are mellow enough to avoid couch lock. It mixes a sativa buzz of mental stimulation and uplifted mood with the tingly, pain-numbing abilities typical of indica-leaning strains.
Growing:
Blackberry plants are a good option for beginner growers because they can thrive outdoors in nature or a well-controlled indoor grow house. Blackberry is a particularly intense strain, so it may be better kept indoors to avoid alerting nosy neighbors.

However, its pungent smell can be overwhelming without appropriate ventilation, so indoor cultivators should invest in proper smell masking and air circulation before planting. At maturity, Blackberry produces lovely purple-green buds, densely packed and coated with sparkling white trichomes.

Height

While exact heights are unknown, the strain likely develops into medium-sized plants approximately 4-6 feet tall with moderate lateral branching.

Humidity and Temperature

Blackberry plants prefer warm and temperate climates with dry air to help them avoid molds or fungal infestations.

Flowering

Blackberry reaches maturity in eight to nine weeks indoors and mid-to-late October outdoors.

Name: Black Widow
Description:
Black Widow is an award-winning hybrid strain (cultivar) honored with the High Times Cannabis Cup. This sativa-dominant strain is a cross between an unknown South American and South Indian sativa. One of the strongest strains yet fairly well-balanced, Black Widow’s indica properties make some users sleepy, while others will respond more to its energizing sativa effects.

Considered a daughter strain to White Widow, bred by Mr. Nice Seeds, Black Widow is easy to grow and known for producing high yields. Black Widow is a phenotype of the original White Widow, so it has the same genetics but expresses different physical characteristics. THC levels are high, sometimes leveling off at more than 20%. People use Black Widow for mental and physical benefits, notably relieving muscle spasms.
Growing:
Those interested in growing Black Widow can expect abundant yields featuring large buds coated in orange hairs. Snowy white trichomes adorn buds rich in terpenes and cannabinoids, primarily THC. Feminized cannabis seeds may be purchased online but are available in limited quantities.

Height

30 to 60 inches

Name: Black Velvet
Description:
Black Velvet is a perfectly balanced 50/50 indica/sativa hybrid strain with THC levels between 15 and 18%. Crossing The Black with Burmese Kush, Black Velvet weed is the brainchild of B.C. Grown Seeds.

Physically, the plant resembles an intense black-purple indica, which is short, bushy, and of high density. But the equal distribution of indica and sativa makes this hybrid strain (cultivar) a good choice for people seeking well-balanced effects.

The strain’s aroma is a bouquet of flowers, including roses and violets, while the tasty flavors of berries, lavender, and even a hint of chocolate shine through. Black Velvet is popular as both a daytime strain and a nighttime strain. Because of its dual indica/sativa parentage, Black Velvet makes some people feel sleepy, and others energized.
Growing:
These cannabis plants produce buds with a black-purple hue, but little else is known about them due to the unavailability of feminized seeds. But if you do get your hands on these elusive seeds, you may be able to produce an indoor yield of up to three ounces in a two-gallon pot.

Name: Black Tuna
Description:
The Black Tuna strain is a potent hybrid of Herijuana and Lamb’s Bread with British Columbian roots bred by 5 Star Organics. The strain’s name derives from the infamous Black Tuna Gang that smuggled Colombian marijuana into the United States in the 1970s. It’s comprised of an even split of 50% indica and 50% sativa genetics.

Known for its strong smell and narcotic effects, Black Tuna packs a potent punch with its high levels of THC (22-28%) and may help relieve depression, chronic pain, and stress. But Black Tuna may be too much for some beginners, and this high-THC strain is recommended for experienced marijuana users.
Growing:
Much of the information about growing Black Tuna has been kept top secret by the breeder and involves a bit of guesswork. However, we do know that the cannabis strain can be grown outdoors and has an average flowering period ranging from 50 to 60 days.

Name: Black Russian
Description:
An indica-dominant hybrid strain (cultivar) of Black Domina and White Russian, Black Russian is known for inducing the couch lock effect. This popular nighttime strain is rich in aromas and flavors of tropical fruit, berry, and sweet vanilla. It boasts 80% indica and 20% sativa.

Black Russian can have sky-high THC levels at up to 26%. This THC abundance can be beneficial for people seeking to increase their appetite and reduce feelings of nausea. Pain and insomnia are two other common conditions Black Russian may help alleviate.
Growing:
The Black Russian cannabis plant features deep green foliage and colorful buds with crystalline trichomes. The strain’s pungent aroma calls for good ventilation in an indoor environment, and many cultivators prefer to raise the strain outdoors. It is one of the great indica yielders with an impressive maximum yield of 32 ounces per plant for outdoor grows with a flowering phase ranging from 7-8 weeks.

Medical users enjoy the strain for its positive effects on chronic pain, anxiety, and insomnia. High-THC levels provide long-lasting effects for medical and recreational users alike.

Black Roses has an aroma profile that includes fresh flowers and rose buds. Citrus and diesel intermingle to create an unexpected flavor profile. The plant’s physical characteristics include buds with bright orange hairs, thick nuggets, and orangey trichomes resembling amber frost.

The Black Roses strain is sometimes confused with Black Sugar Rose, an entirely different hybrid from crossing Critical Mass and Black Domina.

Name: Black Out
Description:
A cross between The Black and Face Off OG, Black Out is recognizable for its strong sage aroma. Other exotic scents from this strain (cultivar) include incense, blackberry, and spices like pepper. Many users prefer Black Out at bedtime, as the strain has a reputation for inducing sleep. It’s comprised of 80% indica and 20% sativa.

An indica-dominant hybrid, Black Out offers some users a feeling of euphoria, along with a more reliable effect of sleepiness. The hazy head effects of Black Out make the strain inappropriate for daytime use or anytime you need to be alert and functioning at top speed.

Black Out is also known to help people with muscle aches, anxiety, and depression.

Originally grown in Humboldt, California, and Oregon by Archive Seed Banks, Black Out is a mysterious strain for growers. Feminized seeds are not available for purchase, and clippings are the only way to grow Black Out in your home garden.

Name: Black Orchid
Description:
Cross the classic strains Gelato and OG Kush, and you get the flavorful and aromatic Black Orchid strain. Originally bred by Wonderbrett, Black Orchid is an indica-dominant hybrid strain (cultivar) reputed to have intensely relaxing effects.

Blueberries, cream, and a hint of citrus round out a succulent flavor profile, while delicate aromas of deep florals and blackberry pie add more intrigue. Seasoned cultivators recognize this marijuana strain for its slender orange hairs and frosty trichomes tinted in deep purple hues.

At nearly 20% THC, Black Orchid is a potent cannabis strain that may fatigue you. Other users report feeling a heady high and experiencing fits of giggles.
Growing:
Strain creator Wonderbrett has kept their growing strategies top secret, and little information is available on how to cultivate Black Orchid. However, anecdotal reports indicate that this is a beginner-friendly strain to grow indoors or outdoors.

Height

Up to eight feet

Humidity and Temperature

While climate information on Black Orchid is hard to come by, during the flowering stage, most cannabis plants require about 40% air humidity in mild, temperate conditions, no higher than 75 degrees.

Flowering

8-9 weeks

Name: Black Mamba
Description:
Black Mamba is an intense indica-dominant strain (cultivar) that crosses Grandaddy Purple and Black Domina (with some people claiming a bit of Blue Bubblejuice in the mix). Black Mamba is so potent that it derives its name from a venomous African snake.

The Black Mamba plant has 70% indica lineage and 30% sativa roots and features flowers with deep purple hues from anthocyanin pigments. At first glance, the dark colors of the Black Mamba plant can make it appear black rather than purple. Rich berry and pine aromas, paired with a fruity flavor profile, complement its striking appearance.

People use Black Mamba to relax, relieve aches and pains, and increase appetite. Relatively high THC levels averaging 20% make the strain ideal for treating numerous conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and, in some cases, eating disorders.
Growing:
Growers can expect dense forest-green leaves and flowers in deep shades of indigo. Frosty white trichomes coat the ample buds, which will blossom in early autumn when cultivated outdoors.

Height

6 feet

Humidity and Temperature

Semi-humid; 70 to 80 degrees Fahrenheit

Flowering

13 to 14 weeks

Name: Black Magic Kush
Description:
An indica-dominant hybrid strain (cultivar) with jade green foliage and bright orange pistils, Black Magic Kush is known as a pleasurable variety of cannabis with sleep-inducing qualities. Medical cannabis patients often seek out the Black Magic Kush strain for pain relief and to treat insomnia. This hybrid strain is a cross between Buckeye Purple and Cherry Sauce.

The strain’s breeders, Andromeda Seeds, have not made Black Magic Kush seeds available online. Prospective cultivators can seek alternative ways of growing the strain, such as by taking clippings of mature plants. The scent of freshly baked pie blended with sweet herbs is strong from flowering time through consumption.
Growing:
Seeds are unavailable for purchase from this strain’s creator, Andromeda Strains, and growers must take clippings to cultivate Black Magic Kush at home. Indoor or outdoor growing is possible, but outdoor conditions must be semi-humid for Black Magic Kush to thrive. Under the right conditions, expect flowers to bloom in bright orange pastels with a rich terpene profile.

Height

5 feet to 6 feet

Humidity and Temperature

50% humidity and 70 degrees Fahrenheit

Flowering

9 weeks
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for insomniaThe entourage effect comes into play when the cannabinoids and terpenes in Black Magic Kush combine to make users feel calm and, often, fatigued.

medical_application_2:
Cannabis for chronic painTHC is well-documented to help relieve chronic pain, such as muscle aches and joint discomfort.

Name: Black Lotus
Description:
With a snowy coating and piney aroma, this unique strain (cultivar) is a cross between Snow Lotus by Bodhi Seeds and Pacific Northwest (also called UW Black Hashplant). Moderate to high THC levels make Black Lotus a popular marijuana strain for people with insomnia and chronic pain.

People with arthritis and anxiety may also benefit from this strain of diverse effects. The 70% indica and 30% sativa profile of Black Lotus makes this strain with a spicy, earthy flavor a favorite among people seeking to unwind from a hectic day.
Growing:
The flowers of the Black Lotus plant have thin orange hairs and trichomes with a sticky texture. Successful outdoor growers will live in a humid climate with warm daytime temperatures up to 80 degrees Fahrenheit.

Height

30 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

Humid; 70 to 80 degrees Fahrenheit.

Flowering

Eight to nine weeks.

Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersCannabis contains many anxiolytic (anti-anxiety) compounds that can beat stress and reduce the production of the stress hormone cortisol.

medical_application_2:
Cannabis for arthritisBlack Lotus is known for helping people with chronic pain, especially those with arthritis. The strain relaxes the body and mind, allowing the joints to loosen and lubricate.

Name: Black Lime
Description:
Also called Black Lime Reserve and Black Lime Special Reserve, Aficionado Seeds created this strain (cultivar). A special cross between Northern Lights, Purple Kush, and Chemdawg Special Reserve, Black Lime won second place overall in the 2014 High Times Cannabis Cup. Its cannabinoid profile includes 13-19% THC and about 1% CBD.

Minty menthol and lemony fresh aromas distinguish Black Lime from other hybrid cannabis strains. At 70% indica and 30% sativa, Black Lime offers a heady high and full body relaxation. Migraine sufferers have also reported beneficial effects from this powerful hybrid.
Growing:
Black Lime is an easy-to-grow strain that is ideal for beginner cultivators. However, Black Lime strain seeds can be difficult to find and are available in limited quantities online. Additionally, while this strain can be grown indoors and outdoors, many cultivators choose to grow outdoors due to the strong scents that Black Lime emits.

Height

30 in to 60 in

Humidity and Temperature

Humidity of 40-50% with temperatures at 70 to 85 degrees Fahrenheit

Name: Black Jack
Description:
Black Jack is a strain (cultivar) bred by a cannabis company called Sweet Seeds. This company created Black Jack by crossing the genetics of two of Sensi Seeds’ classic cultivars: Black Domina and Jack Herer. Black Jack is known to produce thick buds with huge calyxes. The effects of this potent strain are said to be heavy, so it may not be ideal for first-time cannabis growers or users.

Black Jack is an indica-dominant strain with 70% Cannabis indica and 30% Cannabis sativa. THC levels are relatively high, and the amount of CBD is extremely low.

Black Jack has a distinctive fragrance and flavor profile. It consists of florals, wood, and pine, and this is a unique blend that makes it stand out from the rest.
Growing:
Black Jack is an indica-dominant plant and is shorter when compared to sativa plants. However, Black Jack crops may need to be supported on a trellis because some tend to grow top-heavy.

From this, the plant cannot support its weight and may topple over. If the plant falls over, the stems could snap or become damaged. As a result, this plant could be challenging for first-time growers.

Black Jack can be grown indoors or outdoors, but remember that you may not have access to a trellis when growing this plant indoors.

Growers expect a reasonable yield of 18 to 22 ounces per square meter. For an indica plant, this is a good yield; however, plants grown indoors may produce less.

To keep Black Jack strong, ensure it has enough water and sunlight. Also, feed the soil with magnesium and calcium before it enters the flowering stage.

Height

Black Jack can grow up to 30 to 60 inches (2.5 to 5 feet).

Humidity and Temperature

Like most cannabis varieties, Black Jack grows well when humidity levels are between 50% to 70% during the vegetative stage. However, reducing the humidity during the flowering stage to about 30%-40% may prevent mold from growing on the buds.
The best temperatures for Black Jack are between 70 and 85 degrees Fahrenheit (21 to 29 degrees Celsius).

Flowering

10 weeks. Most indicas typically finish flowering in about six to nine weeks.

Name: Black Haze
Description:
Developed by Pioneer Nuggets, Black Haze blends Colombian Black, Colombian Gold, and Purple Haze. Known for its deep purple buds, Black Haze has relaxing but uplifting effects. It’s a sativa-dominant hybrid cannabis strain comprised of 60% sativa and 40% indica.

Rich in terpene valencene, Black Haze hints at orangey citrus flavors and undertones of berry and grape. People with depression may benefit from Black Haze, which is said to induce euphoria in some users.
Growing:
Dark purple hues and crystalline trichomes characterize the buds of this exotic strain. Black Haze is relatively easy to grow and can tolerate fluctuating temperatures, but the strain does best outdoors in a warm, semi-humid climate.

Height

80 cm to 100 cm

Humidity and Temperature

Semi-humid; warm

Flowering

11 weeks to 14 weeks

Cannabis for depressionThe uplifting qualities of Black Haze make it a popular marijuana strain among people seeking to treat depression symptoms.

Name: Black Domina
Description:
Indica-dominant and boasting some of the world’s finest indica genetics, Black Domina is a diverse blend of Northern Lights, Ortega, Hash Plant, and Afghani. This cannabis strain (cultivar) created by Sensi Seeds delivers relaxing effects and can be helpful to people with anxiety and chronic pain.

Solid THC levels make Black Domina efficient as a natural sleep aid. The strain’s 95% indica and 5% sativa profile also contributes to its purported ability to help people fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer.
Growing:
First-time growers can expect a high yield after a short flowering time, with trichome-dense buds developing as soon as 50 days. These compact plants are easy to manage for experienced growers and novice cultivators alike. Hydroponic setups are best for growing Black Haze, but the strain may also be cultivated indoors and outdoors.

Height

Up to 4.5 feet

Humidity and Temperature

Dry; warm

Flowering

50 to 63 days

Cannabis for insomniaThis potent strain may help you fall asleep faster, thanks to its high concentration of indica genetics and THC content.

Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersBlack Haze has a relaxing effect on the mind that helps tame anxiety in some people.

Name: Black Dog
Description:
Humboldt Seed Organization developed the Black Dog strain (cultivar), an indica-dominant hybrid of Blackberry Kush and Emerald Headband comprised of 85% indica and 15% sativa. With high THC levels and a heavy indica influence, Black Dog is a great strain for mental and physical effects like pain relief.

The lesser-known terpenes, ocimene, sabinene, and phellandrene, are most abundant in Black Dog, contributing to its powerful cerebral effects for many users. Tart notes of blackberry tease the palate, while woodsy and piney notes refresh the senses.
Growing:
Growers may purchase Black Dog seeds online for cultivating the strain indoors or outdoors. Good light penetration is necessary during the plant’s flowering cycle, which produces a higher-than-average yield of buds.

Height

Up to 9 feet

Humidity and Temperature

Semi-humid Mediterranean climate

Flowering

48 to 55 days

Cannabis for chronic painSome medical users consume Black Dog for its purported ability to relieve chronic pain. Some people have also reported that the strain helps with everyday aches and pains like a stiff neck.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for insomniaThe sedating properties of Black Dog help some people achieve higher quality sleep, making this strain better for nighttime use.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional,Brain & Nervous System

Name: Black Diesel
Description:
One of the most awarded plants with multiple Cannabis Cups, Black Diesel is bred by Advanced Seeds and features a unique taste and a ripe grapefruit aroma. Descended from NYC Diesel, this sativa-dominant hybrid strain (cultivar) grows best in humid environments and produces large crops with a strong smell.

Peppery notes characterize the potent odor of Black Diesel and contribute to the strain’s energizing qualities. Many users report using Black Diesel to boost energy and combat everyday stress.
Growing:
Black Diesel is known for being an easy strain to grow and is suitable for novices. Growers can expect large crops whether cultivating indoors or outdoors, but humid environments will kill these plants.

Height

70 cm to 100 cm

Humidity and Temperature

Dry (due to mold non-resistance); adaptable to different temperatures

Flowering

51 to 61 days

Name: Black Diamond
Description:
Also called Black Diamond Kush and Black Diamond OG, this mostly indica strain (cultivar) hails from Northern California. Reportedly good at treating muscle spasms and other types of chronic pain, Black Diamond is a THC-dominant cross between Diamond OG and Blackberry and is comprised of 90% indica and 10% sativa.

Expect earthy aromas of mahogany and diverse flavors of nuts, berries, and red wine to tantalize your senses. Black Diamond has one of the most dynamic scent and flavor profiles of any cannabis strain.
Growing:
Black Diamond seeds are not available for commercial sale. Growers hoping to cultivate this particular strain will need to take clippings from mature plants. Black Diamond plants have large flowers and leaves with purple hues.

Height

Black Diamond plants are typical of indica-dominant strains in that the plants are typically short and bushy.

Humidity and Temperature

Black Diamond thrives in a humid climate with 70 to 80 degrees Fahrenheit daytime temperatures.

Flowering

Black Diamond plants typically flower anywhere between 63 to 70 days.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for chronic painThis clone-only strain helps many people relax, taming muscle spasms and reducing overall pain levels.

Cannabis for depressionSome Black Diamond users report feeling mentally balanced when using the strain that is reputed to deliver a surprisingly smooth smoke. Although THC can sometimes lead to paranoia, some people claim that Black Diamond does not come with that side effect.

Name: Black Dahlia
Description:
This indica-dominant hybrid strain is believed to be a cross between the strains (cultivars) Black Cherry Soda and Querkle. Black Dahlia is known for being rich in trichomes and offering pain– and insomnia-relieving effects for some people.

Clocking in at 75% indica, Black Dahlia is known for eliciting mellow sensations and improving mood. Honey and sweet berries characterize the strain’s flavor profile, complemented by woodsy and floral aromas.
Growing:
Black Dahlia is an easy-to-moderate strain to grow, making it a good choice for novice cannabis cultivators. The strain grows best in a warm climate and produces an average yield.

Height

Short to average

Humidity and Temperature

Low humidity, warm temperature

Flowering

10 to 11 weeks
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for chronic painSome users report that Black Dahlia helps with their chronic joint and muscle pain. This is because THC activates CB1 receptors in cells, helping to provide pain relief.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for insomniaKnown as a sleepy strain, Black Dahlia can help some people get a good night’s rest. This is because THC can prompt the release of the sleep neurotransmitter adenosine. This can help manage conditions like insomnia and PTSD.

Cannabis for depressionBlack Dahlia’s euphoric effects can help some people manage their depression, but no cannabis strain should be used in place of prescription antidepressants without a doctor’s approval. Low doses of THC are ideal for managing depression and anxiety.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System

Name: Black Cream Auto
Description:
Black Cream is an exotic purple flowered autoflowering strain (cultivar) and a cross between Cream Caramel and another autoflowering strain with Pakistani Kush roots. Featuring sweet, fruity aromas, Black Cream Auto is also a great resin producer with earthy undertones.

This purple auto strain is heavily indica at 91% and contains some ruderalis plant lineage in addition to sativa. The relaxing and sedating terpenes of myrcene and linalool are abundant in Black Cream Auto, adding to the calming effects of the strain. Some people also use the THC-rich strain to stimulate appetite and prevent nausea.
Growing:
Black Cream Auto produces purple flowers and has a big main cola plus a main stem with several small branches. The strain is known for producing an abundant indoor yield and being easy to grow.

Height

60 cm to 110 cm

Humidity and Temperature

Mild humidity levels at temperatures of 68-74 degrees during flowering.

Flowering

Black Cream Auto marijuana plants typically take around eight weeks to flower.

Cannabis for loss of appetiteSome people undergoing chemotherapy may benefit from a strain like Black Cream Auto that can stimulate appetite while fighting nausea. This is because THC is a CB1 receptor agonist, which can stimulate the release of the hunger hormone ghrelin.

Cannabis for anxiety and panic disordersCannabis contains many anxiolytic (anti-anxiety) compounds that can beat stress and reduce the production of the stress hormone cortisol.

Cannabis for insomniaBlack Cream Auto’s indica-dominant profile paired with its sedating terpenes make it an excellent strain for warding off insomnia.
