Name: Black Cherry Soda
Description:
Dark purple in color and fruity in taste, the Black Cherry Soda strain (cultivar) is reported to be a great strain for chronic pain. It is the inspiration behind other sweet fruity strains like Black Dahlia.

A sativa-dominant hybrid known for its high THC content, Black Cherry Soda has energizing effects for many users. Its fizzy, soda-like taste has been described as invigorating, and some people choose this strain to improve focus and concentration. A daytime strain, Black Cherry Soda is easy to grow and has an average flowering period ranging from 50 to 60 days.

Aside from providing chronic pain relief, Black Cherry Soda is also said to be a great strain for combatting migraines and fatigue due to its higher THC level.
Growing:
Black Cherry Soda is an easy-to-grow strain that achieves the same height whether cultivated indoors or outdoors. The plant buds resemble ripe cherries and are an unusual purple color, adding intrigue to any cultivator’s garden.

Height

30 cm to 60 cm

Humidity and Temperature

Moderate temperatures with low humidity

Flowering

50 to 60 days
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for chronic painHigh-THC strains like Black Cherry Soda are frequently used for their analgesic (pain-relieving) properties. THC activates CB1 receptors in nerve cells, which can reduce the sensation of pain. THC also binds to CB2 receptors, which can help reduce inflammation. The strain may help everything from minor muscle aches to severe neuropathic pain.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS)/myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME)High levels of THC address nausea that often accompanies migraine headaches, while the pain-relieving benefits can ease pressure in the head. THC can activate serotonin receptors, which is one of the reasons why it can help manage migraines, nausea, depression, and anxiety.
Organ SystemsOther,Skeletal,Muscular
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS)/myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME)While some people will feel more tired using Black Cherry Soda partly due to its myrcene content, others may get a strong energy boost, especially if lower doses are taken. The strain is known for raising energy levels and helping people concentrate on creative projects and tasks. Those with chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS) may find that Black Cherry Soda is one strain to look out for.
Organ SystemsOther,Skeletal,Muscular

Name: Black Cherry Punch
Description:
A hybrid of Black Cherry Pie and Purple Punch, Black Cherry Punch is an indica-dominant cannabis strain (80% indica, 20% sativa) that produces relaxing effects. Users reportedly experience stress relief, improved sleep quality, less depression, and other mental effects from Black Cherry Punch.

This hybrid strain has a sweet cherry flavor with a slight hint of woody pine and is notable for its high levels of farsenene, one of the rarer terpenes in the cannabis plant. Growing Black Cherry Punch is a cinch for most cultivators but requires patience from indoor and outdoor growers, as flowering time can occur up to 81 days from planting.
Growing:
Growing Black Cherry Punch is easy for most cultivators, but the strain has a long flowering time of up to 81 days. Patience is required for this strain that may be grown outdoors or indoors.

Height

Up to 60 cm indoors; Up to 80 cm outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

Moderate temperature and humidity.

Flowering

68 to 81 days.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for depressionBlack Cherry Punch’s effects are euphoric for some users and may help treat depression symptoms.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for insomniaMany users report feeling sleepy while consuming Black Cherry Punch, a positive effect for those trying to overcome insomnia.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional,Brain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for neuropathy (nerve pain)Due to its high THC content, Black Cherry Punch can help alleviate pain. Additionally, because many people with chronic pain also suffer from insomnia and depression, this indica-dominant hybrid strain is a great choice for helping relieve all three ailments at once.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_4:
Cannabis for loss of appetiteTHC can stimulate the production of the hunger hormone ghrelin.

Name: Black Cherry Pie
Description:
A hybrid of Cherry Pie and Blackberry Kush, Black Cherry Pie has roots in Vermont through the Green Mountain Collective. According to many users, this fruity strain (cultivar) has a mouthwateringly delicious flavor and a high THC potency. However, the strain contains virtually no CBD.

Equally balanced between sativa and indica, Black Cherry Pie is rich in the terpenes limonene and beta-caryophyllene. The colorful foliage and jade green buds with orange hairs make this strain a striking plant for growers who can obtain clippings of mature plants, as Black Cherry Pie seeds are unavailable online.

This hybrid strain is said to improve focus, reduce pain, and improve mood, causing its users to feel relaxed, happy, and social. Medical cannabis patients may also use this strain to help combat the symptoms of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD).
Growing:
Black Cherry Pie grows in striking deep blue and purple hues, but the strain’s producer, Green Mountain Collective, does not sell seeds online. To cultivate Black Cherry Pie at home, you’ll need to make a clone plant clipping. If you are in a legal state where dispensaries are allowed to sell cuttings, you may be lucky and manage to get a clone for a home grow.

Height

Short and bushy.

Humidity and Temperature

Semi-humid; 70 to 80 degrees Fahrenheit in the daytime; 55 to 65 degrees Fahrenheit at night.

Flowering

Eight to nine weeks.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)Utilizing CBD and other phytocannabinoids and terpenes in cannabis may help replace the lost endocannabinoids, helping treat pain and mood disorders associated with NF1 gene mutations. Using THC may help boost dopamine levels in the brain.
Medical cannabis may also help reduce the intake of stimulant medications. Terpenes like beta-caryophyllene and limonene may be beneficial for reducing the intake of stimulants and addiction in general.
Organ SystemsMental / Emotional
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for acute pain or post-surgery painThe relaxing effects of Black Cherry Pie help some people manage their chronic pain and feel a pleasant tingling in its place.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for depressionBlack Cherry Pie may help some people feel less depressed, but it may exacerbate anxiety because of its high THC content. Suppose you are using Black Cherry Pie for depression. In that case, we recommend using low doses to take advantage of THC’s anti-depressant effects while reducing the risk of adverse side effects.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System

Name: Black Cherry OG
Description:
​​Black Cherry OG — also known as Black Cherry OG Kush — is a hybrid marijuana strain (cultivar) that falls between well-balanced and indica-dominant. Its THC levels usually measure between 12% and 18%, while CBD is less than 1%.

Black Cherry OG’s true genetics are unknown, but some say California breeder Ken Estes crossed Grand Daddy Purple with his special OG Kush (“Ken’s OG”) using Sour Diesel genetics. Ken’s goal was to create a marijuana strain that helped patients find relief from aches and pains. As a result, Black Cherry OG fans seek this cultivar for pain relief, relaxation, and mood elevation. Its moderate THC level provides full-body effects, making this strain ideal to take at night to ease stress and sleep better.

Visually, Black Cherry OG buds are stunning with an intense purple hue and bright, long orange hairs. Its aroma delivers an intoxicating blend of spice, sweet berry tea, figs, and cherries, undercut by sharp hints of citrus. Black Cherry OG’s taste is equally pleasurable, bursting with berries and leaving an aftertaste of green tea.
Growing:
Black Cherry OG is not a delicate plant, making it suitable for beginner cultivators. Black Cherry grows well indoors or outdoors. The yield will be smaller in both situations, maxing out at about 10 ounces per plant. Growers can purchase Black Cherry OG seeds or clones.

Once mature, the Black Cherry OG strain produces oval-shaped green, dense buds with long orange hairs and a decent amount of crystals.

Height

30-60 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

Moderately warm climate.

Flowering

Nine to 10 weeks.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for acute pain or post-surgery painUsers report that the pain relief from Black Cherry OG is undeniable. This cannabis strain significantly eases muscle spasms, muscle tension, and spasticity. It also offers a reprieve from chronic pain and body aches caused by chronic illnesses. The research aligns with these reports, showing that THC and marijuana generally relieve spasms in people with multiple sclerosis.
Organ SystemsSkeletal,Brain & Nervous System,Muscular
medical_application_2:
Cannabis for depressionBlack Cherry OG’s full spectrum of compounds, notably THC, acts as a temporary antidepressant for some people by stimulating the brain’s reward system to produce more dopamine. As a result, people report feeling happier, helping them cope with mental and psychological conditions, including depression, stress disorders, and anxiety.
Organ SystemsBrain & Nervous System
medical_application_3:
Cannabis for insomniaOne of the most dominant effects of Black Cherry OG is sleepiness. After initial feelings of happiness and increased gusto, users report intense sedation and a couch-lock quality. The Black Cherry OG strain is best taken at night or before bed and can assist those struggling with insomnia and other sleep issues.

Description:

Black Cherry Gelato is a slightly indica-dominant hybrid with 60% indica and 40% sativa. Still, most users describe it as a typical indica with calming and sedative properties.

Fans of this hybrid strain report a mix of robust flavors like sweet berry with mild wood notes, marked by the dominant terpenes delta-3carene, pinene, terpinolene, and beta-caryophyllene. Black Cherry Gelato’s complete chemical profile makes it a sweet bud with relaxing and euphoric effects.

Black Cherry Cheesecake is uncommon, but it’s a sweet, exotic strain that holds true to its name in flavor and aroma. Visually stunning, Black Cherry Cheesecake buds appear sugar-coated, with leaves ranging from bright green to deep purple and pink. Users report that it tastes like sweet cherry with pungent cheese notes. Other users note light citrus and strong herbal flavors with deep earthy scents.

Resources report that Black Cherry Cheesecake seeds are not readily available online, so growers should look for seedlings or clones. Once sourced, Black Cherry Cheesecake seedlings can grow indoors or outdoors but may work best in a controlled greenhouse environment. Experienced cultivators say this elusive cultivar can be tricky to perfect and may be best for intermediate-level horticulturists.

Name: Black Cheese
Description:
Black Cheese is an indica-dominant strain (cultivar) grown by crossing San Fernando Valley x Big Buddha Cheese. Big Buddha Seeds also makes a version of Black Cheese that crosses Black SFV OG and UK Cheese. Its parentage produces a powerhouse hybrid with a genetic makeup of 85% indica and 15% sativa. The Black Cheese strain has a THC content hovering between 20% to 23%, while its CBD content is nearly undetectable.

As its name suggests, the Black Cheese strain has a cheesy flavor and aroma. Additionally, this indica hybrid is known for its intense hashy scent complemented with subtle peppery hints. When burned, Black Cheese produces a pungent smoke with a heavy fermented flavor.

Users report heavy body relaxation from Black Cheese coupled with stress-fighting euphoria. As a result, Black Cheese helps people combat anxiety, chronic pain, and even insomnia.

Black Cheese cannabis seeds may be challenging to find, but the plant’s bold purple shade and high THC levels are worth the effort. The Black Cheese strain can be grown indoors or outdoors with medium difficulty. A medium to high-yielding cultivar, this feminized cannabis strain produces up to 800 grams per plant outdoors.

Most users report a sweet aroma with notes of fruit, coffee, and earthiness marked by the strain’s unique terpene blend. Black Bubba’s cannabinoid and terpene profile deliver a delicious, calming, sedative experience.

Name: Black Banana Cookies
Description:
A cross of Blackberry Kush and Banana Fire Cookies, Black Banana Cookies is an indica dominant (65/35) hybrid marijuana strain (cultivar) born from Solfire Gardens. With mid-range THC content between 14.5-22%, Black Banana Cookies delivers calming effects suitable for newer users.

It has a sweet, earthy aroma with notes of banana and a sweet, fruity, and berry taste. Black Banana Cookies may help users manage medical conditions such as insomnia, chronic pain, and stress.
Growing:
The Black Banana Cookies strain is a resilient variety that requires consistency and effort to cultivate. But with some patience, you can grow one bush to yield 400 grams of buds after 60 days.

Height

With excellent growing conditions, room for the plants, proper lighting, and nutrient-rich fertilizer, you can expect Black Banana seeds to grow 30-60 inches in height. The fully matured plant will contain big, vibrant, crystalline buds with an herbal, woodsy, and fruity finish.

Humidity and Temperature

This strain enjoys a warmer climate, around 80°F, and humidity ranging from 30-60%, depending on what part of the growing process you are in.

Flowering

Black Banana Cookies start flowering at about 53 days and last about ten days. After about 60 days, these plants may be ready for harvest. This strain grows upright and is typically denser and leafier toward the top, so you may have to prune the plant throughout its lifecycle to ensure it reaches maximum height.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for insomniaThe Black Banana Cookies strain offers peaceful, calm, and mild sedative effects to help settle the mind and sink into bed, a welcome experience for those with insomnia. THC can trigger the release of the sleep neurotransmitter adenosine. Both THC and CBD can help reduce stress by blunting the effects of cortisol on stress receptors.

Name: Black Afghan
Description:
Black Afghan — also known as Black Afghani — is an 80% indica-dominant strain (cultivar) created by crossing three phenotypes: OG Kush, Afghani #1, and Black Domina.

Similar to Black Afghani Kush created by Medicann Seeds, Black Afghan contains a 5:1 THC to CBD ratio. With up to 22% THC and 5% CBD, this strain is known for mood-boosting effects that radiate visceral relaxation through the body.

Black Afghan’s dominant terpene profile mixes pinene, terpinolene, and caryophyllene to deliver berry, peppery, and sage-like flavors. Users report this hybrid strain also delivers medical benefits ranging from stress reduction to spasm, pain, and insomnia relief.
Growing:
Black Afghani Kush is moderately difficult to cultivate indoors and requires a hot and humid climate for outdoor growth. Additionally, home growers may find it challenging to source Black Afghani genetics online. Those motivated to produce this indica-dominant strain should seek a vendor who sells plant clippings.

Height

Black Afghan plants, like pure indicas, can be relatively short, ranging from 30-60 inches in height.

Humidity and Temperature

Seedlings of any kind prefer high humidity levels of 65-70% and temperatures with lights on of 68-74 degrees Fahrenheit. Growing plants in the vegetative stage prefer less humidity, ranging from 40% to 70%, and slightly higher temperatures of 71-82 degrees. As plants enter the flowering period, growers must reduce humidity levels to 40-50% at temperatures of 68-74 degrees.

Flowering

For indoor grows, Black Afghan typically flowers from 68 to 75 days, developing dark, nearly black, dense buds. Generally, Black Afghan plants are ready to harvest by day 79.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for depressionBlack Afghan helps relieve depression and symptoms by stimulating your brain’s reward system and delivering an uplifting dopamine boost. The strain’s total-body sedation can also help you disconnect from the monkey mind’s racing thoughts and settle into the present moment.

Cannabis for acute pain or post-surgery painLike all high-THC strains, Black Afghan Kush can change your perception of pain and reduce its intensity. Name: Biskante
Description:
With a 70% sativa and 30% indica profile, the Biskante strain is a sativa-dominant hybrid grown by crossing the Melonade and Biscotti strains. Developed by Alien Labs, Biskante has a high THC content of 27%-29% and low CBD levels hovering around 1%.

Paired with its cannabinoid profile, Biskante’s limonene and beta-caryophyllene terpenes produce a biscotti sweetness with a lemony, creamy, gas aroma. Biskante’s chemical compounds synergize to deliver an intense cerebral high, euphoria, and occasional lightheadedness. Some users also report harnessing this potent strain for medical purposes, like pain relief, depression, and anxiety.
Growing:
Alien Labs reportedly grows its designer cultivars indoors but has not published specific cultivation instructions for the Biskante strain. That said, sativa-dominant hybrid cultivars like Biskante grow healthy inside or outside under the proper conditions.

Height

Unlike indica-dominant, sativa-dominant hybrid strains typically take on sativa properties, making them taller and lankier varieties with thin leaves. At full height, sativas can grow five to eighteen feet or more.

Humidity and Temperature

Each stage of a plant’s lifecycle requires different humidity and temperature conditions. For indoor setups, some experts report that seedlings and clones prefer moderate temperatures of 68-77 degrees Fahrenheit with the lights on at high humidity levels of 65-70%.

During vegetation, growers typically start to reduce humidity levels by 5% weekly while they raise temperatures to 71-82 degrees. During the flowering stage, cannabis requires about 40% air humidity in mild, temperate conditions, no higher than 75 degrees. One to two weeks before harvest, ideal humidity levels are reportedly 30-40% at temperatures of 64-75 degrees with lights on.

Flowering

The flowering stage occurs when the plant develops flowers that eventually become cannabinoid-rich buds. This stage occurs after the grower reduces the plants’ light exposure to 12 hours daily. Under these conditions, sativa-like strains produce flowers around week ten to twelve while simultaneously doubling or tripling in height. Their complete growth cycle from seed to harvest lasts about six months.
medical_application_1:
Cannabis for depressionMost people describe the Biskante strain as an uplifting variety that spurs energetic euphoria and giggles. As a result, this strain may be used to treat symptoms of depression, such as sadness, fatigue, and lack of appetite. However, it is best to use low doses of Biskante if using it to manage depression.

Because Biskante has such a high THC percentage, this strain could help with lack of appetite, a symptom of conditions like depression, anxiety, and cancer treatment, like chemotherapy. Biskante’s high THC content might also help relieve nausea.

When THC binds to cannabinoid receptors, it stimulates the brain’s endocannabinoid system, which helps regulate inflammation, immune response, and pain control. As a result, Biskante could be useful for medical patients dealing with migraines and other types of headaches.

Name: Birthday Cake
Description:
Birthday Cake, also called Birthday Cake Kush, is an indica-dominant hybrid strain (cultivar). Birthday Cake is loved for its sweet vanilla cake-like flavor and was created by crossing parent strains GSC with Cherry Pie.

Users say it has a strong sedating effect on the mind and body. Therefore, this strain is preferred by those who need additional support for pain, insomnia, appetite loss, headaches, and inflammation.

Birthday Cake is typically 60% Cannabis sativa and 40% Cannabis indica. Although some claim it’s a 50/50 split. Regardless, it still gives users the best of both. Birthday Cake requires a hot and humid climate to grow, and it can thrive indoors or out, making it an easy plant to cultivate for first-time growers. The buds are light green and orange, are dusted lightly with resin, and some have hints of purple.
Growing:
While Birthday Cake is an indica-dominant strain, it can grow slightly taller than most growers expect. This plant can be grown indoors or outdoors, although it does prefer a slightly warmer climate over a colder one.
Since Birthday Cake is closely related to Cherry Pie, it’s highly mold-resistant, making it easy to look after. Therefore, Birthday Cake would be ideal for first-time growers. However, any gardener will enjoy watching this strain grow because the buds are colorful and highly variable.
Birthday Cake is 60% Cannabis indica and 40% Cannabis sativa. The THC content is high, and the buds are typically frosted in a sticky THC resin. Growers can expect a good yield of 16 ounces per plant when grown outdoors.
The yield might be slightly less when grown indoors. To improve the flowering of an indoor plant, cut the top off the central stalk after it reaches a reasonable height. Doing so will encourage the plant to be bushier, facilitating the growth of more leaves and buds.

Height

The height is variable, depending on the phenotype. Some may grow to only 31 inches (2.6 feet), while others grow to 60 inches (5 feet).

Humidity and Temperature

Birthday Cake marijuana likes a warm and humid environment, so keep humidity between 60%-70% during the vegetative state. Since this strain is resistant to mold, it might be able to handle the same degree of humidity during the flowering stage.
Keep temperatures between 70 and 85 degrees Fahrenheit (21 to 29 degrees Celsius). Ensure that the plant is not exposed to cold temperatures at night.

Flowering

Eight to 10 weeks. Most indicas typically finish flowering in about six to nine weeks.

Name: Bio Diesel
Description:
Bio Diesel is a balanced hybrid strain bred on the farm of Denver Relief in Colorado. Bio Diesel is a four-way cross between Sour Diesel, Original Diesel, NYC Diesel, and Sensi Star. This hybrid won the 2nd Annual Colorado Medicinal Marijuana Harvest Cup in 2009. It’s an evenly balanced hybrid strain with 50% indica, 50% sativa, and a THC content of 17%-22%.

Bio Diesel combines sativa and indica strains (cultivars), producing an intense euphoric high that eases into a relaxed state. These balanced effects may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as chronic pain, anxiety, and inflammation.

True to its diesel-heavy lineage, Biodiesel has a pungent diesel-chemical flavor and potent stench with woody and spicy notes.
Growing:
Bio Diesel is a deep olive color with purple hues. It produces fluffy, dense buds.

This variety may not be suitable for beginner growers as it can be challenging to grow. Unfortunately, Bio Diesel seeds are unavailable — the cannabis variety must be grown from cuttings.

There is also little consensus on the best growing conditions for Bio Diesel.

This variety is potentially susceptible to fungus. It is essential to control the humidity and apply natural fungicides such as citric acid. Inoculating the root zone with beneficial mycorrhizae is recommended to support the plant’s growth and biological defense systems.

This plant can reach over 6 feet tall, so topping it is essential if growing indoors. This variety may benefit from training methods such as “screen of green” (SCROG). The SCROG method involves topping the plants in the early vegetative stage (removing the apical or center stem).

This encourages the plant to produce more side shoots, eventually becoming colas (flowers). Once topped, the branches of the plants are gently weaved through support (usually a horizontal trellis) to maximize the amount of light reaching each potential bud site.

Height

Bio Diesel can reach over 6 feet tall. They should be managed through topping and training to prevent apical dominance and help increase your yield.

Humidity and Temperature

While there is little specific information on ideal environmental conditions for Bio Diesel, a general cannabis guideline can be followed. Keep the relative humidity between 40%-60% in the vegetative phase, and drop it to 30%-40% during flowering to prevent molds such as bud rot from taking hold. Temperatures should stay between 70-80 F (21-26 C).

Flowering

Bio Diesel takes between nine to 11 weeks to complete flowering.

Description:

Big Buddha Cheese boasts a tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) level of 19%, indicating a moderate potency with a fabulous effect that won 1st prize in an indica seed category at the 2016 Cannabis Cup. The uplifting, euphoric, hunger-inducing effects make this strain (cultivar) ideal for managing stress, anxiety, depression, and appetite loss.

Big Buddha Cheese is a leafy plant known for its deep forest green leaves peppered with orange and pink hairs. When growing, Big Buddha cheese can find a way to thrive, growing to a medium height, with a relatively short flowering time and good yields, making it a great addition to any grower’s collection. Additionally, due to the natural resistance and ease of growing the Big Buddha Cheese, it is an excellent plant for beginners.

Big Buddha Cheese lives up to its name and won’t ever disappoint lovers of the classic Cheese strain, as Big Buddha Cheese inherited the highly sought-after skunky cheese aroma that makes the Cheese strain famous. This skunky cheese aroma from the Cheese parent is combined with the earthy tones and peppery tones of Skunk #1, as well as the fruity flavor and aroma from the Afghani strain. The strain, although indica dominant, can pack a punch, and it is advised that people new to the strain only smoke a little at a time.

Big Buddha Cheese can thrive in most temperatures and does best in warm and sunny environments.

The plants of Big Bud produce extremely high yields of huge buds with few leaves, which is how it got its name. Due to its high yields, Big Bud has become a popular cultivar to cross with other varieties of cannabis.

The indica to sativa ratio of Big Bud is 85:15 (highly indica dominant). The tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) levels of Big Bud vary significantly, with levels between 15% and 26% and cannabidiol (CBD) levels almost nonexistent at less than 0.2%.

Big Bud induces euphoria and cerebral stimulation, but the body’s high potency also brings a sense of deep relaxation. Most users succumb to “couch-lock” and sedation, and Big Bud’s effects make it potentially very useful for managing chronic pain, anxiety, and insomnia.

Expect Big Bud to yield 25 ounces per outdoor plant and 20 ounces per square meter for indoor plants. If you want to go the extra mile, Big Bud flourishes even further when grown in a hydroponic setup and using Sea of Green growing methods. However, neither of these are necessary for success.

Height

Big Bud plants quickly grow to 7 ft outdoors. If you’re planning to grow indoors, remember to allow sufficient room above your plants to avoid overcrowding.

Humidity and Temperature

Big Bud prefers a warm climate with lots of sunshine and low humidity. An eye needs to be kept on humidity levels to prevent molding.

Flowering

Big Bud flowers quicker than other indicas, within seven to eight weeks. Outdoor plants are ready for harvest in the beginning to middle of October.

Name: Berry White
Description:
Berry White is an indica-dominant hybrid strain that also goes by White Berry and Blue Venom. It’s 75% indica and 25% sativa and tastes like sweet blueberries and pine trees (a classic combination), with THC levels ranging from 16%-22%.

The punny name was inspired by American singer-songwriter Barry White, whose smooth, deep voice led him to become one of the best-selling music artists of all time. Like the legendary singer’s voice, Berry White is noted for its soothing, relaxing effects, and this makes Berry White ideal for managing insomnia, chronic pain, and inflammation.

Berry White is a cross between indica-dominant parents Blueberry and the hybrid White Widow. White Widow, developed by Green House Seeds, originates from the Netherlands and is one of the most popular strains in the world. White Widow was also the winner of the Cannabis Cup in 1995. The Blueberry strain is another highly sought-after strain and was created in the 1970s.

Berry White came about by accident; breeders at Green Beadz Seedz in Colorado were breeding this strain as an intermediary for mass-producing a different strain. They were surprised by the results of Berry White, which grew in popularity.

The distinctive blueberry flavor is because of terpenes also found in fruit-producing blueberry plants and Blueberry strains.
Growing:
Berry White is available in both regular seed and feminized seed, as well as in clone form. Feminized Berry White seeds are a great choice as they result in exclusively bud-bearing plants, are much more cost-effective, and require less growing space.

Growing Berry White is relatively straightforward as it’s highly resistant to mold and mildew, so humidity is less of a concern for growing indoors. The plant has a good structure, requiring less pruning, and is, therefore, a great option if you’re looking for something low maintenance. It can be grown both hydroponically and in soil.

If you’re growing indoors, opt for growing in soil and coco coir to maximize the blueberry aroma. You can look forward to a yield of around 1.64 ounces per square foot (16 ounces per square meter) when grown indoors and 18 ounces (500 grams) per plant outdoors. It’s a medium-sized plant with large blue buds that can turn purple. If you’re growing outdoors, pick a sunny spot.

Height

Berry White plants generally grow to a height of 30-78 inches. You can maximize the height of your plant by supplying nutrients to the roots.

Humidity and Temperature

Berry White best grows at around 70-80 degrees Fahrenheit. Berry White can handle humidity well; however, you want to aim for a relative humidity of approximately 55%, then lower to around 40% gradually as you get within one to two weeks of flowering.

Flowering

Berry White has a flowering time of around seven to eight weeks, and you can expect a high yield. If you’re growing outdoors, this means you can expect to harvest in early October.

Description: Berry Punch or Blueberry Punch is an energizing hybrid strain (cultivar) from breeding the popular strains of Romulan and the original Blueberry. Cannabis users herald this strain for creative energy effects that facilitate completing artistic projects. As the name suggests, this strain tastes like super sweet blueberries. This variety of cannabis may help manage ADHD, stress, and chronic pain.The most studied medical effects of cannabis involve the endocannabinoid system (ECS). It is responsible for receiving the various molecular substances contained in cannabis (e.g., phytocannabinoids like CBD and THC) and triggering natural healing responses within our bodies.
Growing:
Berry Punch is a difficult strain to grow and is not recommended for novice growers.

Height

If raised under the right conditions, it can grow to around 30-60 inches indoors and out. The Berry Punch plants are also relatively dense.

Humidity and Temperature

Like the berries it is named, Berry Punch thrives best in warm spring and summer climates. As with many other strains, a Mediterranean-like climate is best. Since this plant is difficult to grow and may fall victim to disease from mold, it is best to keep it in this climate.

Flowering

While the Berry Punch strain is more difficult to grow, it does have a shorter flowering period of around 55-65 days, with an average of 58 days. The plant should yield approximately 10-15 ounces per plant if grown outdoors and 1-2 ounces per square foot indoors. Name: Berry Pie
Description:
Berry Pie is a delicious, sativa-dominant hybrid created through a collaboration between Cookies and Seed Junky Genetics. By crossing GSC with Blueberry, the breeders have developed a sweet and fruity strain with a reportedly smooth-smoking experience.

Berry Pie is a relatively even hybrid, with 60% sativa and 40% indica heritage. This strain has a THC content of 18%-22% and a welcome 1% CBG content.

Berry Pie makes a great daytime strain, with users often reporting energizing and euphoric effects. This strain may also help alleviate stress and depressive symptoms with its mood-lifting properties.

Berry Pie has a rich, gourmet taste and sugary sweet aroma with notes of blueberries and cream, often likening to blueberry waffles or blueberry pie.
Growing:
Berry Pie is a visually striking strain with heavily frosted buds that look like they’ve been dipped in sugar. Looking hard enough through their powdery coating, you’ll notice lime-green flowers with orange pistils.

This variety is known for its sturdy stems, making it an excellent option for outdoor growing as it can withstand strong winds and insects. Berry Pie doesn’t require intense light levels, making it ideal for gardeners with semi-shaded areas and easier on the electric bill for those growing indoors. Berry Pie is a relatively low-maintenance strain and doesn’t require intense trimming.

Berry Pie can be found as both standard flowering and auto-flowering seeds. You can expect a typical yield of 400 grams per plant indoors and 500 grams outdoors.

Height

Berry Pie will typically reach 60-80 inches outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

As with most cannabis varieties, Berry Pie should be grown in warm temperatures (70-77 Fahrenheit or 22-26 degrees C) and a moderately humid environment (40%-60% RH). When flowering, reducing the humidity will help prevent molds such as bud rot. It is recommended that temperatures do not dip below 68 Fahrenheit (20 C) at night, as Berry Pie forms purple stems, especially in response to colder night temperatures.

Flowering

Berry Pie has a flowering time of nine to 10 weeks.

Name: Bediol
Description:
Bediol is a strain by Canadian LP Bedrocan. It’s a sativa-dominant strain (cultivar) with a well-balanced cannabinoid content of 6.5% tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) and 8% cannabidiol (CBD). Unfortunately, finding a plant with a good split of THC and CBD is rare. However, Bediol’s incredible balance caters to a range of needs and is exceptionally versatile for anyone suffering from pain, inflammation, anxiety, or nausea.

Bediol produces a mellow high that’s less euphoric and more soothing than most strains offer due to its high CBD content. However, it’s crucial for anyone sensitive to THC to monitor their dose.

Bediol is a sativa-dominant strain; some claim it’s a pure sativa. However, it’s unlikely that a totally pure sativa plant exists.
Growing:
Most Bediol plants are said to be fully Cannabis sativa; however, some traces of Cannabis indica likely are present. That aside, when growing Bediol, you’ll see that the plant is a dominant-sativa strain because it grows tall with thin leaves. Like most cannabis plants, you can grow Bediol indoors or outdoors. However, it prefers the outdoors because it’s a large plant and needs plenty of space to grow.

If you’re growing Bediol indoors, you can limit its top growth by cutting off the plant’s central stalk (called “topping”). Doing so enables the plant to grow bushier rather than taller and, when done correctly, can also increase yields. Unfortunately, no exact guidelines exist for how much this plant yields. However, since Bediol is a sativa plant, you can expect a large yield. Bediol does prefer being grown in a warm climate, so it’s worth growing indoors if you live in a cooler region.

Height

Bediol typically grows to 4.9 feet (1.5 meters) when grown outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

Bediol grows best in a semi-humid climate; thus, keeping the humidity around 50%-60% is best for this plant. When the plant enters the flowering stage, reducing the humidity to about 30%-40% prevents mold from growing on the buds.

Like most sativas, the temperature should be between 68 and 77 degrees Fahrenheit (20 and 25 degrees Celsius). Don’t leave this plant outside when the nights are cold because cold temperatures are not suitable for this strain. Either bring the plant inside overnight or protect it with a frost cloth.

Flowering

Most sativas finish flowering after 10 to 14 weeks. Therefore, you can expect Bediol to flower for at least 10 weeks.

Name: Beach Wedding
Description: Beach Wedding is a balanced indica-sativa hybrid of two other hybrid species, Wedding Cake and Tropicanna Cookies. Beach Wedding has a highly variable THC content of between 16%-29% and a CBD content of less than one percent. In small doses, this strain can provide an energizing and antidepressant effect. In large doses, more sedative and analgesic effects are seen. This makes Beach Wedding ideal for managing chronic pain, anxiety, and depression.
Growing:
Although marketed as an easy-to-grow strain, Beach Wedding is recommended for gardeners with some previous experience. Due to large, fan-shaped leaves, some defoliation is required to maintain good airflow and prevent mold growth. Thinning the leaves also allows for more efficient light exposure.

Indoor plants produce a yield of around 1 to 2 ounces per square foot of foliage, and outdoor plants produce approximately 10-15 ounces per plant, slightly more than indoor growth that is well-cultivated and maintained.

Height

Beach Wedding grows to between 30 and 60 inches tall. Although the strain can be grown inside and outside, Beach Wedding benefits from the increased natural airflow provided by an adequately spaced outdoor garden.

Humidity and Temperature

Little information is available on the exact humidity preferred by Beach Wedding. Lower plant density generally allows for higher humidity, while tightly packed plants require low humidity and high ventilation to prevent fungal growth.

Flowering

Beach Wedding starts to flower at 55-60 days and is ready for harvest at 62-70 days. Buds are purple-green with orange trichomes. When ready for harvest, the resin is visible outside the trichomes. In the northern hemisphere, outdoor plants are usually ready for harvest in October.

Height

BC Roadkill plants tend to grow on the shorter side. However, this plant lacks height and makes up for density and width with strong lateral branches.

Humidity and Temperature

The BC Roadkill strain tends to grow best in warm, Mediterranean-like climates.

Flowering

BC Roadkill flowers within eight weeks when grown indoors or outdoors and offers a moderate to high average yields of up to 450 grams per square meter of plant.

Description: The BC Big Bud strain was bred in British Columbia by Jordan of the Islands. It is a sativa-dominant hybrid (60%) in contrast to its parent strain Big Bud, an indica-dominant hybrid from Amsterdam. BC Big Bud’s sativa characteristics give the strain balanced cerebral and body effects. The strain (cultivar) has, unsurprisingly, big buds that are moss-green in color with amber-colored pistils and translucent trichomes. BC Big Bud may be ideal for managing stress, anxiety, and depression.
Growing:
BC Big Bud can be grown inside or outside, though the climate in the growing area becomes an important consideration if you decide to grow the plant outdoors. If you’ve never tried growing cannabis before, learn what you can about cannabis growing essentials to get a good idea of the basics before you begin.

Height

The height of the BC Big Bud depends a lot on its environment and where it’s grown. It usually grows between 30 and 80 inches (76.2-203 cm).

Humidity and Temperature

As a seedling, your plant will prefer a humidity of around 60%. When it reaches the vegetative stage, it’s a little less picky and can be kept at a humidity of 50%-70%. Then, when it starts to flower, you’ll need to keep it a bit drier, around 50%, to prevent the plant from rotting or getting moldy.

Flowering

BC Big Bud plants take between 48 and 67 days to flower and can usually be harvested in about 74 days or in early October if grown outside. The color of the pistils and trichomes can be a helpful indicator of when a plant is ready to be harvested. The size of the flowers means you should have a pretty impressive yield from your plant, but these can also weigh it down a bit, so you might want to prop it up with wooden supports.

Description: Bay Platinum Cookies is a popular sativa-dominant hybrid bred by Grandaddy Purp. It’s a cross between the famous Bay 11 and Platinum Cookies strains, and its high tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) content means it packs a punch. Bay Platinum Cookies has a strong high paired with a strong scent of citrus and earthy flavors. Effects have been described as arousing, euphoric, and happy. This suggests Bay Platinum Cookies may be ideal for managing chronic pain, depression, and anxiety.
Growing:
Bay Platinum Cookies is a moderately complex plant to grow; however, it may be a welcome challenge for some growers. If done right, this plant rewards with a moderate to high yield and colorful buds that can send you into a spacey and fantastic high.

Height

Bay Platinum Cookies reaches around 51 inches (129 cm) when fully grown. However, these plants can be a little more challenging to grow than others, so some growers may struggle to get their plants to reach this height.
As with other cannabis plants, regular topping is required to ensure bud clusters don’t form. This process involves cutting the main stalk to encourage more bushy growth. Pruning is also required to remove dead parts, and the living portions have adequate light exposure and airflow.

Humidity and Temperature

Bay Platinum Cookies prefers warm weather between 68 and 80 degrees F (20 and 27 degrees C). These plants thrive in indoor growing environments, often generating large resinous buds. They do exceptionally well in greenhouse environments, growing to huge and dense sizes.

Flowering

Bay Platinum Cookies takes around eight to nine weeks to flower and has a moderate to high yield depending on the harvesting method and the plant’s health. If the plant is healthy and grown under the right conditions, Bay Platinum Cookies can yield between 3 and 6 ounces per square foot.
The flowers of this strain are often a bright green with small radiant orange fibers and amber trichomes. However, the flowers can range anywhere from purple to green to orange.

Banana Sherbet has a flowering time of approximately 60 days and is usually harvested towards the end of September or early October.

Name: Banana Kush
Description:
Banana Kush crosses two famous strains, OG Kush and Skunk Haze. It’s an indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain with a ratio of 60% indica and 40% sativa. Banana Kush is a THC dominant strain known for its high THC concentration.

While the THC levels average at around 21%, some reports suggest that it can reach up to 25% with the proper care when growing. However, cannabidiol (CBD) content is almost zero. Banana Kush has been described as having a sweet, fruity, tropical taste, not unlike that of bananas. The effects have been described as talkative, giggly, and sleepy. Banana Kush could be useful for managing stress, anxiety, chronic pain, and insomnia.

Banana Kush is a fun, juicy, and enjoyable smoke with flavors reminiscent of fresh bananas. This strain inspires an initial euphoric high that gives way to a strong feeling of relaxation that’s sleep-inducing and hard to resist, making it an excellent evening option.
Growing:
The Banana Kush strain is an average-sized plant with a thick main stem and sturdy branches. The buds grow in dense clusters and have an almost pyramid-like shape. They are almost neon green, interspersed with bright yellow and dark orange pistils. Banana Kush is considered to have moderate difficulty growing and isn’t recommended for beginners because it can require a lot of attention to flourish compared to other strains.

For example, this cannabis strain needs a steady supply of constant light to thrive, so it is recommended to grow it in an indoor, controlled environment. It also needs to be trimmed regularly to produce a good yield. However, this strain is also highly resistant to diseases and pests, making cultivating it easier.

Banana Kush seeds are relatively easy to get your hands on, and you can buy them online. Though this strain is best grown indoors, it can be grown outdoors in the right environment. If you live in a warm and sunny climate and have a location where the plants will get steady sunlight, outdoor cultivation is possible. This strain has an above-average yield size, with an outdoor yield size of around 21 ounces per plant (595 grams per plant) and an indoor yield size of 18 ounces per square meter (510 grams per square meter).

Height

The Banana Kush strain grows to around 30-60 inches (76-152cm) when grown indoors or outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

Description:
Banana Hammock, also called Banana Hammock R1, is an indica-dominant strain (cultivar). This cannabis strain is a hybrid produced by crossing Mandarin Sunset with Grape God. As a result, Banana Hammock has a rich blend of terpenes that creates a sweet, grape, and honey-like aroma. Additionally, this strain has a decent amount of myrcene, a terpene that offers medicinal value. So, if you are looking for a strain for therapeutic use, this one could be perfect, especially if you seek relief from stress and insomnia.

Banana Hammock is typically 70% Cannabis indica and 30% Cannabis sativa, and the effects of this strain are said to be relaxing and soothing. Therefore, it’s perfect for when you need a quiet evening at home. Most of its effects come from THC, and different varieties of this strain have different concentrations of THC, so it’s always best to check THC levels first to ensure it’s right for you.
Growing:
Banana Hammock is 70% Cannabis indica and 30% Cannabis sativa. Indica-dominant strains tend to be shorter than sativa strains, though the height of this strain may vary due to its 30% Cannabis sativa content. However, growers should not be put off by a shorter plant because while indica plants are typically short, they tend to be bushier.

If you are growing more than one Banana Hammock plant or indica-dominant strain, ensure enough ventilation between the plants. Due to the bushy nature of these plants, they will be more prone to mold and disease since they are densely packed. It’s also essential to avoid overcrowding when the plant flowers because the buds are susceptible to decay.

When grown outdoors, growers can expect a yield of 20 ounces per plant, which is a significant yield for an indica strain. For the best yield possible, cut the top off the central stalk when it has reached a suitable height. Doing so will enable the plant to stop growing taller and divert its energy into producing more flowers and buds.

Name: Banana Daddy
Description: A cross between Granddaddy Purple and Banana Hammock R1 strains, Banana Daddy is a fruity, heavy-hitting strain with high THC content of up to 35%, relaxing and invigorating anyone who partakes.

Banana Daddy is not especially difficult to cultivate, making it a good choice if you are a new or inexperienced grower.

The Banana Daddy strain provides a medium to high yield, with plants having strong lateral branching and growing to a medium height. Banana Daddy is a good choice for shorter growing periods as it flowers more quickly than other strains. If you are somewhere with longer summers, you may be able to get a mid-season harvest of Banana Daddy.

Height

Banana Daddy plants grow to a medium height of 30-60 inches, and this strain doesn’t require extensive pruning to keep the plant under control. Yields for Banana Daddy are roughly 15-20 ounces per plant when grown outdoors or 1-2 ounces per square foot when grown indoors.

The humidity preferences of Banana Daddy are unclear, so it’s advisable to use the standard humidity range of 40%-50%.

Banana Daddy plants will flower 53-63 days after planting. Feminized seeds are readily available, so you can be sure you’re not wasting time on male plants. Auto-flowering strains are available, but most Banana Daddy seeds flower based on how much light they get each day.

Name: Bacio Gelato
Description: The Bacio Gelato strain is a rare, evenly balanced hybrid strain (cultivar). Made by Sherbeinskis in Los Angeles, this strain is the most potent in their popular Gelato lineup. It’s a hybrid cross between the popular strains Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint GSC. With very high average THC levels of 26%-28%, this strain packs a punch and leaves users feeling uplifted and aroused. This could make Bacio Gelato ideal for managing stress, chronic pain, and depression.
Growing:
The Bacio Gelato strain is challenging to grow. It requires high-intensity light and low humidity conditions, which can be hard to maintain. It’s also susceptible to fungi and overwatering. Growers prepared for the challenge will enjoy the benefits of this potent strain.

Height

This hybrid strain is a relatively small plant, making it an ideal option for indoor growth, especially if you do not have a substantial growing room. It rarely exceeds 30 inches and produces a plant with broad, dark green leaves.

Humidity and Temperature

This strain has particular humidity requirements, making it challenging to grow. If you grow this strain outside, ensure humidity is low during warmer temperatures. The Bacio Gelato strain does well indoors or in a greenhouse where the relative humidity can be kept below 60% with high light. If the humidity is too high, the cannabis strain may develop diseases, including Botrytis cinerea, a fungus that can kill the plant.

Flowering

The Bacio Gelato strain’s flowering time is around eight to nine weeks when grown indoors or mid-October if grown outdoors. This strain will produce green nugs with shades of purple and orange due to the presence of purple trichomes and orange pistils.

Name: B4
Description:
B4 is a hybrid strain of cannabis created by crossing parent strains Blue Dream with Chemdawg 4. B4 tends to be a balanced hybrid, with around 50% sativa and 50% indica genetics. The strain is potent, with a high THC level of up to 26%, and reportedly induces feelings of euphoria, heightened awareness, and a dreamy, full-body buzz. B4 may be beneficial for managing stress, anxiety, depression, and chronic pain.

The B4 strain was created by MTG Seeds, who also produced the famous Orange Creamsicle.

B4 is a colorful and attractive plant bearing small-to-medium forest green buds with fiery orange hairs, light blue undertones, and a coating of gold trichomes.

This strain is famous for its earthy, blueberry scent. Its potent effects combine the common wide-awake, creative effects of sativa strains with the more relaxing, happy high of indica strains.
Growing:
This strain of cannabis is difficult to find, and some consumers suggest obtaining clippings from mature plants rather than looking for seeds.

Height

This strain of cannabis plant often grows to around 5 feet and can grow even taller.

Humidity and Temperature

This strain does best in a semi-humid, Mediterranean-like environment.

Flowering

B4 flowers in about nine to 10 weeks when grown indoors. It usually has a high yield of buds at harvest time.

Name: B.B. King
Description: B. B. King is a hybrid 75% indica-dominant cannabis strain named after the famous blues musician Riley B. King. Although B. B. King has a relatively low tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) content of 14%-16%, it’s known for its heavy sedative effects. It treats muscle cramps, anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues.
Growing:
B. B. King is among the easier cannabis strains to grow and is popular with home and commercial growers. The plants are compact, mature quickly, and have a high yield. No auto-flowering strains are currently available. In good conditions, B. B. King can be expected to produce a yield of around 3 to 6 ounces per square foot (900-1800 grams per square meter) outdoors and around one and 0.5 to 2 ounces per square foot (460-610 grams per square meter) inside.

The plant is sturdy, with strong stems and tolerance to fluctuations in humidity and temperature. This, combined with its compact size and high yield, makes it a good plant for novice growers.

Height

B. B. King is a naturally short plant, averaging 20-30 inches (50-76 cm) tall. No training is required, though some growers use netting to help keep the plant’s leaves spread out for maximum light exposure.

Humidity and Temperature

B. B. King prefers a dry climate but is tolerant of fluctuations in temperature and humidity. This strain is also naturally resistant to mold and mildew, making it suitable for outdoor growth in moderately humid areas.

Flowering

B. B. King should produce flowers at around six to eight weeks. When outdoors, flowers can expect to be harvested from late September to early October.

This strain produces large, dense buds and long horizontal branches that may require some support. Flower buds are a light mint green to purple with a fine coating of bright orange hairs. When ready for harvest, the buds are covered with fine white crystal resin that’s very sticky to the touch.

Name: B-Witched
Description:
B-Witched is a hybrid cannabis strain (70% sativa, 30% indica) that inspires a powerful euphoric high while providing substantial relief from pain and nausea.

Created by Ocean Grown Seeds, B-Witched crosses OGs Wizard’s Potion and the infamous witches weed strain, an incredibly potent strain boasting THC levels as high as 30%. Though its offspring is a little more modest on this front (B-Witched tests at about 18% THC), it resembles its forefathers in terms of its dense and frosty buds. Its spell-binding name indicates its effects, which have been described as “soaring” and “magical.” If you want to experience a euphoric, giggly high, we recommend grabbing your broomstick and giving this one a go.

B-Witched’s scent has been compared to cupcakes, with additional notes of grape, citrus, and an earthy “forest floor” scent. One dose of this otherworldly strain (cultivar) can leave you feeling warm, free-spirited, and happy. The initial head high generally tapers into more physical effects, dropping you into a state of deep and contented relaxation. Many users report that as the high progresses, you’ll start to feel noticeably hungry, so be sure to have some snacks on hand when the cupboard raiding begins. We recommend cupcakes to match B-Witched’s mouthwatering scent.
Growing:
Seeds for B-Witched are available through Ocean Grown Seeds and can be sourced online, depending on availability. A good choice for beginners, B-Witched can easily be grown indoors in a controlled setting or outdoors if you are cultivating in a hot and humid climate. This bewitching strain should be topped during flowering to ensure proper budding.

Height

B-Witched will flower in approximately 10 weeks.

Humidity and Temperature

The B-Witched strain is a small to medium plant with a maximum height of 4 feet. Tending toward bushiness, growers should prune and trim the plant regularly.

Flowering

This strain thrives best in hot climates with moderate to high humidity.

Name: Ayahuasca Purple
Description:
Ayahuasca (aa·yuh·waa·skuh) Purple is an indica strain (cultivar) bred from Master Kush and Red River Delta strains. This deep purple strain produces a relaxed sense of euphoria and may aid people who are managing stress, depression, insomnia, pain, and nausea.

Many discussions have taken place about the strains name “Ayahuasca,” which refers to a plant-based psychedelic Ayahuasca, a concentrated liquid from the Banisteriopsis caapi vine combined with the Psychotria viridis shrub. The psychedelic drug has been used for centuries by people to change their consciousness and reach altered states of being.

Marijuana purists have complained that naming a strain after an illicit drug can lead to further discrimination against marijuana and its benefits. Whatever your feelings about the name, the Ayahuasca Purple strain is a powerful relaxant thanks to its indica foundation.

As a 100% indica strain with high THC content, this strain reportedly provides strong body highs while relaxing muscles and leaving the user feeling calm and zoned out. The strain can provide a feeling of bliss without the constant background noise of anxious thoughts.

Ayahuasca Purple flowers contain a high level of THC at 21%. As a result, even cannabis veterans should get a powerful high from this strain.

This strain’s flowers are full of fluffy purple buds, beautiful orange hairs, and delicious mango and papaya flavors.
Growing:
Ayahuasca Purple has broad leaves and dense buds. It’s suitable for both outdoor and indoor cultivation. These plants can produce large yields of more than 600 grams per square meter. With this in mind, it is essential to utilize structures that can support the weight the excess flowers will add to the plant.

Because the plant is a good provider, you probably don’t need much land to secure a good yield. If you choose to grow indoors, you can expect to produce approximately 650 grams of product per square meter.

Height

Ayahuasca Purple grows to heights between 35 and 40 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

These plants need to maintain a consistent humidity of at least 60 percent.

Flowering

The flowering cycle takes about 55-65 days, which is relatively short compared to most marijuana strains.

Flowering

Information on how to cultivate this miraculous strain is hard to find, but the general consensus is that its indoor flowering time starts at around eight weeks.

Description: As the name suggests, the Aurora Indica strain is an indica-dominant strain (cultivar) with a composition of 90% indica and 10% sativa. With a low to moderate THC level ranging from 12% to 20%, Aurora Indica is not the most potent strain, but make no mistake, it still creates a heavy buzz. Aurora Indica is noted for its spicy, herbal, pine, and woody taste and sleepy, relaxing, hunger-inducing effects. Aurora Indica is potentially very useful for managing chronic pain, stress, insomnia, and appetite loss.
Growing:
Aurora Indica seeds are readily available on the market, are fast flowering, and are relatively easy to grow, making this a good strain for beginners. Aurora Indica is a strong, sturdy plant that can handle most climates and is resistant to disease.
The plants are short, bushy, and densely packed. The buds are solid and resinous, with pale green leaves, brown and red pistils, and a coating of crystal white trichomes. Because these plants are dense with heavy colas, they can be susceptible to mold in the last few weeks of growth.
Because Aurora Indica plants grow short, they suit the indoor “sea of green (SOG)” growing method, which can yield up to 19.5 ounces per square foot. Aurora Indica can yield up to 23 ounces per plant in an outdoor growing environment.

Height

Characteristic of a true indica plant, Aurora Indica grows short and bushy, reaching only 30 to 40 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

You will need to control the humidity in an indoor environment to avoid mold and mildew in the final few weeks of growth. Your indoor grow space would benefit from some ventilation; in many cases, a dehumidifier will be necessary.
In an outdoor environment, Aurora Indica will thrive in a warm, sunny, south-facing position with daytime temperatures between 70 to 80 degrees Fahrenheit. However, this strain is challenging and has been known to survive colder outdoor temperatures. The colder temperatures will turn the buds a dark purple color.

Flowering

If you are growing your Aurora Indica indoors, it should flower around nine to 11 weeks. If you are growing your Aurora Indica outdoors, it should be ready to harvest by mid-September.

Name: Atomical Haze
Description: Atomical Haze is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain created by Paradise Seeds. It’s a cross between multiple strain types combining the best landrace strains, including original Haze, an Indian classic sativa, and Sweet Afghan. It has a kiwi taste and finishes with a classic Haze spice.
Growing:
Atomical Haze is a high-yield, sativa-dominant plant with explosive growth. Paradise Seeds list the difficulty level of this strain as medium to difficult. It can be grown indoors but thrives outdoors in a Mediterranean climate. It has a large bud production, uncommon for sativas, with 13.3 ounces per square yard (450 grams per square meter) for indoor grows. Outdoors, it can yield up to 28.2 ounces (800 grams) per plant.

Height

This plant is a tall strain growing up to 4 meters. As a result, the height of the plant is limited mainly by the size of the garden, which should be factored into indoor or greenhouse setups

Humidity and Temperature

This strain is highly resistant to mold and mildew because of the late harvest time and being a sativa-dominant strain.

Flowering

When grown outside, Atomical Haze plants have a relatively late harvest time, and the strain’s long flowering period results in a harvest in late October. Inside, the strain has a longer flowering time of around nine weeks. When harvesting at the end of the flowering period, the buds can be plucked from the plant like ripe fruit.

Name: Atomic Northern Lights
Description: Atomic Northern Lights is an indica-dominant strain (cultivar) with a moderate to high THC level of around 14%-24%. It’s known as a pungent strain with a sweet flavor. It also offers sour notes of lime and a punchy tobacco undertone with a touch of honey. Dr. Atomic Seeds is considered one of the closest versions of the original Northern Lights developed in the 80s. Atomic Northern Lights may help manage chronic pain, insomnia, and stress.
Growing:
The Atomic Northern Lights strain grows best in a warm environment. It’s a short, stocky plant with an indoor yield of around 0.5-1 ounce per square foot (300 frams per square meter). Outdoor yield is approximately 10-15 ounces per plant (400 grams per plant). Defoliating (removing dying or useless leaves) is encouraged to promote your plant’s growth. You can also try trellising your plant, which entails adding a supportive structure to help the plant to keep itself upright. Atomic Northern Lights tend to have relatively uniform growing characteristics and is an excellent choice for novice growers.

Height

Atomic Northern Lights can grow tall to around 30-60 inches (75-150 cm).

Humidity and Temperature

Ideally, humidity is something you want to carefully control when growing weed. Start with a humidity level of around 60%. Anything above this, and you may risk damaging your plant. Once you’re close to harvesting, around one to two weeks out, you can start lowering this humidity to around 40%.

Flowering

This strain has a somewhat longer flowering period. It tends to flower in eight to nine weeks indoors, so you can expect a harvest in mid-October when growing outdoors.

Name: Atomic
Description: The Atomic cannabis strain is an indica-dominant hybrid with 70% indica lineage. The strain was bred as a cross between a Chem Dawg/OG Kush hybrid and the THC Bomb strains by Bomb Seeds, and this breeding heritage hints at a mostly Afghani lineage. The olive green color of the plant is perfectly contrasted by its sunset orange hairs and trichomes. Users have reported that this strain (cultivar) helps manage stress, anxiety, and depression.
Growing:
The Atomic strain is very well suited to growing indoors, but like most plants, it can be grown inside or outside depending on your preference. If you’re new to growing cannabis, learning what you can about cannabis growing essentials is recommended before you start.

Height

Depending on whether it’s grown indoors or outdoors, Atomic plants can grow to reach heights between 2.6 and 6.5 feet (80-200 cm).

Humidity and Temperature

Seedlings need to be kept at humidities of about 60%, while plants in the vegetative stage can manage anywhere between 50% and 70%. When the plants start flowering, they must be drier at 50% humidity to prevent mold or rot.

Flowering

It takes about eight to nine weeks for Atomic plants to flower. They’ll start flowering between late September and early October if they’re grown outdoors. The color of pistils and trichomes can help you decide when to harvest. Atomic gives impressive yields, but there are some valuable tips for increasing your yield.

Name: Apple Fritter
Description:
Apple Fritter combines Animal Cookies and Sour Apple, created by Lumpy’s Flowers in Northern Carolina. It’s a fine example of misleading appearances, with buds looking fairly average in color, size, and number of pistils yet boasting extremely high THC levels of up to 32%. This gave it celebrity status, making it worthy of the High Times Hall of Fame of the World’s Strongest Strains.

The Apple Fritter is a multi-award-winning strain, mainly due to its strength and delicious flavor. It has a 50/50 indica-to-sativa ratio. Its unique terpene and cannabinoid profile make Apple Fritter an ideal strain (cultivar) for managing inflammation, chronic pain, and insomnia.

Apple Fritter combines the energizing effects of Sour Apple with the smooth relaxation of Animal Cookies. Both of its parents are strongly indica yet have produced evenly balanced offspring.

The strain is named after the famously sweet apple pie pastry, as its creators found it closely mimics the sweet taste. It’s sweet and apple-like on the inhale, with notes of vanilla on the exhale.
Growing:
Apple Fritter plants are bushy and grow to medium size. Unfortunately, as a relatively new strain, its growing information remains hard to come by. We know that it responds well to topping and trimming, helping you to maximize your yield.

Indoors you can expect a yield of around 10-15 ounces (425 grams) per plant, while outdoors, you’re looking at approximately 14-16 ounces per plant (400-450 grams). This strain isn’t the best when fighting off diseases, so it is something to be aware of if you want to grow it. Buds are dark olive green with fiery orange trichomes and silky purple undertones.

Height

The height your weed plant grows depends on a variety of factors. If you’re growing outdoors, giving your plants lots of space for the roots will allow them to reach around 5 feet (152 centimeters) tall. Having insufficient light exposure and smaller space will result in shorter plants.

Humidity and Temperature

Based on Apple Fritter’s parent strains, it thrives in a Mediterranean environment. Humidity control is fairly important with this strain, given its susceptibility to damage and disease. Keep humidity at 70% during the seedling stage and decrease this to 40% during the flowering stage to optimize the health of your buds.

Flowering

Flowering time is standard at around nine to 10 weeks. Growing outdoors, you can expect a harvest time around October.

Name: Ancient Kush
Description:
Ancient Kush, often called OG Kush, is a heavily indica-leaning hybrid with roots traced back to Iranian Landrace and Snow Lotus, though some still argue about its true lineage. This vintage strain has a THC concentration that dances between 15% and 21%, with CBD content usually falling below 1%. Its genetic makeup leans towards 85% indica and 15% sativa.

Ancient Kush has been noted for its sleep-inducing, stress-relieving, and mind-awakening effects, though newcomers should tread carefully due to its profound sedative properties. Ancient Kush’s respectable THC content makes it potentially useful in handling stress, migraines, and bouts of insomnia. It greets the palate with an unusual blend of cheese, skunk, and mint while leaving behind an earthy, citrusy aftertaste.

The strain’s robust resin-coated buds emit a medley of aromas, creating an exciting, energetic buzz before leading you gently toward your couch. As Ancient Kush’s influence gradually kicks in, users are often treated to a thought-provoking, introspective journey, concluding in deeply soothing sedation.
Growing:
You can easily buy Ancient Kush seeds online. Both experienced and beginner growers will find cultivating this strain rewarding.

Height

When grown indoors, Ancient Kush usually reaches 30-60 inches. The plants can grow taller outdoors, reaching 60-80 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

This strain prefers dry climates with low humidity. If you’re in a humid region, you must control the humidity for the plants to grow well.

Flowering

You’ll need to wait about nine to 10 weeks for Ancient Kush to flower. Each plant yields roughly 400 grams indoors and 500-550 grams outdoors.

Name: Amnesia Haze
Description:
Amnesia Haze is a cross between the Amnesia and Haze cannabis strains. This sativa-dominant hybrid comprises 80% sativa and 20% indica. The tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) content tests at a high 21% and has a low amount of cannabidiol (CBD) at less than 1%. Amnesia Haze has been reported as having euphoric, uplifting effects that could make it useful for managing stress, fatigue, and depression.

Amnesia Haze is often found in Amsterdam coffee shops. It earned first place in the 2004 Cannabis Cup and the 2012 Sativa Cup. While this hybrid contains Amnesia and Haze genetics, it also has roots in indica-dominant South Asian and Afghan Hawaiian strains and Jamaican sativas.

Amnesia Haze is a smooth and zesty smoke. Its flavor profile is dominated by sweet lemony citrus, with a sprinkle of spicy pepper that ends on an earthy exhale. Amnesia Haze gives the brain a workout with a strong creative high. The effects are reportedly uplifting and euphoric, with a psychedelic bend, making it a great strain to consume during the day.
Growing:
The Amnesia Haze is grown from feminized Soma seeds. The strain is not the easiest to grow for the novice cultivator. It requires some experience and ample room for the large plants to spread out. But care and attention can bring a satisfying, fruitful yield. The Amnesia Haze plan has a comparatively long harvest time of around 10 to 12 weeks. Growers can expect a yield of between 600 and 700 grams per square meter.

This strain grows happily outdoors in tropical environments, particularly in countries near the equator. The height of the plants can reach 60 inches (150 cm), adorned with heavy branches laden with flowers when grown in optimal conditions. Make sure to stake them to avoid breakage. If the local climate doesn’t permit long days of warmth and light, growing Amnesia Haze indoors at around 70-85 degrees Fahrenheit (21-30 degrees C) is best.

Important considerations for indoor growing include space, lighting, and nutrients. Growers should keep an eye on the plants getting too leggy and trim large leaves near the top to be sure light gets to the lower branches. Keep lights consistent at 600W. Don’t overwater; be careful not to overload the plants with nutrients.

The Amnesia Haze plant is tall and dense. Its buds are elongated and tend to sport a green-yellow hue with orange hairs. Trichome crystals are often abundant. The strain’s lemony flavor also comes through in the smell of the buds.

Height

This strain is tall and can grow up to 59 inches (150 cm) when grown indoors or outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

The Amnesia Haze strain likes a hot outdoor climate for optimal growing conditions or a hot environment created indoors with a humidity of around 60% to 70%.

Flowering

The cannabis flower of the Amnesia Haze strain has a long flowering time of 84 to 91 days.

Name: American Dream
Description:
The American Dream strain (cultivar) is a proprietary of Sensi seeds that provides a subtle cerebral high that could help manage stress, anxiety, and depression. This strain is named after its effects and has often been described as honest toil, personal improvement, and enjoying the fruits of one’s labor.

The American Dream Strain comes from breeding the Afghan Skunk strain with Jamaican and Hawaiian strains and contains moderate THC levels from 13% to 18%. This hybrid cannabis strain is heavily indica-dominant and produces a very pleasant high. It smells heavily of earth with skunky tones, making it a unique and well-rounded aroma. The high American Dream produces will leave you feeling balanced and uplifted.
Growing:
Marijuana can be grown indoors or outdoors, depending on your preference and climate. American Dream is a hybrid strain suitable for both environments, but indoor growing allows for greater control over growing conditions.

Height

American Dream is of moderate growing difficulty and is shorter than its peers when grown indoors and outdoors. The buds produced on this plant are rather dense, making this a compact plant. The short nature of this strain may make it easier for individuals with limited growing space.

Humidity and Temperature

The American Dream strain prefers a temperate or Mediterranean climate. However, it often thrives, like many other plants, on the warmer side of the scale. A benefit of this strain is that its lineage provides it resistance against high humidity and issues such as mold and mildew.

Flowering

The flowering time for American Dream is around seven or eight weeks if grown indoors. It tends to flower around September or October if grown outside. It has a relatively high yield, around 16 to 20 ounces per plant if grown indoors and 16 ounces if grown outside. The flowers are a dark green, coated in lighter trichomes, which makes it look like a forest laden with frost. Some say it even shines in the light.

Name: Alpine Blue
Description: The Alpine Blue strain is a slightly sativa-dominant hybrid cannabis strain (cultivar). It is made by crossing Blue Mystic with Power Plant, 60% sativa and 40% indica. This strain is ideal for daytime use due to its energizing effects, which could make Alpine Blue helpful in managing anxiety, depression, and fatigue. The Alpine Blue THC level hovers between 13%-15% and approximately 4% CBD.
Growing:
The Alpine Blue Strain is an easy strain for beginners. It can be grown indoors and outdoors, taking around 70 days until it’s ready to harvest. This strain produces long, dark green buds with deep blue undertones. Fine purple hairs and blue trichomes give the strain its trademark blue appearance.

Height

Although Alpine Blue weed is a sativa-dominant hybrid cannabis strain, the plant has indica phenotypes. Thus, it doesn’t grow as tall as its other sativa siblings, and it will usually reach around 60-80 inches and can also be grown indoors.

Alpine Blue typically produces a moderate to high yield, with indoor growers reporting an average yield of around 400-500 grams per square meter. Outdoor growers can expect a slightly higher yield, with some reporting yields of up to 600 grams per plant.

Humidity and Temperature

Keep the relative humidity high in the first few weeks of growing – at around 60%-80% – until the seedlings root. When the plant grows, reduce the humidity to about 50% to 70% to promote growth. When the strain begins to flower at around the seven-week mark, keep the plant at low humidity – around 40% RH – to prevent bud rot from forming.

Flowering

The Alpine Blue strain typically flowers in late September, and it usually takes seven to nine weeks to flower and will be ready to harvest in around 70 days. This strain has average yields when grown both indoors and outdoors. Indoors it will yield between .5 to 1 ounce per square foot, while it will yield between 10 and 15 ounces per plant outdoors.

Name: Alpha Express
Description:
Alpha Express Genetics created this strain, which grows dark olive green buds with amber hairs and matching trichomes that gain a red tint as the flowers mature.

As an introspective sativa strain, users of Alpha Express report an initial increase in the ability to focus while simultaneously providing a euphoric and slightly dreamy feeling.

With a THC (tetrahydrocannabinol) level of 19% to 21%, this strain of cannabis is classified as moderate to strong. THC is the compound that gives cannabis its “high” effects. Alpha Express has a very low cannabidiol (CBD) level. CBD is associated with medical benefits such as alleviating anxiety and improved cognition.

This strain is not recommended for first-time users, and the therapeutic cerebral effects make Alpha Express helpful in alleviating some of the symptoms of depression and bipolar disorder. The strain is best taken in the evening rather than during the day.
Growing:
Alpha Express can be grown in soil, coco coir, or hydroponic systems. Ensure the growing medium is well-draining and has the appropriate nutrient content. It requires a lot of light to grow, so using a high-intensity lighting system such as HID or LED is recommended. The recommended light cycle during the vegetative stage is 18-24 hours of light per day and 12 hours per day during the flowering stage.

Height

The Alpha Express strain grows to average height, generally at least 30 inches (2.5 feet). Alpha Express responds well to training techniques such as topping, low-stress training (LST), and scrogging to increase yields and promote even growth.

Humidity and Temperature

Alpha Express grows well in a warm, Mediterranean climate, with daytime temperatures between 70 to 80°F (21 to 27°C) and nighttime temperatures between 60 to 70°F (15 to 21°C). It can tolerate slightly higher temperatures but avoid extreme heat or cold.

Flowering

The flowering time for this strain is usually around 10 weeks but can be up to 12 weeks. The strain can produce a moderate to high yield, with indoor growers reporting yields of around 400 to 500 grams per square meter.

Name: Alpha Blue
Description:
Alpha Blue strain, also known as Dream Diesel or DD, is an award-winning sativa-dominant hybrid cannabis strain (cultivar) resulting from a cross of Blue Dream and NYC Diesel. This illustrious strain claimed two second-place awards for sativa breeds at High Times’ Medical Cup in both Denver and San Francisco.

Alpine Blue has a THC level of anywhere from 15% to 20% and provides a potent, dynamic, and fruity smooth smoke. Alpha Blue may be useful for managing stress, anxiety, depression, and chronic pain.
Growing:
The seeds for this plant are not available commercially, so if you wish to grow Alpha Blue, you will need to acquire a clone. It is also important to note that it is a moderately difficult strain to grow, so you may wish to have some experience before attempting it.

Height

This plant grows from 30 to 60 inches, both indoors and outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

As this is a developing strain, growers are still working out the most efficient cultivation techniques. Cannabis plants prefer a humidity of 65% to 70% as seedlings, which you should then lower to below 60%, preferably 40% to 50%, two weeks before flowering to avoid mold growing on the bud. After harvesting, buds should be cured on drying racks with air circulation for seven to 10 days with a humidity of around 50%. Be sure to check buds daily for signs of rot.

Flowering

This plant will flower in 56 to 70 days and be ready for harvest around the 77-day mark. The flowers will be of medium to large size and, surprisingly, tend to look more like flowers than typical buds. They also have inherited their parent strains’ beautiful purple and blue hues.
