Description:
Aloha Limone is an intriguing cross between Hawaiian Sunrise and Nina Limone strains, with THC levels ranging from 22 to 24%. It is well regarded for its unique scent, described as a “fruit tree rotting in the Kona sun.”

This cross is a proprietary of Colorado Seed Inc. and is sativa leaning. The body high and happiness this strain can provide leave users feeling energetic and ready to take on whatever the day throws at them.

Aloha Limone may be useful for alleviating stress, anxiety, and depression.
Growing:
Aloha Limonene can be grown indoors and outdoors, but indoor growing is recommended for the best results.

It requires a balanced nutrient regimen with a higher nitrogen content during the vegetative stage and a higher phosphorus and potassium content during the flowering stage. Aloha Limonene has a flowering time of around eight to 10 weeks and can produce a moderate to high yield of around 400-500 grams per square meter indoors. It responds well to training techniques such as topping, low-stress training, and scrogging. As with any cannabis strain, it’s important to monitor for pests and diseases regularly and take appropriate measures to prevent and treat any issues.

Height

Aloha Limone won’t tower over other strains, with an average height of around 30 to 60 inches. This height can be achieved either inside or out. This strain is commonly chosen for breeders as its offspring are sturdy, growing strong, disease-resistant stalks.

Humidity and Temperature

The Aloha Limone plant prefers a warm, Mediterranean climate with temperatures between 70-80°F during the day and 50-60°F at night. However, it is a relatively hardy plant with resistance to many diseases. It is an excellent choice for breeders, as its resistant nature means it can be grown outside of its recommended conditions.

Flowering

Aloha Limone takes around 72-84 days to flower, and harvesting time occurs around 90 days after planting, often in mid to late October. The flowers are bright and vibrant green, with large streams of orange and red covering their surface. The yield is relatively high, between 12-16 ounces when grown indoors and more than 16 ounces if grown outdoors.

This strain is known for its high THC content, which averages around 21% but can reach up to 24%. Aloha Grape Stomper is 60% sativa and 40% indica, making it a balanced hybrid that offers the best of both worlds.

Aloha Grape Stomper is known for its uplifting and euphoric effects, making it a popular choice for those seeking a mood boost. However, due to its high THC content, beginners should approach this strain with caution. The strain’s potential therapeutic benefits include stress relief, pain management, and appetite stimulation. Aloha Grape Stomper is said to have a unique flavor profile, with notes of sweet grape, tropical fruit, and earthy undertones.
Growing:
Aloha Grape Stomper plants are moderately challenging to grow, reaching a medium height with a substantial yield. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor cultivation, this strain is an ideal pick for growers with some experience.

Height

Aloha Grape Stomper plant’s size is moderate, reaching a medium height with robust stems. With proper care, cultivators can expect a bountiful yield.

Humidity and Temperature

The Aloha Grape Stomper strain flourishes most in a moderately warm climate. Cultivating indoors allows growers to regulate the ideal temperature and humidity levels.

Flowering

The flowering time for Aloha Grape Stomper is moderate, typically between nine to ten weeks.

Name: Allen Iverson OG
Description:
Allen Iverson OG is a potent indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain bred in California’s cannabis industry that boasts THC levels of around 23%.

Named after NBA legend Allen Iverson, the strain packs a punch. That’s because it was designed with users who are a bit more resistant to the effects of other strains in mind, although we cannot say for sure whether this strain (cultivar) delivers in this regard. The strain’s potency doesn’t come at the expense of flavor, though, with sweet, earthy tastes like pine and wood and some sour notes for balance. Allen Iverson OG (sometimes just “Allen Iverson”) has been reported to improve mood, increase appetite, and help induce sleep, making it ideal for anxiety, appetite loss, and insomnia.
Growing:
If you can get seeds, growing Allen Iverson OG is much the same as increasing many other cannabis plants. Typically, they can be grown inside or outside, and you can find specific tips for each environment with just a little research. If you’re just starting, find out about cannabis growing essentials. The predominantly indica genetics make Allen Iverson OG ideal for indoor grow tents, although some phenotypes may display more sativa-like traits that are preferable for a greenhouse grow.

Height

Depending on where the plant grows, this can vary, but the strain typically reaches less than 30 inches (76 cm) when grown indoors and between 60 and 80 inches (152-203 cm) when grown outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

The ideal humidity depends on the stage of the plant’s life cycle. Seedlings tend to do best at a humidity of around 60%, while plants in the vegetative stage can manage anywhere between 50% and 70%. However, when they start flowering, they need to be kept a little drier at 50% (sometimes lower) relative humidity to prevent rotting and disease.

Flowering

Cannabis plants usually take about six to 14 weeks to start flowering. In the case of Allen Iverson OG, it usually takes about 10 weeks. You can use the pistils’ color or trichomes to decide when they should be harvested. If you’re unimpressed with the amount your plants produce, some techniques can increase the yield of your harvest.

Name: All Gas OG
Description:
All Gas OG, formerly known as Asphalt Plant, is an indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain with a THC content averaging 21%. A cross between Humboldt OG and Venom OG strains, All Gas OG is pungent and skunky, with sedating effects. All Gas OG may help manage chronic pain, anxiety, and insomnia.

All Gas OG also has a pungent diesel flavor and has been named accordingly, with hints of sour citrus, pine, and earthy notes. With this mix of flavors, All Gas OG has no subtlety, which is something to keep in mind if you try to be discreet. Similarly, All Gas OG’s taste is not for the faint-hearted, so you might not enjoy its flavor complexities if you are a beginner or normally stick to mellower strains.
Growing:
All Gas OG can be grown both indoors and outdoors. According to growers who have grown All Gas OG in the past, this plant requires a little bit of experience, so it would not suit a novice grower. Feedback from other growers also suggested using some form of air filtration in indoor grow spaces — the pungent, skunky, diesel aroma is not subtle.

Being an indica strain, All Gas OG plants will be short and densely packed. Because of this, the “sea of green” (SOG) method can be used in indoor grow spaces to maximize the yield per square foot. The SOG method will require a more experienced grower as it is an advanced technique that involves packing the plants close together and reducing the airflow to the lower branches, increasing the chance of mold developing. Experienced growers will know how to prune their plants to help avoid this.

All Gas OG will produce dense, bright green buds with frosty white trichomes. Some growers have reported that exposing this strain to colder temperatures helps to bring out purple hues in the buds.

Height

Being indica dominant, All Gas OG will stay short and bushy. You can expect your plants to reach a height of between 30 and 60 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

The All Gas OG marijuana strain prefers a warm and dry climate with low to moderate humidity levels.

All Gas OG prefers daytime temperatures between 70-80°F (21-27°C) and nighttime temperatures between 60-70°F (15-21°C). The strain can tolerate slightly higher temperatures during the day, but extreme heat can cause damage to the plant.

All Gas OG prefers low to moderate humidity levels of around 40-50%. High humidity can promote the growth of mold and mildew, which can be harmful to the plant. To maintain the appropriate humidity level, it may be necessary to use a dehumidifier or air conditioning system.

Flowering

In an indoor environment, the flowering time for All Gas OG is around 55 days. If you are outdoors growing your plants, the buds should be ready to harvest between late September and mid-October.

Name: Aliens on Moonshine
Description:
The Aliens on Moonshine strain, a cross between the Sour Alien and White Moonshine strains, is 80% indica, 20% sativa and is a CBD-rich phenotype.

This strain has a low average THC level of 2.5%-5.5% with CBD levels of approximately 9%-16%, giving you a mellow, soothing high with great medicinal benefits. It has full-body sedative effects with limited psychoactivity, which means you can remain feeling relatively sober if you avoid excessive consumption. Aliens on Moonshine has sage, pine, and grapefruit flavors and may help manage stress, anxiety, and chronic pain.
Growing:
Sin City Seeds created aliens on Moonshine, and unfortunately, they have yet to release public access to the seeds. However, if you are an interested grower and manage to gain access to a mature plant, taking cuttings will allow you to clone the strain. Depending on the climate, aliens on Moonshine can be cultivated inside and outside.

Height

Plants of this strain grow into short bushes with small, broad leaves and branches that spread horizontally. Trimming new growth will increase this lateral growth, increasing the bud yield. Plants will usually grow 60-80 inches high.

Humidity and Temperature

This plant has great versatility regarding the temperature you can grow; however, it requires a specific humidity level. Humidity levels for seedlings usually need to be around 65%-70%, lowering to about 40%-50% a few weeks before flowering.

Flowering

The strain usually reaches the flowering stage in about eight to nine weeks. Flowers of Aliens on Moonshine have stunning colors, including deep greens, curly orange pistils, and purples that can be brought out by exposing your plant to colder temperatures at night. Ideally, this colder temperature would be close to freezing but above 41 degrees Fahrenheit.

Name: Alien Walker
Description: A cross between Albert Walker and Tahoe Alien, Alien Walker is a 60% indica and 40% sativa hybrid cannabis strain. Its tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) content tests between 19% and 22%, with little to no cannabidiol (CBD). As a medicinal application, Alien Walker can help manage chronic pain and some mental health conditions like anxiety, depression, PTSD, and stress.
Growing:
Alien Walker can be grown indoors and outdoors, but indoor growing is recommended for the best results.

The strain prefers a warm and dry climate, a high-quality growing medium, and a lot of light, which a 600-watt can provide HID lighting system.

Alien Walker requires a balanced nutrient regimen with a high nitrogen content during the vegetative stage and a higher phosphorus and potassium content during the flowering stage. It responds well to training techniques such as topping and low-stress training.

Height

The plant will grow to about 60 to 80 inches tall and sits on the larger end of the scale, regarding the excellent yield it can produce.

Indoors, the plant can reach around 19 grams per square meter. Growing outdoors can be more complicated if the climate improves, as Alien Walker is more of an indoor strain. However, if it’s grown correctly, the strain can grow up to 6 feet tall and produce up to 24.5 grams of buds per plant.

Humidity and Temperature

Ideal growing conditions for the Alien Walker strain take a lot of work. Generally, a high humidity level of 60% to 70% for the seedlings and cuttings will ensure the plants develop a stable root system. Keep the temperatures around 72 to 82 degrees Fahrenheit.

During the vegetative stage, lower the humidity levels down to 50%-60%. Finally, when the plant reaches its flowering stage, the humidity levels will be reduced from 40% to 50%. Adhering to the correct humidity and temperatures can lessen the plant’s chances of rotting, getting moldy, or dying. Once grown, the buds should be fluffy and covered with fine hairs.

Flowering

You can expect a flowering time of 49 to 65 days (six to eight weeks) for Alien Walker. The strain is generally ready for harvest at the 70-day mark.

Name: Alien Technology
Description:
Alien Technology, also known as Alien Tech, is one of several seed varieties an American soldier brought to the United States from Afghanistan. It was then named and bred by breeder OBSoull33t. Alien Technology is a pure indica marijuana strain with tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) levels of around 14%-19% and very low cannabidiol (CBD) content.

As with many marijuana strains, Alien Technology hasn’t explicitly been scientifically tested for efficacy due to many strains and relatively recent legalization. However, initial reports suggest that Alien Technology has the potential to relieve the symptoms of depression and anxiety temporarily.

The cured flower buds of Alien Technology aren’t commonly available for purchase, though Alien Technology seeds can be ordered from several sites online. Alien Technology has primarily been used as breeding stock to create the Alien family, known for strong, rapid effects. Alien Technology is renowned for having sustained effects beyond most strains, with noticeable effects still present up to six hours after inhalation.

Alien Technology can create euphoric effects and improve mood, energy, and creativity. After the initial effects have faded, the strain provides muscle relaxation and relief from chronic pain. Unlike most indica strains, Alien Technology doesn’t usually cause significant sedative effects, though it can be helpful in calming thoughts and relaxing the body before sleep.

Cured Alien Technology buds have a spicy, earthy aroma with a hint of fresh pencil shavings, cedar wood, and diesel. When inhaled, a rich herbal taste, a chemical bitterness, and a vanilla taste linger.
Growing:
Alien Technology is considered a reasonably easy-to-grow strain, tolerant to nutrient levels and temperature variations. Most growers will be able to grow the plant to harvest successfully.

However, bud production can vary greatly depending on growth conditions. If a high yield is desired, growers will need more experience in training techniques and fine-tuning temperature and light exposure.

Although the original Alien Technology is a photoperiod strain, feminized seeds are available and suited for indoor growing conditions. The resulting harvest may have slightly different characteristics than the photoperiod strain described in this article.

Alien Technology produces beautiful plants that are naturally Christmas tree-shaped with white frosted buds. The strain likely originated from cold regions of Afghanistan and is very tolerant of temperature variation. However, for best results, it shouldn’t be exposed to temperatures below 50 degrees Fahrenheit (10 degrees C) at night or above 80 degrees Fahrenheit (27 degrees C) during the day.

Height

Alien Technology grows between 30 and 60 inches (75 and 150 cm) tall indoors and outdoors. Plants respond well to training methods such as the “sea of green” method, where the stalks of young plants are bent horizontally to increase the number of vertical stems.

Humidity and Temperature

Alien Technology prefers a steady humidity of between 40% and 50% but benefits from some defoliation to prevent leaves from becoming too crowded.

Flowering

Light hours should be adjusted for flowering at around 68-75 days when grown indoors, and buds should be ready for harvest at approximately 82 days. Indoors, a yield of 0.5-1.0 ounces per foot (150–300 grams per square meter) can be expected. If grown outdoors, plants take around eight weeks before flowering and should flower in late September to early October.

Name: Alien Stardawg
Description:
Alien Stardawg is a sativa dominant cross between Alien Kush and Stardawg strains (cultivars). It’s well-known for its heavy-hitting, full-body effects, sweet cherry hash flavor, and smooth berry exhale.

Alien Starwdawg brings an intense and out-of-this-world high, beginning with a euphoric uplift that increases happiness, energy, creativity, and motivation for hours. It’s well suited for use in the morning or early afternoon to assist in keeping up productivity.

The tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) levels of Alien Stardawg vary greatly from 14% to 23%, with those lower-level THC percentages best suited for beginners and those suffering from anxiety and/or depression.
Growing:
Alien Stardawg possesses the typical characteristics of sativa plants: tall with thin stalks that are feeble and may break easily in conditions like strong winds or heavy rain. It can be grown indoors and outdoors, but lengths should be taken to protect these plants from harsh conditions. These plants are great candidates for the “screen of green” growing method. Hydroponic setups will also improve the yield and trichome production of Alien Stardawg, but this is not a requirement as the plants also flourish in soil.

The strain’s buds are relatively small and light green with blue, red, and purple undertones. Each nug is often dusted with a coating of white crystal trichomes. Due to these factors, Alien Starwdawg best suits growers with at least some experience.

Height

Alien Stardawg can grow up to 7 feet (210 cm) tall if not contained.

Humidity and Temperature

Alien Stardawg flourishes when grown at low levels of humidity.

Flowering

When grown indoors, Alien Stardawg flowers between 10 and 12 weeks and produces 12-16 ounces per square meter. Outdoor growers should expect flowers from the very end of October to mid-November with 16 ounces per plant yield.

Name: Alien Rock Candy
Description:
Alien Rock Candy, or Alien Candy, is an indica-dominant hybrid made by Alien genetics by crossing the Sour Dubble and Tahoe Alien strains. It delivers a fruity citrus aroma with sour hints from the terpene profile that originates from the Sour Dubble parents.

The flowers of Alien Rock Candy aren’t visually impressive. They’re sticky, covered in silver resinous trichomes. The buds are dense and small, arranged in a popcorn-like formation. The leaves are a shade of forest green with hairy rust-colored pistils.

This marijuana strain is particularly potent, delivering a powerful punch followed by a sedative effect despite containing low CBD and THC levels compared to other strains.

The taste of Alien Rock Candy is uniform throughout the bud, delivering fruity and citrus flavors. The candied sweet aroma and flavor develop into a pungent earthy aftertaste. The great taste makes it a good ingredient in edibles, cannabutter, oil, and wax.
Growing:
The Alien Rock Candy strain is an excellent plant for beginner growers. It can be cultivated indoors and outdoors and, once established, does not require much care.

Like other strains, Alien Rock Candy contains resinous trichomes, making it more resistant to mold.

Most growers cultivate this strain indoors, so a hydroponic setup alongside the “sea of green” (SOG) technique is recommended to achieve maximum yields. Hydroponics involves using a nutrient-enriched liquid for the plant’s roots and allows the roots to have maximum surface area for nutrient uptake. The SOG method consists in securing a screen above the canopy of the plants and tying the plant to the screen as it grows. This technique allows all branches and leaves to be exposed to sunlight while efficiently using space in a growing chamber.

Height

Due to its indica genetics, the Alien Rock Candy strain requires more vertical space to flourish. It can grow up to 6 feet.

Humidity and Temperature

Alien Rock Candy requires a “Mediterranean” climate with temperatures between 69.8 and 80.6 degrees Fahrenheit (21 to 27 degrees Celsius).

Flowering

Alien Rock Candy begins to flower between seven and eight weeks. It produces medium-large yields of 18 ounces per square meter when cultivated indoors and 18 ounces per plant when cultivated outside. The buds gradually open to reveal the thick, milky resin that creates a lemon aroma.

Name: Alien Rift
Description:
Alien Rift is a strongly indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain (cultivar) initially bred by Ocean Grown Seeds Co. It has a highly variable cannabinoid content with reported tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) values ranging from 18% to 30%. Although cannabidiol (CBD) concentrations are generally reported as very low, other cannabinoids, such as cannabigerol (CBG), are present in higher than usual concentrations.

Alien Rift is used primarily as an analgesic (painkiller) and sedative. It also provides calming and uplifting effects, which can help relieve depression and anxiety. Alien Rift is noteworthy for being less likely to cause paranoia than other strains, making it useful for those managing post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).
Growing:
Alien Rift is a photoperiod cannabis variety. It benefits from extra vegetative time and training methods such as topping.

This strain is considered medium difficulty growing as it requires fine-tuning of humidity, temperature, and light cycles to achieve a high yield.

Height

Alien Rift is naturally short, and training methods such as topping further reduce the height until the plant is not likely to grow higher than 3 feet (1 meter). Plant height doesn’t seem to differ significantly between indoor and outdoor plants.

Humidity and Temperature

Alien Rift prefers mild to moderate humidity, with temperatures around 70 to 80 degrees Fahrenheit (21-27 degrees C). The plant may benefit from regular defoliation of larger leaves to improve ventilation and increase light exposure.

Flowering

Ocean Grown Seeds recommends a longer-than-usual vegetative stage to maximize harvest. Flowering should be induced at around eight to 10 weeks if grown indoors. If grown outside, plants are ready for harvest in mid-October.

Name: Alaska Thunder Grape
Description:
Alaska Thunder Grape, aka “Grape Thunder,” is an equally balanced hybrid strain (cultivar) that lives up to its unique name. It produces an invigorating head-to-toe high that will give you the creative boost you’ve been looking for and enough relaxation to take the edge off. Some may utilize this strain to manage stress, fatigue, and depression.

Alaska Thunder Grape was created in Sonoma County by crossing the genetics of Grape Ape and Matanuska Thunder Fuck (sometimes called “Matanuska Tundra”). Grape Ape’s history is based on the landrace strains of the Afghan mountains. If those names aren’t enough to capture your interest, this strain offers a delicious flavor combination of lavender and hibiscus. It boasts high THC levels of 18%-22% so expect its potent effects to hit your head fast.
Growing:
This strain produces tightly wound purple buds with bright orange hairs and crystal trichomes. It was designed to resist changes in an outdoor growing environment. It offers a yield of 1-2 ounces per square foot (400 g/m2) and 15-20 ounces per plant (550 g/plant) if grown outdoors.

Height

Alaska Thunder Grape grows to an average height of around 30-60 inches (75-150 cm).

Humidity and Temperature

As with most strains of cannabis, Alaska Thunder Grape thrives in a warm, Mediterranean-like climate. It initially responds well with a higher humidity of around 70%, which can be lowered gradually toward the flowering stage to about 30%-40%. This reduces the risk of mold.

Flowering

The short flowering time of this strain – only eight to nine weeks – is another reason it has become such an excellent option for growing.

Description:
AK-48 is a potent indica-dominant hybrid strain (cultivar) with 65% indica and 35% sativa. AK-48 was created by Nirvana Seeds, a cannabis company from the Netherlands, and was made by the cross between the strains Jock Horror and Ice. This strain delivers a tropical aroma of pineapple, mango, and blueberry and looks just as enticing with its burnt-orange pistils and crystal trichomes.

This marijuana strain is not considered particularly potent compared to other strains, but AK-48 can still deliver a powerful punch of energy followed by a sedative effect that is both euphoric and relaxing. Despite containing less-than-average cannabidiol (CBD) and tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) compared to other strains, AK-48 is a great social strain that delivers an energetic and happy high ideal for managing anxiety, depression, and fatigue.
Growing:
AK-48 is a strain that is perfect for beginner growers due to its ability to survive in any climate and its resistance to pests and mold. This specific strain can be grown both indoors and outdoors with no problems, but techniques such as the “sea of green” (SOG) or “screen of green” methods (ScrOG) can be utilized to produce higher yields with improved quality. However, when it comes to growing this strain, it is important to note that AK-48 has a strong, pungent aroma, so it should be grown in a well-ventilated area away from neighbors.

Height

AK-48 is an easy strain to grow, reaching a medium height of up to 50 inches (120 cm).

Humidity and Temperature

AK-48 grows best in a Mediterranean climate, but this strain is resistant to lower temperatures and can, therefore, be grown indoors and outdoors with high yields.

Flowering

The AK-48 strain grows quickly, with flowering occurring in around seven weeks or 49-63 days. Additionally, the yield of AK-48 is high, with a yield of about 400-500 grams per square meter.

This rough-sounding name doesn’t reflect its effects well, with users commonly reporting mellow feelings mixed with happiness and relaxation, making it ideal for managing stress, anxiety, and depression. Some growers use air filtration to keep fungal spores to a minimum for this mold-prone strain.

AK-47 differs from other strains regarding humidity preferences, enjoying 65% to 70% range early in the vegetative stage, but dropping to as low as 30% humidity for the later vegetative and flowering stages.

Flowering

AK-47 can be grown indoors and outdoors. When grown indoors, flowering will take place in seven to nine weeks. Outdoor growing behaviors depend on location. AK-47 is ready to harvest in October.

Description:
Air Jordan OG is a 100% indica cannabis strain (cultivar) with THC levels between 15% and 20%, but it may be possible to find Air Jordan OG genetics with as low as 11% THC. Its lineage is unknown, but it is said to obtain some of its genetics from Kush strains. Bred by California breeder Good as Gold, Air Jordan OG is a primarily sedative strain and is particularly effective for nighttime use. Air Jordan OG may be useful for managing chronic pain, insomnia, and stress.

Air Jordan OG users report a tasteful combination of sweet and spicy flavors. The high begins with euphoria before its indica heritage inspires a relaxed state.
Growing:
Air Jordan OG is a rare strain, and growers will have trouble finding seeds to grow these plants privately. Because of this, there aren’t many cultivation tips available.

This strain produces fluffy buds with a purple tinge. They are lightly dusted with a sprinkling of white trichomes.

Height

Air Jordan OG reaches a height of 30-60 inches indoors and 60-80 inches outdoors.  Growers can expect a yield of 400 grams per square meter indoors and 550 outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

Air Jordan thrives best in a sunny, hot climate. This ensures a rapid growth time and a full, rich bud. Given enough nutrients, including water and recurring trims, this plant thrives in tropical or hot climates, including the Mediterranean and California. When growing indoors, keep the relative humidity between 50%-60%. Temperatures should stay at 70-80 degrees Fahrenheit (21-26 C).

Flowering

The flowering time for the Air Jordan OG strain is roughly seven to nine weeks.

Description: The Agent Orange strain is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain (cultivar) made by MzJill Genetics. Height

The Agent Orange strain can grow tall due to its sativa nat, and the plant can grow up to 10 feet tall outdoors. Therefore, if you grow Agent Orange indoors, you must train the strain into a bush to keep it short.

Humidity and Temperature

The Agent Orange cannabis strain does well in warm temperatures of around 72-78 degrees Fahrenheit. During the vegetative state, the humidity level should be kept at about 60%-65%. When the strain is flowering, reduce the humidity to around 40%-50% to avoid bud rot.

Flowering

Agent Orange’s flowering time is between 55 and 65 days. If grown indoors, you can expect 16 ounces of bud per square meter and a whopping 19 ounces per plant outdoors. The Agent Orange strain produces beautiful buds with crystal trichomes and dark orange hairs.

Name: Agape
Description:
A cross between Shasta Grape and Black Cherry, Agape is 60% sativa and 40% indica. Its THC content ranges between 12% and 20%, with less than 1% CBD. Agape has been described as having arousing, uplifting effects and a flavor reminiscent of tea, grape, and tropical fruits. Users have described Agape as helpful in managing cramps, ocular pressure (glaucoma), and depression.

Agape is a bit of a mysterious strain (cultivar) with many different dispensaries giving conflicting information on its cannabinoid content and history. While some information sources have nothing to say about the strain’s background, others only offer up “Justin” as the breeder when he was working at Trinity Sacred Rootz based in America.

Agape provides a lovely smoke with a mix of tropical and fruity flavors, giving users a tingly, inspiring, and euphoric high. This rare, sativa-dominant strain is an excellent choice for a morning bowl. If you can try this premium bud, make sure you stock up. You’ll likely have one chance, as this strain is rare.
Growing:
Agape is not particularly challenging to cultivate, sitting roughly in the middle of the difficulty spectrum. If you are considering growing this strain, be aware that there is relatively little growing information available specific to this strain, and you may need trial and error to find what works best for this strain.

Height

Agape cannabis plants generally grow between 30 and 60 inches when grown indoors and upwards of 90 inches outdoors. Bear this in mind when setting up your growing operation.

Humidity and Temperature

There is no humidity information available specifically for the Agape strain. In general, cannabis plants require between 40% and 50% relative humidity, though some appreciate humidity up to 90%.

Flowering

Flowering times for Agape range between 50 days and 63 days, depending on growing conditions. Harvesting of Agape is usually possible around day 69, yielding 1-2 ounces of bud per square foot when grown indoors and roughly 15-20 ounces per plant outdoors.

Name: Afternoon Delight
Description:
Afternoon Delight (or Afternoon Delite) is a hybrid cannabis strain created by Colorado Seed Inc. It is an indica-dominant strain that is incredibly potent and great for relaxation and pain relief.

Afternoon Delight results from a cross between Banana, Schrom, and Tangie strains. Citrus flavors, rich pine, and skunky diesel give this strain a tropical punch, perfect for chilling out at the beach or hanging out on the deck on a sunny day. You may have heard the song lyrics “skyrocket in flight, afternoon delight,” but not everyone knows what it is about. Bill Danoff wrote it after visiting a cafe that offered a set of smaller food dishes called “Afternoon Delight.”

This got his creative juices flowing, and he used the name as a euphemism for the feeling you get during a sexual high. This is the perfect analogy for this particular strain, which is sometimes referred to as “herbal Viagra,” thanks to its strong body high coupled with feelings of euphoria.

Both the taste and smell are tropical in nature, with citrus, pine, and chunky diesel notes. This strain is known for its small, dense buds, which are accentuated with thin orange hairs and sticky resin.

This strain has a high indica and sativa ratio: It is unknown what the exact content is, but a good guess would be around 70% indica and 30% sativa.
Growing:
Seeds for Afternoon Delight are hard to come by, which is why this can be a difficult plant to grow (you need to find a supplier first). The reason behind the difficulty in obtaining the seed is that the plant is not easy to grow and is recommended to those who have grown marijuana and understand the various issues that can arise.

As it can be a finicky grower, it is important to pay Afternoon Delight plants a lot of attention by pruning regularly and topping to ensure that it grows in a smaller space (increasing the flowering potential). This plant grows best under the “screen of green” technique, which means installing a lattice above the canopy and weaving branches into it. This encourages bud production, evens light distribution and encourages lower nodes to move up to the light.

Height

Indica, sativas, and hybrid strains all grow differently. There isn’t much information available about the height Afternoon Delight grows to, but you can expect it to grow to around 3-6 feet tall as a hybrid strain.

Humidity and Temperature

When growing indoors, you need to keep the plant in a Mediterranean environment, so you will need to keep humidity at 65%-75% during the seedling stage and 40%-50% during the vegetative stage.

If you are growing it outdoors, keep it away from harsh weather conditions, as cold snaps will kill the plant overnight.

Flowering

The flowering time of Afternoon Delight is approximately eight to 10 weeks indoors. The strain flowers outdoors from mid-to-late October.

Name: African
Description:
The African Cannabis strain is a purebred landrace strain (variety). It is a pure sativa with 10% THC and little CBD content. “African” is usually a blanket term for any cannabis from Africa, such as Durban Poison, Malawi Gold, Swazi Gold, Swazi Redbeard, Kilimanjaro, Angola Gold, and many others.

t is a popular group of strains for daytime use due to its energizing, euphoric effects, which could make them helpful in managing stress, anxiety, fatigue, and depression. Although African cannabis varieties can be difficult to grow, growers who are up to the challenge can achieve a high yield and a plant with unique chemical characteristics.
Growing:
African cannabis varieties have adapted to grow in African climates; therefore, they tend to thrive in hot climates with low humidity. This may be challenging to achieve, especially for novice growers, and this makes it a group of strains that are best tackled by people with some experience growing cannabis. However, if successful, the African strain produces above-average yields. Its flowering period can vary depending on the plant’s genetics, but expect anything between eight and 14 weeks. African cannabis varieties produce leafy and bright green buds with tiny orange hairs.

Height

Like other sativas, the African Cannabis strain can grow upwards of 8 feet. If you decide to grow this strain indoors, it may be ideal to trim the plant’s tops to limit its height. In ideal outdoor climates, the African strain will grow very tall.

Humidity and Temperature

African cannabis is from Africa, so it requires hot, dry climates to thrive, and this is usually what makes growing African cannabis genetics so challenging. This strain must be grown in relatively low humidity in either hot climates or temperature-controlled systems, and high humidity is the number one killer of African cannabis strains.

Flowering

Flowering time can vary with African cannabis, lasting between eight and 14 weeks, depending on the phenotype. Outdoors in the Northern Hemisphere, African cannabis varieties should flower around mid-October, depending on the climate in which it is grown. After it flowers, it will produce a respectable yield of around 14 ounces per plant when grown outdoors and 12 ounces per square meter when grown indoors.

Name: Afpak
Description:
Afpak, named after its Afghani and Pakistani genetics, is an indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain that instantly provides strong calming benefits. The indica-to-sativa ratio of Afpak is 70:30.

Users benefit from the cerebral and physical effects of Afpak, leading to a euphoric and relaxed state.

The tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) levels of Afpak are moderate at around 21%, only slightly higher than average. This level of THC is what contributes to Afpak’s cerebral euphoric effects.

Due to the deeply calming effects of Afpak, its use is better suited to the evening to assist in unwinding before bed. Afpak may be particularly useful for managing chronic pain, insomnia, and stress.
Growing:
Afpak is a robust cannabis strain that’s easy to grow and manage, making it an excellent plant for beginners. It’s adaptable to different growing conditions, although it flourishes outdoors where adequate sunlight provides enough energy to produce extensive, trichome-laden flowers.

The high trichome production means each harvest is filled with strong, hashy buds coated thickly in sticky resin. This makes it a popular plant for those wishing to develop extracts.

Afpak plants are beautiful and inviting, with deep green leaves and lime-colored buds. The plants may also exhibit purple undertones depending on the climate.

Afpak has a sweet aroma with earthy undertones of pine. When combusted, it produces a spicy smoke with herbal undertones and leaves an earthy aftertaste at exhalation.

Height

Afpak plants grow to an average height of 7 feet tall.

Humidity and Temperature

Afpak is a robust plant that can grow anywhere and adapt to various weather conditions.

If you want to ensure you get the most out of your Afpak plant, maintaining moderate temperature and humidity levels is best.

Flowering

Afpak has an indoor flowering period of eight to 10 weeks, while outdoor plants mature around mid-October.

Growers can expect between 10 to 12 ounces of buds per square meter for indoor plants and an excellent yield of 12 ounces per plant for outdoor plants.

Name: Afgoo
Description:
A cross between Afghani and Maui Haze, Afgoo — or Afgooey — is an indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain with a THC content of 18% and classic indica effects that will send you off into a blissful sleep. This strain (cultivar) may be ideal for managing stress, insomnia, and chronic pain.

Created by Green House Seeds, a highly decorated seed company out of Amsterdam, the Afgoo strain is one for the books. With quick-hitting, long-lasting effects and buds so resinous and sticky they’re almost gooey, Afgoo is a strain you must try.

Afgoo is the product of Afghani and Maui Haze strains. Afghani, a pure indica landrace strain, gives Afgoo’s strong indica effects and skunkiness. Maui Haze, a sativa-dominant hybrid strain, gives Afgoo’s sweet earthy flavor with hints of spice.

Afgoo buds are small and densely packed, ranging from elongated to spherical or cylindrical. Whatever the shape, these buds are vibrant green with a twist of long orange hairs and high amounts of gooey resin. The distinct resin these buds produce gives Afgoo its peculiar name.
Growing:
Afgoo used to be a clone-only strain, but it’s now readily available as feminized seeds.  The strain is a robust and vigorous plant that can survive most conditions due to its Afghani genes, but it does require regular topping, to keep airflow and light circulating the lower branches.

Afgoo can be grown indoors and outdoors, rewarding growers with high yields. Afgoo’s large plants can produce 32 ounces per square meter in an indoor grow space and 35 ounces per plant in an outdoor space.

Being an indica-dominant strain, Afgoo plants are textbook indica with a short, bushy structure and densely packed buds. A hydroponic system or the “sea of green” method are good ways to capitalize on Afgoo’s size and maximize your yields.

Afgoo’s aroma is pungent, which makes it hard to be discreet. If you are growing your Afgoo outdoors, plant it in a well-ventilated area. Growing Afgoo indoors requires that you have fans in your grow space to help with airflow and ventilation.

Height

Afgoo grows like a true indica strain, so it won’t reach an impressive height, likely around 40 to 50 inches tall.

Humidity and Temperature

The Afgoo weed strain thrives in a semi-humid environment with daytime temperatures between 70 and 80 degrees Fahrenheit. However, its landrace genetics allow this strain to survive colder temperatures.

Flowering

Expect eight to nine weeks if flowering indoors. For outdoor plants, they will be ready to harvest by late September to mid-October.

Ace of Spades has some top-rated children, including the Jack of Spades and CBG Blend strains.

The Ace of Spades strain is one of the larger cannabis plant varieties. Users are recommended to grow these plants in spacious areas as they grow tall and very bushy, and these plants are also relatively dense and heavy.

Ace of Spades is an easy-to-grow plant that prefers warm and sunny climates outdoors. Its ideal climate is the Mediterranean; however, it is resistant to common mold and mildew so it can be grown in damper climates.

Ace of Spades looks just as beautiful as it tastes, with multicolor buds flourishing after around eight weeks. These can have vibrant purple, blue, pink, or orange hairs running through them, with sparkling white trichome crystals. When grown indoors, the yield is around 23 ounces per square meter, and when grown outside, it yields approximately 19 ounces per plant.

Ace Killer OG is an indica-dominant strain resulting from crossing White Fire OG, King’s Kush, Kosher Kush, and an unnamed mystery strain. Grown across the world, Ace Killer OG boasts indica-heavy traits that lend themselves to both medical and recreational use. This strain of cannabis will start off giving you a heady and happy high, followed by more body-based effects.

A cloud will descend over your head a few minutes after ingestion, freeing you despite the mental fog. The body effects follow shortly after, bringing a sedative weight and locking you into your current position on the couch. Many users report experiencing excessive “munchies,” perhaps due to alleviating nausea and stress. Make sure you have some good snacks nearby before dosing with this strain.

Ace Killer OG is meant to be savored and enjoyed like a rare scotch. White trichomes, olive green nugs, and amber hairs give Ace Killer OG a distinct look.

Ace Killer OG plants will grow between 30 and 60 inches regardless of growing location. Plants grown indoors and outdoors can reach a maximum height of 60 inches if nutrients, water, sunlight, and other factors are optimal.

You can try setting up a few different grow rooms with varying levels of humidity to see what works best for your location.

Flowering

The flowering time for Ace Killer OG plants is between 58 and 61 days, depending on location-specific factors. This strain will be triggered to flower by altering the amount and type of light provided (referred to as the “photoperiod”).

Name: ACDC
Description:
The ACDC strain (cultivar) is perfect for treating various medical conditions due to its high levels of CBD. The CBD to THC ratio, reported to be 20:1, shows this strain helps obtain marijuana’s medical benefits without intoxication. ACDC may help manage anxiety, neuropathic pain, and epilepsy.

The ACDC strain is not named after the rock band but is an acronym for “Alternative Cannabinoid Dietary Cannabis.” The strain was given its name by the original breeder, Northern California physician Dr. William Courtney in 2011. He acquired the seeds from Barcelona and crossed them with Cannatonic and Ruderalis strains hoping they’d help with his wife’s lupus. Dr. Courtney’s intention is for it to be used as an (unheated) dietary supplement.

This hybrid blend has an equal balance between indica and sativa components. Users have reported that it is an uplifting blend that allows concentration and intense calmness. It is primarily used for its therapeutic effects.
Growing:
ACDC requires some skill and is not generally recommended for beginner growers. It can be grown outdoors but is most commonly grown indoors.

Height

ACDC is a bushy plant that can grow to around 4 feet tall with large buds and leaves with a tinge of purple.

Humidity and Temperature

This strain is very fussy about the temperature and climate, so regulating indoor room temperature (around 68-80 degrees Fahrenheit) or time of year (harvesting around October) are important factors. For indoor growing, humidity should be less than 60% and ideally around 40%-50%.

Flowering

The strain takes approximately 10-12 weeks to flower indoors or slightly longer if grown outside. Before harvesting, ACDC can reach about 4 feet with purplish leaves and large buds. The yield is medium.

Name: Acapulco Gold
Description:
Acapulco Gold is one of the highly sought-after sativa-dominant strains and is considered a cult classic. It originates from Acapulco, Mexico, and was popularized in America in the ’60s, becoming well known for its potent high and euphoric effects.

This strain has a relatively high THC content, ranging from 18% to 25%. However, its CBD levels are practically nonexistent. Acapulco Gold may be useful for managing anxiety, depression, and chronic fatigue.

Experienced users feel a joyful, energizing high, making it popular for morning or daytime use. However, novices must be aware that its potent effects may be overwhelming and should approach this strain cautiously.

Acapulco Gold is a popular strain, considered by many as being “top-shelf” or “connoisseur cannabis.” Many users enjoy its energizing, euphoric effects, so much so that it earned its place on High Times magazine’s Greatest Strains of all Time list. Its name is a nod to its beginnings in Acapulco, Mexico, while the “Gold” in its name is due to its golden brown buds.
Growing:
Acapulco Gold is relatively difficult to grow as no clear guidelines are available. However, the strain has grown best in conditions resembling its indigenous Mexican climate.

Height

If grown indoors, the plant reaches up to 3.6 feet tall. However, the plant can be grown outdoors, where it grows significantly taller, up to 6.6 feet. Therefore, many prefer to grow this plant outdoors to maximize its growth potential.

Humidity and Temperature

Acapulco Gold grows best in conditions similar to its origins in Acapulco, Mexico: a warm and humid climate. The minimum humidity is around 40%, and can tolerate up to 85%. The strain also enjoys high temperatures of between 68 and 83 degrees Fahrenheit.

Flowering

The Acapulco Gold flowering time is around 60-75 days. The strain has a long growing season and will be ready to be harvested around mid-October, depending on growth conditions. When ready for harvest, it produces average yields of around 17 ounces per square meter and up to 53 ounces per plant if grown outdoors.

Name: Acai Berry Gelato
Description:
A cross between Pink Panties and Sunset Sherbet strains (cultivars), Acai Berry Gelato is a sativa-dominant hybrid of 70% sativa and 30% indica. Its tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) level is a moderate 15%-19%, with cannabidiol (CBD) content of less than 1%. Acai Berry has been reported as having uplifting, talkative effects and a lemony, piney, flowery, berry flavor. Acai Berry may be useful for managing stress, anxiety, depression, headaches, ADHD, and lack of appetite.

The Acai Berry Gelato strain is a sativa-dominant strain bred by Sherbinskis, the founders of several gelato family strains. It offers a full-flavored smoke with sweet and fruity notes, hints of earth reminiscent of other gelato strains, and a slightly sour tropical exhale. The Acai Berry Gelato high is reportedly carefree, uplifting, and non-sedating, making it a perfect daytime option.
Growing:
The Acai Berry Gelato plant is tall and has slender leaves that reflect its sativa genes with tight bunches of dense buds. The deep green buds show purple hints and thin, orange hairs with tiny, deep amber crystal trichomes.

This strain is considered challenging to grow partly because the strain is mainly sold online as clones. However, if you can get your hands on the original strain and have the chance to grow it yourself, it’s usually a little hardier and more forgiving than indicas.

Acai Berry Gelato can be grown outdoors and indoors; however, its sativa-heavy genetics means that the plants can grow up to 6 feet tall, making growing them indoors tricky. The outdoor yield size is about 15-20 ounces per plant (approximately 550 g/plant), while the indoor yield size is 1-2 ounces per square foot (about 400 g/m²). If you are growing the plants inside, keep the grow room warm and dry, and ensure that the cannabis plants receive adequate exposure to light. The Acai Berry Gelato strain is a photoperiod flower, which means it needs over 12 hours of darkness to initiate the flowering phase properly.

Height

This strain grows tall and can reach a height of 60-80 inches (152-203 cm) when grown indoors or outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

In general, all Gelato cannabis strains thrive in warm and humid environments. If you are not cultivating in a region with a warm and humid climate, it is recommended that you try to replicate the conditions indoors.

Flowering

The Acai Berry Gelato strain has an average flowering time of 58-61 days.

Name: Abomination
Description:
Abomination is not a strain for newbies — with THC levels as high as 30%, this strain packs a real punch. We don’t know the exact combination of strains used to create Abomination. Still, we know it’ll provide you with a heady cerebral high that could make it helpful in managing stress, depression, chronic fatigue, and ADHD.

Abomination is a hybrid strain containing 50% indica and 50% sativa. This well-balanced strain is characterized by its massive THC hit. Make sure you’re ready for Abomination; this strain will immediately provide a powerful cerebral impact that can leave you unfocused, energized, and a little giddy.

This strain has a robust and sweet lemon flavor with notes of pine, herbs, black pepper, and a little spice. In terms of scent, Abomination smells of lemon and burning will add a layer of sourness and spice to the aroma.
Growing:
Abomination is quite an easy plant to grow, making it an excellent option for those with beginner skills wanting to grow a strong bud. Abomination will grow indoors and outdoors, allowing you much flexibility in your setup.

Height

When grown indoors, your Abomination plant will reach somewhere between 30 to 60 inches. Outside, you’ll get a little more height, with plants reaching around 60 to 80 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

Flowering

Abomination plants will take 54 to 63 days to flower, with harvesting best done on the last day of blooming.

Name: Aberdeen
Description:
The Aberdeen strain (cultivar) is a 75% sativa-dominant hybrid known for improving mood and decreasing chronic pain. Aberdeen is a cross between Orange Velvet and Jack the Ripper cannabis varieties developed by MzJill and TGA Subcool. Another strain, Agent Orange, is produced by the same hybridization. However, the two are different in looks and phytochemistry and can be considered different strains.

Aberdeen has a moderate THC content at 15%-17% with negligible amounts of CBD. Although the strain is low in THC, users report it is very potent and should be consumed in moderation. Aberdeen has been said to help manage anxiety, PTSD, depression, and cramps.
Growing:
Aberdeen seeds have never been released by the parent company, Aphria, which only sells dried flowers and extracts. Aphria considers all information on the growing conditions of Aberdeen to be proprietary and has not published any details. Therefore, the following advice is on growing similar strains, including Agent Orange and parent strains Orange Velvet and Jack the Ripper.

Aberdeen prefers a slightly cooler temperature than other strains, at around 65 to 85 degrees Fahrenheit. Ventilation is necessary, as all closely related strains are vulnerable to mold in high humidity and low airflow conditions.

Due to the lack of information, training, and ventilation requirements, this strain is not recommended for first-time growers.

Height

The height of Aberdeen’s parent and sister strains can vary dramatically, with Agent Orange reaching up to 10 feet when grown outdoors. However, as Aberdeen has been bred to be cultivated indoors, it is likely best topped or trained using the “sea of green” method, through which the young, flexible stems are trained to grow horizontally. This method can expect to reach heights of around 2 feet.

Humidity and Temperature

No specific information is available on the humidity preferred by Aberdeen. An average humidity of 50 percent is well tolerated by related strains and is least likely to cause damage to the plants. However, this may not be the optimal humidity, and growers may wish to experiment.

Due to potential mold issues, it may be advisable to perform some defoliation to maintain proper airflow and humidity. Water should be applied only to the plants’ soil and not to the plants themselves.

Flowering

Aberdeen’s parent strains and Agent Orange all flower at around eight to 10 weeks when grown inside (October when grown outside), and Aberdeen can be expected to do the same. No information is available on whether Aberdeen is an auto-flowering variety.

Aberdeen produces deep olive green buds with fiery orange or red pistils and amber trichomes.

Name: A-Dub
Description:
A-Dub strain is a renowned indica-dominant strain (80% indica, 20% sativa) known for its high potency and complex flavor. It earned second place in the High Times “Earth’s Strongest Strains” list in 2014. A-Dub has been described as having a chemical, diesel, peppery flavor and relaxing, euphoric effects. Patients have reported that this strain (cultivar) helps manage stress, anxiety, depression, and chronic pain.

A-Dub strain boasts impressive genetics as a cross between Alien Dawg and the highly popular Sour Double (a cross between Sour Diesel and Sour Bubble). California breeders created this delicious, well-balanced hybrid strain that offers a very high potency when carefully grown and cured, reaching as high as 32% THC.

The strain has deliciously sweet honey and tropical pineapple flavor, with earthy undertones to balance the sweetness.
Growing:
To maximize the high THC on offer from this strain, you must grow and cure A-Dub carefully. Indoor yield sits around 12 ounces per square meter, while outdoor yield is 14 ounces per plant. A-Dub thrives in a warm, Mediterranean-like environment but can grow well indoors and outdoors.

Drying your buds allows moisture to be released so you can smoke or vape your buds. It generally takes around seven to twelve days, though this can vary depending on the size of your bud. Conversely, curing involves storing your bud in a sealed container for around 14 days. Curing isn’t a step you want to skip, as it boosts the flavor and aroma of your bud: You’ll get a smoother, better-tasting smoke overall.

You’ll want to keep buds stored somewhere dry and dark while you’re curing and check on them frequently to ensure no signs of mold.

Height

A-Dub is a short strain, around 30-50 inches (75-130 cm).

Humidity and Temperature

As with any strain, you want to start with a higher humidity during the growing phase. We recommend starting with 70%. As you reach the flowering stage, you can gradually lower humidity in 5% to 30%-40% increments. This process is essential to prevent the risk of your crop growing moldy.

Flowering

Flowering time is average, with an eight-to-nine-week flowering cycle.

Name: 98 Aloha White Widow
Description:
A robust and tropical variant of the classic White Widow strain, this spicy hybrid known as the ’98 aloha white widow strain is 70% sativa and 30% indica. It’s often called a “one-hitter high,” with a moderate THC level of around 20% and 1% CBD. It’s commonly used recreationally but can also help relieve chronic fatigue, insomnia, and headaches.

The 98 Aloha White Widow strain comes from Hawaii, and it originates from the White Gold phenotype. It was first developed in 1998: the legend is that a traveling cannabis enthusiast from Canada produced some seeds to barter with locals, leading to the creation of the hybrid.

The strain is recognizable by its distinctive green trichome-coated dark foliage. Along with other strains such as Kona Gold and Maui Wowie, 98 Aloha White Widow has legendary status in Hawaii and is notable for its unique, earthy flavor and room-filling odor. The strain is available through the Pua Mana 1st Hawaiian Pakalolo Seed Bank.
Growing:
As with all medical marijuana seeds, the first step is germinating the seeds. Cover them with a damp paper towel, and don’t pot them until the seeds have started to sprout (this will usually take a day). Indoor growing is recommended to protect the 98 Aloha White Widow strain from pests and disease, but this strain can also be grown outdoors in a good climate.

Height

You can control the height of the 98 Aloha White Widow by keeping the light low. The White Widow is a shorter strain and should not exceed 1 meter.

Humidity and Temperature

The 98 Aloha White Widow strain needs moderate humidity, and it doesn’t need much special care or as much water as most cannabis plants.

Flowering

One of the reasons for the 98 Aloha White Widow strain’s popularity in Hawaii is its shorter flowering time compared to other Hawaiian strains Kona Gold and Maui Wowie. It vegetates for about eight weeks (between 18-24 hours of light). The flowers do not have a strong aroma, so you don’t need to worry about them drawing attention.

Name: 91 Krypt
Description:
91 Krypt is an indica-dominant strain (cultivar) bred by DNA Genetics, made by crossing Chemdawg 91 and Captain Krypt OG strains.

This strain is an indica-dominant hybrid with 80% indica and 20% sativa lineage. It is a typical indica strain that is perfect for nighttime use, helping users de-stress, relax, and relieve aches and pains.

91 Krypt was bred for potency and often reaches around 20% THC, with a CBD level of less than 1%. Users have described 91 Krypt as having pungent, diesel-like, and ammonia smells and flavors and relaxed, sleepy, giggly effects. This strain may help manage stress, depression, appetite loss, and chronic pain.
Growing:
91 Krypt produces dense and sticky buds on a compact, sturdy plant. This strain is moderately challenging to find and grow. It is a discontinued strain that is only available as cuttings.

To increase the yield, 91 Krypt should be topped to encourage lateral growth and more even colas. As the strain is dense and compact, regular trimming is required to improve airflow, especially in the center of the plant, which will also help increase light penetration through the canopy.

91 Krypt plants are photo-period dependent, meaning they begin flowering when days shorten. Growers can achieve this indoors by altering their lights, the most common of which is a 12:12 cycle, where the lights are on for 12 hours and then off for 12. Outdoors, cannabis will start flowering in late summer through fall, and seeds are generally started indoors from April to May for transfer into the garden.

91 Krypt produces a moderate yield. Users can expect a harvest of about 300 grams per plant indoors and 400 grams outdoors.

Height

Krypt 91 is a compact variety that will reach 30-60 inches tall indoors and outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

When growing this strain indoors, keep the relative humidity between 40%-60% in the vegetative phase and drop it to 40%-50% during flowering to prevent molds such as bud rot from taking hold. Temperatures should stay between 70-80 degrees Fahrenheit. The humidity may fluctuate with changes in temperature as the water cools and condenses from the air. Continual humidity monitoring is essential, significantly when growing indoors.

Flowering

91 Krypt takes 53-60 days to flower.

Name: 9 lb Hammer
Description:
9 Lb Hammer strain (cultivar) is an indica-dominant hybrid composed of 80/20 indica to sativa genetics. Produced by Jinxproof Genetics as a cross of Gooberry, Jack The Ripper, and Hells Angels OG strains, this hybrid carries approximately 17%-21% THC content and a low CBG of 1%. 9 Lb Hammer, also called Nine Pound Hammer or 9 Pound Hammer, has a spicy pine, lime, and grape scent and flavor. The effects can be sleepy, relaxing, and hunger-inducing, which could help manage chronic pain, insomnia, and stress.

As the name suggests, the 9 Lb Hammer is a potent indica strain with high THC levels. The strain descends from Afghani landrace lineage and is notorious for its instant effects, which can feel like a delicious, sedating blow to the head. Coming on strong and inviting the user to breathe more deeply, this somatic high starts as a cerebral slide into full-body sedation.

Offering a piney flavor and a smooth smoking experience, 9 Lb Hammer adds a little lime to the exhale and delivers earthy tones. As the buds are broken or ground, an intense aroma is released, speaking to this indica-dominant hybrid’s Afghani lineage.

The presentation can be chunky and large for a particular sticky bud with an abundance of glittering trichomes. When the flowers are exposed to colder temperatures, they may sport purple hues produced by higher levels of anthocyanin, which is triggered by the cold. 9 Lb Hammer leaves are a mossy green with yellow and orange pistils; the buds are solid, tight, and thick, and the leaves tend to turn toward the stem.
Growing:
9 Lb Hammer can be grown indoors and outdoors. The seeds can be purchased online from Jinxproof Genetics.

Height

Indica plants are relatively short and bushy, growing to be about 3-6 feet tall on average.

Humidity and Temperature

Outdoor growers should aim for a semi-humid climate with a daytime temperature of around 72-80 degrees Fahrenheit.

Flowering

9 Lb Hammer can be expected to flower in approximately nine to 10 weeks. When grown outdoors, the harvest occurs end of October.

Name: 818 OG
Description:
A strain (cultivar) created by an unknown breeder, 818 OG, is shrouded in mystery. Known to be a descendant of the famous OG Kush, 818 OG is 70% indica and 30% sativa, with high THC content testing around 20%. 818 OG has a pungent, flowery, lavender flavor and can help manage insomnia, chronic pain, and anxiety.

The San Fernando Valley is home to many things, from famous film studios and wealthy areas to the infamous porn industry, strip malls, gang neighborhoods, and sweltering heat; the Valley has something for everyone. Maybe that is what our mystery breeders were thinking: that the area code for the Valley, 818, was a fitting name for a strain born in the valley, one with a mix of flavors and effects that has something for everybody.

From its name, 818 OG is suspected to descend from the well-known OG Kush, but because no one knows where this strain came from, nothing else is known about its parentage. The 818 OG strain boasts a sweet, fruity flavor palate with hints of lemon and pine that are mirrored and intensified in its aroma.

818 OG is known as a “fun indica”  due to the strain’s blend of effects that start as euphoric and uplifting before mellowing into relaxation. This can leave you feeling happy and giggling, yet relaxed — the perfect high to keep you sociable and carefree without sending you off to sleep. This strain is 70% indica, so it best suits nighttime use.
Growing:
818 OG can be grown indoors and outdoors but is best suited to intermediate or advanced growers. Like most other indica varieties, this plant is short and densely packed, with heavy buds growing close together. This makes 818 OG susceptible to mold and mildew because its bushy foliage hinders airflow and light coverage. Growers are encouraged to learn how to prune the plant and control humidity and air filtration to fight off disease.

If you manage to grow 818 OG successfully, the buds will be dense, dark green, and spade-shaped. They should have twistings of orange hairs and a dusting of amber-colored trichomes on the surface.

818 OG can yield 10 to 12 ounces per square meter indoors and at least 12 ounces per plant outdoors, but more experienced growers may achieve greater than normal yields with this strain. The “sea (or screen) of green” method can maximize yield. This method makes the most of the short, bushy nature of strains such as 818 OG. You can grow a dense, high-yielding crop in less time using a shorter vegetative stage, shorter flowing times, and pruning of the lower branches. Pruning is vital to maintain airflow and avoid the development of mold.

Height

Like a true indica strain, 818 OG will grow short and bushy, reaching a modest height of around 30 to 40 inches.

Humidity and Temperature

818 OG is a sturdy plant that can survive colder-than-average temperatures but will do well in a warm, sunny environment. As mentioned earlier, this strain is susceptible to mold and disease if the humidity and airflow to the lower half of the plant are not adequately controlled. Pruning and humidity control are your best bet to try to avoid this.

Flowering

When grown indoors, this strain has a short flowering period of seven to nine weeks. If you are growing your 818 OG outdoors, expect it to be ready to harvest from late September to mid-October.

Name: 805 Glue
Description:
Co-founder of Nevada-based GG StrainsGlues, Jon Peabody (also known as Joesy Whales), made history when he developed the first Glue strain in 2013. The strain won the Los Angeles Cannabis Cup thanks to its parent strains of sativa-rich Chem’s Sister, hybrid Sour Dubb, and Chocolate Diesel. The original Glue strain (classic Gorilla Glue) includes a rich and pungent mix of flavors and aromas that lead to an intense body high.

Thanks to its popularity, it made sense that growers would work on other Glue strains, which is where the ever-popular 805 Glue strain found its footing.

The Californian Glue strain (cultivar) is an indica-dominant hybrid (85% indica, 15% sativa) of two unknown hybrid indica strains. While no one can be sure, 805 Glue has always been thought to be a hybrid of at least the Gorilla Glue strain. The 805 Glue strain is THC-dominant at 21%.

The 805 Glue strain is a sought-after hybrid with an interesting etymology. It first appeared in Southern California with the telephone area code “805.” This strain is a cultivar by California’s greenhouse brand Pacific Stone and was created by crossing an unknown strain simply referred to as “805” with what experts believe is most likely Gorilla Glue #4 (GG4). Users say the strain gives off the perfect blend of citrus and earthy aromas with a taste that resembles skunk and soil.

GG4 is one of the strongest glue strains in the world, and the 805 Glue strain is a mellower version of its pungent cousin. 805 Glue buds are small and popcorn-shaped, with minty green nugs and thin orange hairs. They include a coating of frosty, tiny, white crystal trichomes, and thanks to the high indica genetics, it provides a heady and full body high. As the top running glue strain for sale in the United States, it is said to give you that famous “Santa Barbara daily chill.”
Growing:
The 805 Glue strain was first developed in California, so it needs to be grown in a warm environment. Seeds can be grown indoors or outside. As an indica-dominant hybrid, it should grow in most operations. However, it is suggested that it will not grow alongside consistent onshore winds. The best growing method for this particular plant is the “sea of green” method, where you grow plants in a limited space, which causes the plants to form a canopy (sea of green).

Height

As an indica hybrid, you can expect the 805 Glue strain to reach around 3-5 feet in height.

Humidity and Temperature

When growing, keep the humidity between 40%-50% in the vegetative stage, and drop it closer to 40% during the flowering period to prevent mold from growing. You should increase humidity closer to 65%-70% during the seedling stage.

Flowering

As a known photoperiod grower, this plant should flower in eight to nine weeks. You can expect a yield of fewer than 400 grams per plant indoors and less than 400 grams per meter squared outdoors.

As indica-heavy plants grow shorter and bushier than sativa or hybrid strains, this growing pattern will force the plants to focus less on their side blooms and more on the main heavy bloom at the top. With this method, it will only take four to six weeks to grow as the plants will only be small. However, if you choose to grow the plants farther apart, they could take up to 54-64 days to grow and increase up to 30-60 inches in height indoors and outdoors.

Name: 707 Truthband
Description:
A select phenotype of True OG, the 707 Truthband strain is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by breeder Ras-Truth of Emerald Mountain Seeds. The strain often tests at 19%-23% THC, and finding these cannabis seeds can be difficult. 707 Truthband is said to have aromas and flavors of spicy fruit, lemon, oil, and pine, with both physical and cerebral effects that could help manage depression, fatigue, and ADHD.

707 Truthband is a classic Californian strain (cultivar) bred by the Ras-Truth of Emerald Mountain Seeds. This skunky indica-dominant hybrid is a direct descendant of parents OG Kush and True OG.

707 Truthband has a 70% indica and 30% sativa heritage and will give users a relaxed but uplifting high, with users often feeling euphoric. With a moderately high THC content of 19%-23%, 707 Truthband is an ideal strain for experienced users who want to improve their mood, sleep, and manage pain.

Typical of indica-dominant strains, 707 Truthband is best suited for evening use. This strain is loved for its deep aroma and flavors with hints of spiced fruit, citrus, and pine.
Growing:
707 Truthband is a visually stunning variety with strong branches that produce dense, fluffy buds with beautiful purple and red hues. These buds are covered in sticky, resinous trichomes.

Seeds of this variety can be difficult to come by. The seed supplier, Humbolt Seeds, has discontinued this variety. If growers find them, they are only available as feminized seeds, which is great for growing plants for flower rather than breeding. They may also be sourced as cuttings from reputable breeders.

Height

707 Truthband reaches an impressive height of 3-4 meters outdoors.

This is a fast-growing and heavy-yield strain that does well both indoors and outdoors. It responds well to the “screen of green” (SCROG) growing method, as it has sturdy branches that can withstand a bit of bending. The SCROG method is performed by topping the plants in the early vegetative stage. This encourages the plant to produce more side shoots, which evens out the canopy and increases the number of flower sites.

Once topped, the branches of the plants are gently woven through support (usually a horizontal trellis) to maximize the amount of light reaching each potential bud site, giving bigger flowers. Plants can be topped two or even three times, depending on the grower’s setup and the number of bud sites desired.

Humidity and Temperature

The standard flowering period for the 707 Truthband strain is 63 days (9 weeks).

Regular trimming is advised to ensure adequate airflow throughout the canopy, as this strain is compact. 707 Truthband is known to be pest-resistant, which is a bonus for beginner cultivators.

Growers can expect a yield of 600 grams per square meter indoors and an incredible 1 kg to 4 kg per plant outdoors.

Flowering

707 Truthband can tolerate hotter and more humid environments than other strains. When growing, keep the relative humidity between 50%-60%. Temperatures should stay in the 70-80 degrees Fahrenheit (21-26 C) range, but as this is a Californian strain, it can tolerate higher temperatures.

Description:

It’s famous for its head highs that cause a relaxing and calming feeling in the skull. The 707 strain is a light green cannabis plant with high crystal trichomes layered on the plant’s buds. Due to its creation and popularity in California, the strain is easy to find in this area and elsewhere on the West Coast and in Colorado.
Growing:
The 707 strain is a medium-sized cannabis strain grown indoors or outdoors that produces high-yielding flowers. The 707 strain, however, must be grown in an ideal environment to thrive, making it a somewhat challenging plant to grow, especially for beginners. The 707 strain, although not super complicated to grow, can produce a gassy and pungent smell that requires a well-ventilated area.

Height

The 707 strain is a medium-sized cannabis plant that can surprisingly double its size when the flowering period begins, resulting in high yields of up to 35 ounces per plant.

Humidity and Temperature

The ideal environment for growing the 707 strain is dry and sunny, which maximizes the height and yield of the flowering plants.

Flowering

The flowering time of the 707 strain is around 61 to 66 days, with flowering occurring from late October to early November.

Name: 5th Element
Description:
A cross between Blackberry and All Spark OG, the 5th Element strain (cultivar) is an indica-dominant hybrid containing 70% indica and 30% sativa genetics. The strain’s THC tests at around 15%-22%, while its CBD level tests below 1%. The 5th Element strain is medium-sized with dense, moss-green buds covered in orange hairs and sticky trichomes. 5th Element has been reported to help manage stress, chronic pain, and anxiety.

The 5th Element strain has an initial aroma of diesel, which quickly morphs into an earthy, citrus, berry flavor and smell. Like its parent strains, 5th Element can cause cerebral effects that are felt as a light pressure in the head that relaxes both the body and mind to induce a calming and long-lasting high. 5th Element is both challenging to grow and difficult to find.

The 5th Element strain is indica dominant and was created from a cross between Blackberry and All Spark OG strains. This combination creates 5th Element’s aromas of earth, berries, and citrus, and when smoked, it can result in a highly calming and relaxing high. Due to its calming and relaxing effect and terpene content, 5th Element can be used for various medicinal applications, such as treating stress, anxiety, or insomnia.
Growing:
5th Element plants are small- to medium-sized and can be grown indoors or outdoors. Depending on the conditions the strain is grown in and the technique used, such as the “sea of green (SOG),” yields can be improved. However, 5th Element is known to produce below-average yields. The strain should be grown in an ideal environment to thrive, making it a somewhat tricky plant to grow, especially for beginners.

Height

5th Element is a small- to medium-sized plant that rarely exceeds 50 cm in height. Due to the structure of the plant and the density of the leaves and buds, pruning is an essential technique for optimal growth of the strain.

Humidity and Temperature

The 5th Element strain can withstand unpredictable growing factors such as low temperatures. Because of this, it performs well when cultivated outdoors on a farm or garden in the Northern Hemisphere. However, the strain still does best in hot, humid climates.

Flowering

The 5th Element strain can be grown indoors and outdoors; however, indoor operations can result in higher yields when trained with the “sea of green (SOG)” technique. The 5th Element strain flowers quickly in 49 to 56 days indoors and mid-October when grown outside. Even in ideal conditions, the strain generally produces a below-average yield.

Name: 541 Kush
Description:
541 Kush, bred by Eugenius, is a heavy-hitting strain (cultivar) that begins with a subtle tingling sensation that slowly spreads throughout the body. It’s highly indica dominant, with an indica to sativa ratio of 90:10. Its tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) levels are moderate at 15%-20%, giving the strain a long-lasting high.

541 Kush was selectively bred to bring out the characteristics of Kush varieties and comes from a very well-known phenotype, Triangle Kush, delivering the reliable body high common to Kush strains.

Users report that the strain is perfect for use at the end of the day to unwind, relieve stress, relax, and sleep aid. The strain is popular for those managing insomnia, chronic pain, fatigue, and stress.

The strain has a spicy flavor with floral hints upon exhalation, while the aroma boasts an array of earthy herbs, spicy diesel, and skunk tones. Visually, the buds are fluffy, neon green, and oval-shaped, with orange hairs and a sparse coating of tiny, white crystal trichomes.
Growing:
Those looking to grow 541 Kush will be disappointed that the seeds are not readily available for purchase. Seeds sold as 541 Kush may be of a similar genetic makeup or provide similar effects but will not be the authentic plant bred by Eugenius.

However, due to the lineage of 541 Kush, it is safe to assume that it would boast the same growing characteristics as other Kush strains.

Height

Kush varieties are relatively short plants, growing from 2-5 feet tall (90-160 cm).

Humidity and Temperature

Hot and tropical climates are best for Kush varieties. Great care should be taken to provide them with the right environment, as they are sensitive and temperamental plants that require maintenance.

Flowering

An indoor plant will have an expected flowering time of eight to nine weeks and can produce 17 ounces per square meter when given optimal growing conditions.
An outdoor plant will be ready to harvest in early October, and can produce around 16 ounces per plant.
