Name: 503 Wifi
Description:
Grown from a cut of White Fire OG, 503 Wifi is a rare sativa-dominant strain (cultivar) with a very high approximate tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) content of 24% and a cannabigerol (CBG) content of 1%. Descriptions of 503 Wifi’s effects include euphoric, energetic, and focused, and it is often reported to produce a very balanced high. 503 Wifi has been described as having a “flowery” taste and could help manage acute and chronic pain, stress, depression, chronic fatigue, appetite loss, nausea, and ADHD.

It gets its name from parents and the Portland area code 503, which is particularly popular. With its dense barrel-like buds, 503 Wifi appeals to growers and consumers alike.

The creation of 503 Wifi began when the team at OG Raskal Seeds created the potent white fire og strain (AKA Wifi). By dusting a female Fire OG plant with a male clone of The White strain, they enhanced the resulting strain’s aroma and potency. A cutting of a particularly delightful bud of White Fire OG was taken and cultivated independently, giving rise to 503 Wifi.

The 503 Wifi strain has a high potency that can knock even experienced users out flat. It reportedly has a fast and hard high that hits you immediately after smoking, leading to cerebral effects, lifting your mood, and elevating your spirit as your worries fall away.  Next, users report that the high may become “heady,” making them sleepy or sedated. Then it reportedly becomes a more body-based high, bringing feelings of “couch lock” and extreme relaxation.

Many users report 503 Wifi as a perfect all-around strain with multiple applications – it can be consumed during the day or at night.
Growing:
Very little information is available for growing 503 Wifi specifically. If you are looking to grow this strain, you can read up on the growing preferences of 503 Wifi’s genetic parents and relatives (The White, Fire OG, and White Fire OG).

Height

Height of 503 Wifi is not known.

Humidity and Temperature

503 Wifi probably grows best at 40% to 50% humidity.

Flowering

The flowering time for 503 Wifi is unknown, but it is likely similar to Fire OG, which flowers in nine to 10 weeks.

Name: 501st OG
Description:
The 501st OG strain is a 70% indica-dominant hybrid notable for imparting relaxing, sedative effects. It’s a hybrid of Skywalker OG with Rare Dankness #1. 501st OG has a tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) content between 21% and 26% and very low cannabidiol (CBD) levels.

501st OG was initially bred by Rare Dankness Seeds and is known for cerebral and physical effects, often helpful in treating anxiety, insomnia, PTSD, and chronic pain. Overall, this results in a robust and heavy sensation of relaxation after an initial active, cheerful period.
Growing:
501st OG is an easy-to-grow, high-yielding strain suitable for beginners. The plant is tolerant of temporary cold and damp situations and is mold and mildew-resistant. Buds are small but potent. Combined with the ease of growth, it’s clear that 501st OG is a fabulous strain for home growers.

Height

When growing 501st OG indoors, you can expect a stocky plant that responds well to training methods such as “sea of green,” where young plants are bent to grow horizontally. Using this method, plants do not often grow above 30 inches (76 cm).

When growing outside, untrained plants can grow up to 6 feet. For this reason, training methods such as topping or the “sea of green” method are recommended.

Humidity and Temperature

Although the strain prefers a dry, sunny climate, 501st OG is resistant to mold and mildew and can tolerate the occasional high humidity.

Flowering

When grown inside, 501st OG can be expected to take around 50-65 days before being ready for harvest. The colorful flower buds are small, dense, and covered in fine hairs. They’re ready for harvest when the trichomes turn into a mixture of cloudy/milky and amber. For plants grown outdoors, flowering time is near the end of October.

U.S. breeder Exotic Genetix created this indica-dominant strain. 4 Kings is fantastic for its sedative effects, helping people get to sleep in the evenings and stay relaxed without laziness during the day. 4 Kings may be ideal for managing chronic pain, anxiety, and insomnia. Users of this strain report that it is great for a happy buzz without feeling like too much of a couch potato.

Height

Generally, 4 Kings plants will grow between 35 to 60 inches(90 to 160 cm) with large and dense buds that are coated in resin.

Humidity and Temperature

Although cultivating information is rare to find for 4 Kings, one of its parent strains (OG Kush) is similar in its preferred cultivating climates and sizing outcomes. If growing in a hydroponics system, keep humidity at 55% during its vegetation stage, then lower it to around 40% during its flowering stage. Ensure the air is circulating around the plant with a good fan system.

Flowering

4 Kings is an easy-to-grow strain with a flowering time of 55 to 67 days. The buds will be ready to harvest by day 74 if grown in the correct conditions. Indoors, the yield is around 10.5 ounces per square meter. Outdoors, you can get about 14 ounces per square meter, though the risk of a scrapped harvest due to mold is high.

Name: 3rd Coast Panama Chunk
Description:
Bedford Grow created 3rd Coast Panama Chunk as a cross between East Coast Panama Chunk and Sour Diesel strains. Users say this strain (cultivar) is a vigorous grower that produces dense, resinous buds with a pungent smell similar to pine and fuel.

This strain is also potent and uplifting, with many users reporting that they opt for 3rd Coast Panama Chunk because it provides excellent stress relief and has varied cerebral and physical effects. Others claim this strain is also suitable for relieving migraine pain, sore muscles, and insomnia.

3rd Coast Panama Chunk is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain with an estimated 70% sativa and 30% indica. But growing this strain from home appears relatively easy, and growers will enjoy seeing the varied colors in the buds.
Growing:
However, it’s a sativa-dominant plant since it has many characteristics of a sativa, such as pale, thin leaves and a tall height. Therefore, when growing this plant outdoors, growers must ensure that the plant has plenty of sunlight. Otherwise, the bottom leaves could be prone to diseases like mold.

When grown outdoors, growers can expect a yield of 10-15 ounces per plant (280-425 grams). However, when grown indoors, the yield will be slightly lower. When growing this plant indoors, growers can limit the height of this strain by cutting the top of the central stalk. Doing so will prevent the plant from growing too tall. As a result, it will be bushier and produce more flowers.

Height

3rd Coast Panama Chunk grows to 90 inches (2.2 meters) outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

Semi-humid climates are best. Therefore, keep the humidity around 40%-50%. Reduce to 30% humidity as the plant enters the flowering stage.

Temperature is best kept between 68 and 77 degrees Fahrenheit (20 and 25 degrees Celsius). However, growers can increase the temperature slightly for this strain if required.

Name: 3D CBD
Description:
3D CBD is a strain (cultivar) specially curated by the rapper Snoop Dogg, which he bred for its therapeutic benefits. It is a sativa-dominant hybrid (80%) with an earthy flavor. This strain has a relatively high ratio of cannabidiol (CBD) to THC (CBD:THC 8:5) and can provide users with many therapeutic and medicinal benefits. 3D CBD has a woody, spicy, herbal flavor and may help manage chronic pain, muscle tension, anxiety, and inflammation.

The 3D CBD is named for its possible three-dimensional lineage. Some experts believe it crosses Haze, Afghani, and Skunk strains. However, Snoop and other growers have left this fact shrouded in mystery. This parental hypothesis occurred due to 3D CBD’s intense skunk aroma with tropical notes. This strain is relatively rare, but if users can get their hands on it, they can have a greatly enjoyable high.
Growing:
Location and temperature are two of the most important factors when growing 3D CBD.  It grows best in semi-humid climates, like the Mediterranean or countries bordering the equator. It can still grow in other climates, but it’s best to grow indoors where you can easily change the temperate, humidity, and lighting to help optimize the growth.

That said, it’s a difficult strain to grow because it’s impossible to get ahold of the seeds. The only way to grow 3D CBD is by getting a clipping from another plant.

Height

3D CBD grows to a height of around 60-80 inches both inside and outside. This is around average for a cannabis plant. As it isn’t substantial, growers without a sizeable growing space may find this plant attractive.

Humidity and Temperature

As with many other cannabis plants, 3D CBD thrives in a warm climate. This has been compared to a Mediterranean climate, but growers in colder areas can still manage under indoor conditions where they can regulate the temperature.

Flowering

The flowering times for 3D CBD is between 62-71 days, a relatively short period for cannabis. The harvesting time is 76 days and yields around 1-2 ounces per square foot indoors. In an outdoor climate, it yields approximately 15-20 ounces per plant in an outdoor environment.

The flowers of 3D CBD are colored similarly to a mint plant. The trichomes are the show’s star, giving the buds a rich, gold hue that sparkles in the light.

Name: 33 Bananas
Description:
33 Bananas is the balanced hybrid child of the Bananas and OG Kush (50% indica, 50% sativa) strains. For the most part, 33 Bananas is one of the fairly potent strains with THC content at 15%-27% and less than 1% CBD. The strain (cultivar) is named after its rich, fruity, sweet banana aroma and tastes like overripe bananas. The high it creates has refreshing, soothing, and energizing cerebral effects. It is a popular strain worth trying because of its delightful euphoric effects and novelty flavor combination. Its effects suggest that 33 Bananas may help manage anxiety, depression, chronic pain, ADHD, and stress.

This cannabis strain is available from cultivator Kings Garden and was created by crossing Bananas and OG Kush strains. Like its parent strains, 33 Bananas has a pleasant fruity taste shockingly similar to bananas and reportedly provides a happy, relaxed high.

In comparison to the Bananas strain, 33 Bananas has higher levels of sativa, making it evenly balanced genetically rather than an indica-dominant hybrid.
Growing:
This plant has an average yield of around 400 grams per square meter and does tend to grow quite large, so if you care for it well, you may still acquire a decent amount of bud.

Height

This plant has the potential to grow quite tall, so make sure you have sufficient space before planting. The height can range from 30-60 inches both indoors and outdoors.

Humidity and Temperature

As seedlings, cannabis plants grow best in an environment with humidity levels of 65%-70%. You should lower this to 40%-50% two weeks before flowering to protect the strain against bud rot.

Flowering

This strain flowers in 53-62 days and is usually ready to harvest right after this. The buds of 33 Bananas are deep dark green with contrasting purple hues, orange hairs, and pearly white trichomes.

Name: 309 OG
Description:
The 309 OG cannabis strain is new, and little is known about it. Nature’s Grace and Wellness bred the indica-dominant hybrid strain with Grimace OG, and OG Kush strains to yield a distinctive hybrid. Its name comes from the local area code and its OG heritage. However, the OG family of cannabis strains are all related to OG Kush distantly. The “OG” abbreviation denotes an original or unique strain, referencing the term “original gangsta.” Although the strain hasn’t been around long, users have already taken note of its benefits for insomnia, stress, and pain.

309 OG is tetrahydrocannabinol (THC)-dominant and contains low levels of other cannabinoids like cannabigerol (CBG) and cannabidiol (CBD). Its parent strains have a high THC content of 23% (OG Kush) and 18% (Grimace OG) with little to no CBD or CBG.
Growing:
Because 309 OG hasn’t been around long, little is known about its ideal growing environment. But if you get some seeds, growing 309 OG should be the same as growing many other cannabis plants.

Typically, cannabis can be grown inside or outside, and you can check out some specific tips for each environment. If you’re just starting, it’s good to learn cannabis growing essentials.

Height

Since the 309 OG strain is so new, its average height hasn’t been worked out. Most cannabis plants can grow anywhere between 1.5 to 34 feet tall. However, Grimace OG typically only grows to be less than 30 inches tall, and OG Kush only just tops that, growing to be 35 to 63 inches tall. Considering that these are the strains 309 OG was bred from, you can probably expect it to also be on the shorter end of the spectrum.

Humidity and Temperature

The ideal humidity depends on the stage of the plant’s life cycle. Seedlings tend to do best at a humidity of around 60%, while plants in the vegetative stage can manage anywhere between 50% and 70%. Then, when they start flowering, they need to be a little drier at 50% humidity to prevent them from rotting.

Flowering

Cannabis plants usually take about six to 14 weeks to start flowering. You can use the pistils’ color or trichomes to decide when they should be harvested. Some techniques can increase your harvest if the plant isn’t producing a satisfactory yield.

Name: 303 Kush
Description:
The 303 Kush strain (cultivar), also known as 303 OG Kush, is a cross between the Pre-98 Bubba Kush and Chemdawg strains. This indica-leaning hybrid comprises 60% indica and 40% sativa. Its tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) level is up to 18%, with cannabidiol (CBD) content of less than 1%. 303 Kush has been reported to have sleepy, relaxing, euphoric effects, potentially beneficial for stress, pain, insomnia, and depression.

The 303 Kush strain is an indica-dominant hybrid born from a combination of Pre-98 Bubba Kush and Chemdawg. Its breeder is officially unknown but speculated to be Zombo, a cultivator from Colorado. 303 Kush is a richly flavored smooth smoke. It has a complex flavor profile with coffee, diesel, and spicy taste undertones. It reportedly inspires a happy high that will make you feel extra social and euphoric before settling into a relaxing, calm comedown free of physical and emotional stress.
Growing:
The 303 Kush plant is relatively short and bushy, with small buds that grow in dense, tight clusters. The buds are chunky and spade-shaped and have a mossy green coloring broken up by deep shades of purple, reflecting the strain’s Bubba Kush parentage. They have orange pistils and are coated in tiny, white trichomes. This strain is not considered difficult to grow, and both beginners and experienced cultivators can grow this strain relatively easily. The challenge comes from finding the seeds online, resulting in many growers using propagated clones.



Height

When grown outdoors, the 303 Kush plant can reach a height of 60-80 inches (152-203 cm) but stays a relatively short 30-60 inches (76-152 cm) indoors. Although this strain is relatively short on average, it has been reported to grow over 6 feet tall in outdoor conditions, so pruning is essential to eliminate any light-blocking leaves.

Humidity and Temperature

To successfully grow 303 Kush outdoors, you need a hot and semi-humid climate, so indoor cultivation may be best for most growers.

Flowering

The cannabis flower of the 303 Kush strain has an average flowering time of 53-58 days. The outdoor yield size is about 15-20 ounces per plant (approximately 550 grams per plant), while the indoor yield size is 1-2 ounces per square foot (about 400 grams per square meter).

Flowering

On average, you can expect 3 Kings to flower at around 60-70 days indoors and about mid-late October if grown outdoors. The yield is moderate, but you tend to have a greater amount if grown outdoors.

Name: 3 Bears OG
Description:
3 Bears OG, also known as 3 Bears or 3 Bears Kush, is an indica-dominant hybrid strain containing 70% indica and 30% sativa genetics. This strain was created through the mix of Bear OG, Karma’s OG, and Triangle Kush. From these parent strains, 3 Bears OG picked up the best aroma of each plant, which has resulted in the unique watermelon, lemon, and musk aroma and taste of the strain. Although not known fully, the THC content is expected to be around 10%-20%, resulting in a moderately potent high.

3 Bears OG is a small, dense, forest-to-mint green plant that produces dense buds covered in orange hairs and thick crystal trichomes. Due to the density of the plant, some attention to 3 Bears OG, as well as experience in cultivating, may be beneficial to produce the maximum yield. Additionally, due to the makeup of this plant and its known sedative effects, 3 Bears OG may be used for various medical concerns such as stress, anxiety, and insomnia.

Although a small plant, 3 Bears OG can be difficult to handle due to its tendency to grow dense and bushy. Because of this, this strain may be difficult to grow, requiring some cultivation experience and patience. If successfully cultivated, however, 3 Bears OG can produce a decent yield, especially when techniques such as “sea of green (SOG)” are used.

Height

3 Bears OG is a short plant that is only expected to grow to 20-32 cm in height. However, this strain is known to be bushy, making up for its lack of height.

Humidity and Temperature

3 Bears OG is a strain that thrives in hot, Mediterranean climates. However, this strain is also perfect for indoor growing in a greenhouse using the “sea of green” technique (SOG) due to its small size.

Flowering

The flowering time for 3 Bears OG is around 54-59 days, with an expected yield of about 75-100 grams per plant, making it an average-yielding cannabis strain.

Description:
24K Gold, sometimes shortened to 24k or 24K, is a potent hybrid marijuana strain (cultivar) that is indica dominant (60%) with some sativa heritage (40%). Due to its high THC content of approximately 20%, 24K Gold produces powerful psychoactive effects, even for more experienced users. 24K Gold is known for its sweet, citrus flavor and euphoric, relaxing effects and may be useful for managing stress, anxiety, and depression.

High-profile DNA Genetics bred 24K Gold in Amsterdam. It was created by crossing the award-winning Kosher Kush and Tangie strains. Bringing the mouth-watering flavors of its Tangie parent, this strain has a sweet, fruity aroma that pairs with an even better high.

Users report that the euphoric high kicks in faster than most indica strains but eventually tapers down for relaxation.
Growing:
Breeders DNA Genetics has seeds available online if you want to grow your own plant. However, it is quite a tricky plant to grow if you haven’t had much experience.

24K Gold loves being outside in warm, sunny, semi-humid weather and doesn’t tend to lend itself well to indoor environments.

Height

24K Gold looks like a sativa species plant, growing very tall and dense. 24K Gold can grow as tall as 80 inches, and experts recommend pruning the plant in the earlier stages to reduce the heights it can reach if grown indoors. This can also help with light exposure and air circulation.

Humidity and Temperature

24K Gold thrives in outdoor semi-humid environments, which is why it isn’t often grown indoors.

Flowering

Flowering should occur at around 10 weeks, with harvesting not long after. 24K Gold’s yield tends to be moderate, but taking care of it should be a little more rewarding.
